author: R. Joseph
review_text: 🚨🚨Listen up!!! This is hands down one of the best steakhouses I’ve been to. Our server Susan was absolutely a charm! I typically go to steakhouses weekly and Susan was by far the best. Great conversation, personality, local content sharing etc. she was very attentive to our dinner service. I highly recommend this location for a date night or just a wonderful experience to celebrate yourself.

author: Eddie St. Louis
review_text: Amazing Christmas dinner. Our annual tradition of a nice steak dinner and A movie lives on!!! Such a great restaurant. I may have to come once a month at minimum!!  Thank you for an incredible experience.

author: Jr
review_text:
The steak was unbelievable, steak were so tender and it just melted in your mouth… the fried octopus was delicious, The steaks were cooked the perfect way. Duck was all right wasn’t bad was better than usual. Service was excellent, attentive and always making sure we had everything we need and wanted.

My biggest and only  issues were the bathrooms. trash everywhere, Paper towels just everywhere. The toilet toilets were disgusting. For a high-end steakhouse well-known well established is unacceptable.

author: David Murphy
review_text: After visiting your restaurants in NewYork , Miami and Chicago we said while in Boston we would try this Location our reservation was for 7.15pm Sunday 14th December 2025 , The Food and Restaurant was as always amazing However The Service was absolutley appalling, after being seated we were left 25mins waiting to order drinks this i could understand if it was busy however it was very very quiet with  most wait  staff just standing around the bar area chatting and watching  the tvs, i decided id go to bar myslef and order drinks (not acceptable) when we did get our drinks the waiter whom seemed so uninterested in having to work, we asked to order wine with dinner however after waiting a further 20mins for our chosen wine our meal had already arrived to our table . We are so disapointed in our visit in Boston as we have always  had such amazing service in your other Locations , not good at all i will definetley not be back and will not recommend this Boston location,  Not worth the money that it costs.

author: Z Rao
review_text:
We don't usually leave reviews but  hoping that prividing this feedback might be helpful for the restuarant and other diners.

We had dinner on a week day here. First impressions were good, buzzy atmosphere, restaurant is well decorated.

However, the service we recieved just did not match up to the restaurant's reputation.

Food took over 45min to arrive (ok.. it's a busy evening so we can understand that).

The food tasted good, but not something to rave about, especially at their price point.

We were disappointed by the service for the evening:

- Our server checked up on us once very very breifly immediately after the food arrived , before we even tasted anything, and then didn't check again after we'd actually started eating.  We would have loved some mustard to go with the steak for example. But no one was around to check up on us.

- We asked our server if we could pack the remaining cheesecake dessert to take away.  Rather than the cheesecake being carefully into the container, the server came over with the box to our table, and literally flipped the plate with cheesecake on it into the box, so the cheesecake landed  upside down. We watched with much surprise.

We really wanted to like the experience more but struggled to in the end.  We felt there was a general lack of attentiveness and care throughout our evening, which left us rather disappointed.

author: Matt M
review_text: Nice restaurant. Cocktails were great. Food wasn't. But they were polite and removed it from our bill.

author: Liliya Fisher
review_text: I had seabass and it was cold and small. Half of it was just thick skin. I was very disseminate.  Tuna tartar was small as well.  Half the size of what im used to getting at other restaurants and the sesame cracker was soggy.  Last time I was there it wasn't like this. Maybe bad chef night?

author: Kathleen Foxx
review_text: WOW. We were impressed the moment we walked in. Our server was wonderful, staff was super attentive, food was magnificent. Couldn’t have picked a better place for a surf n turf birthday dinner! Menu is a La carte, so you order your main entree and sides separately. We ordered half portions of the sides and it was still too much food! Absolutely wonderful.

author: Jay (JMan)
review_text:
This is 1 of the best steaks I've  ever had it was Juicy and tasty cooked perfect.  🔥

Also had the Shrimp were big anuff to knock  you out and they were cooked perfect and tasted great. The bread was a hit also.
I definitely recommend This restaurant 👌.

author: Maria
review_text: Happy New Year... Enjoyed a fantastic meal... The swinging tomahawk was a hit.  Igly, our waiter, was exceptional... A gift card and recommendation from my son Markie made it special. Grateful for the experience.

author: Jesus Caez
review_text: Me and my wife dined here for Christmas Dinner and nothing short of amazing. Me and my wife got the Surf n Turf for two and it blew us away. The steak and lobster were cooked perfectly, the truffle Mac n cheese was also great, I recommend the coconut creme cake to end the night. Me and my wife do not drink so I cannot comment on their alcohol but they had a very extensive wine list!

author: shirley DAVIS
review_text: SuPerB!! Lobster and crab cakes for appetizers.   Filet and Chilean Sea Bass was to die for.  The choCoLate cake was simply put "Oh My"!!.  The drinks were well made - The service ♤♤♤ couldn't be beat.

author: Serdar N
review_text:
Top 5 all my life steaks.

The Boston branch is very nicely located. You look at the historical ship and water front.

Food is unbelievable.

Is it affordable? Not necessarily. I had to cut off dining out for a few weeks in order to eat here.

But it’s worth it

author: J B
review_text:
Always ask for the waitress Claudia from Columbia…
The wagyu beef appetizer was great.
The clam chowder was good. I have had better but I would order it again.
The drinks were superb! I wish we had more time to order a few more drinks.
Claudia was so attentive as well as the rest of the wait staff. They made our trip to Boston lovely. Claudia was so nice and personable.

My wife is vegetarian and I wish there was more options but the sides she ordered were very tasty.

author: Neelam Larm
review_text: Excellent customer service, food was delicious flavored, rustic retro atmosphere. Overall I would like to give 4.5 but don't know how. Lamb chops was excellent flavor and mint jelly to to top it off. Only thing I didn't care for was, it was little tough. Everything else we had ordered on the side was excellent.

author: Russell Ariagno
review_text: We had the Japanese Wagyu beef dumplings as an appetizer and they were incredible, the sauce they came in was delicious and the beef inside was perfectly cooked.  I got the A5 Japanese wagyu which was very good, some pieces were a bit cool which I understand happens with the A5 but I feel it should have been properly heated up and brought out immediately.  It was seared on the outside with the right amount of crisp and the warm pieces inside melted like butter.  As a complimentary side they gave exotic mushrooms which were delicious and had some kind of a raspberry vinegar glaze/sauce which was perfect with these mushrooms.  My wife got the American Wagyu filet whip was cooked and seasoned perfectly, came out delicious.  We also had there tater tots which were crispy on the outside and a mashed potatoe filling on the inside.  It was my birthday and they gave me a complimentary chocolate filled with marshmallow and graham cracker.  The service was excellent, our waiter was very friendly, everyone who waited on our table was excellent, top class service.  All in all a great experience

author: Laura Martin
review_text:
We had our wedding at Mooo… Seaport and cannot say enough amazing things about the entire experience. From the moment we began planning to the very last minute of our reception, the team went above and beyond in every possible way. The events manager Melanie was incredibly organized, responsive, and genuinely invested in making our day perfect.

The staff on the day of our wedding delivered flawless service—professional, warm, and attentive without ever being intrusive. The food was unbelievable (our guests are still talking about it), the venue was stunning, and every detail ran seamlessly. It honestly felt like a dream, and we owe so much of that to the exceptional team here.

If you’re considering hosting an event or wedding at Mooo… Seaport, don’t hesitate. It was truly one of the best decisions we made. We are beyond grateful for the unforgettable experience!

author: Ashley Perez
review_text:
This restaurant is beautifully put together — the decor feels polished and intentional, and the overall atmosphere is upscale and welcoming. Customer service was great from start to finish, the restaurant was very clean, and the food was excellent. The steak was prepared to perfection, and the drinks were well made. Everything we ordered was on point.

The bathrooms are not located inside the restaurant but downstairs in the main lobby, which wasn’t a big issue, just something to note.

The only reason this isn’t a full 5-star review is the valet parking situation. Valet was $25 and required payment upfront, which was surprising — especially for a high-end restaurant. This was my first time experiencing mandatory upfront valet payment, and it definitely took away from an otherwise excellent experience.

Great food, great service, great atmosphere just wish the valet process matched the rest of the experience

author: Robert Chin
review_text: Modern steakhouse with a twist! Celebrated my mom's birthday with a delicious dinner here at Moo. We wanted something different than the typical steakhouse (Smith & Wolensky, Capital Grille, etc.) and we've heard great things about Moo. The lobster bisque with souffle topping is one of the best I've ever had - sweet from the lobster and not overly buttery. The porterhouse was cooked perfectly. We definitely recommend the cream spinach and mushroom sides. We topped it all off with an apple tart a la mode...yum! Thank you to our waiter, Daniel for providing the best service and making my mom's birthday super special.

author: Julian Ramirez Perez
review_text:
I went with my wife for for dinner anniversary. We always are Bar lovers so, we had 2 seats at the bar ( the most comfortable bar I ever been ). We were not extremely hungry so we just try a couple dishes. The carpaccio was good, and nice portion. The octopus was actually not my favorite, I like my octopus juicy inside an we’ll roasted outside, but it was actually just burn and dry. I loved the steak tartare, I actually think is the best I have try. We order the 24 Oz ribeye, with the truffle butter. OMG the steak is just to perfect.
Margarita was our bartender, she is such a charming person and so attentive. She makes really good tequila espresso martinis. I really like the place and the friendly staff. “Note, the place is more in the fancy side, so dress up properly”

author: Salina Allen-Sharpp
review_text:
I spent my 65th birthday dining solo at Moo in the Seaport — something I do often and truly enjoy. This wasn’t about being alone; it was about indulging myself in an extraordinary meal while quietly celebrating where I’ve been and embracing where I’m headed next. ✨

The Beef Wellington was exceptional — beautifully prepared and perfectly tender. The Yukon potatoes were rich and fluffy, though I did happen to find a thin wire in them. To their credit, the staff handled it with grace and professionalism, immediately apologizing and making things right without hesitation. Their attentiveness turned what could have been an unfortunate moment into a testament to true hospitality. 🍷

I paired my entrée with broccolini and ended the evening with a freshly baked chocolate chip cookie — still warm, almost too hot to hold, and completely worth the wait.

Moo offers an atmosphere that feels both refined and welcoming — the kind of place where a solo diner can feel perfectly at home while enjoying a bit of quiet luxury. It was a wonderful way to mark another year of life, gratitude, and growth. 🌿

author: Chris Ferreira
review_text:
I honestly feel like this place is better for drinks then for food

I felt like it was extremely overpriced for what we actually got. I did think they went above and beyond with the menu. It was a nice personal touch. I was there for an anniversary and a birthday and they gave her  a personalized menu but other than that when you spend 400+ on a dinner 389 to be exact you would think you would get more.

I will say that I went there prior just for drinks in the atmosphere. It was pretty amazing.

But just be aware that you are going to spend quite a bit when you go here it’s up to you if you think it’s worth it or not

I believe this place is more hype than what it’s worth. I would be willing to try it again some other time.

The milk and cookies was amazing! Also had to add that in there

author: Stijn V
review_text:
Very good meat.  I had the NY strip loin. Also the tuna tartar was excellent.
Béarnaise could use some improvement though, more sour would have been nice.  Wines were great as well as was the bread. Good service.

author: Katherine Rodriguez
review_text:
Absolutely Incredible Experience!

We had an amazing time at this steakhouse! From the moment we walked in, everything felt welcoming and top-notch. The atmosphere is classy but comfortable — perfect for a date night or a nice dinner with friends.

Our server Alexis was truly outstanding. He was friendly, professional, and made us feel so well taken care of the entire evening. Alexis knew the menu inside and out, gave great recommendations on the steak sauces, and made sure every detail was perfect. It’s rare to get service that good these days!

The food was beyond delicious — our steak was cooked exactly how we ordered, juicy and full of flavor. The sides were good but the Lobster Mac and cheese were very dry. The Moo steak sauce was impressive.

The cocktails were meh.. I’m not a huge fan of savory cocktail which the Devils Advocate was strong but savory.

The milk and cookies dessert was the perfect finishing touch. That moo milk is something else!!

Everything about this place was exceptional. Great food, amazing service, and a wonderful atmosphere. Huge thanks to Alexis for making our dinner so memorable! We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Kate
review_text: We had a group experience in a private dining room for events. The appetizers with champagne were delightful before dinner. The service was impeccable and timely. The Caesar salad fresh, the filet mignon and whipped potatoes, creme brulee  and cappuccino paired with their chocolate truffles were all outstanding. I will be back, even if only for the service. Aside, if you're a water snob, you won't be disappointed here.

author: Mareesa Ahmad
review_text: Holy cow this place was insane. THE BREAD AND BUTTER ARE YOU KIDDING. I dream of it. The steak was divine and we did the side flight which was much larger than we expected, but all was delicious. Honestly thought the prices were high at first but they give large portions so it’s all worth it!

author: Denny Andrade
review_text:
Mooo…. Seaport is hands down one of the best dining experiences in Boston. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere strikes the perfect balance of modern elegance and cozy sophistication.

Our server, Alexi, was outstanding—warm, attentive, and incredibly knowledgeable about the menu. He guided us with great recommendations and made the entire evening feel special without ever being overbearing.

The steaks are the star here: perfectly cooked, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and seasoned to absolute perfection. Each cut feels like it was chosen with care, and the presentation elevates the experience even further. The sides are equally impressive—creamy whipped potatoes, decadent mac & cheese, and fresh seasonal vegetables that complement the richness of the steak beautifully.

Don’t skip dessert—the warm butter cake is an indulgence worth every bite. Pair it with a glass of wine from their thoughtfully curated list, and you have a flawless night out.

Whether it’s for a special occasion, a business dinner, or simply a treat-yourself evening, Mooo…. Seaport delivers excellence on every level. Truly a must-visit in Boston’s dining scene.

author: Gina R
review_text: The reviews don’t lie!! Make a reservation and come here. We celebrated a birthday here. We started with oysters and they tasted super fresh! For dinner, we got filet mignon with a side of mashed potatoes and side of onion rings. All of the food was out of this world! We both agree  it was the best filet mignon we’ve had. Brad was our server. He was very knowledgeable on the menu and made great recommendations. Will be back for sure!!!

author: Small Blue Toy
review_text:
Really great service from experienced professionals

A very well executed meal with impeccable service. Anyone can sell you a 100$ ribeye cooked properly but not many can do it with the level of service Mooo seaport provided

Meal timed perfectly, everything cooked perfectly. Upscale setting. One of the best in Boston

author: Chandan S
review_text:
Giving 4 because I wasn’t that impressed with their steak. I got the New York Prime Rib and it was meh. Their lamb racks and bone marrow on the other hand was solid. Top notch. Thoroughly enjoyed them.

Service was great. Staff was friendly and kind.

author: Jackie Vanegas
review_text:
Incredible meal with incredible services. My partner and I went here to celebrate some of our professional successes that’s happened within the last couple of weeks. Upon finding out, our waiter and the rest of the team presented us with a lovely chocolate cake on the house.

The Tomahawk for 2 was incredible and he brought home plenty of leftovers with us. The flavor of the steak and the temperature was perfect and each bite had such an amazing flavor. We thoroughly enjoyed the service in where they explained to us each part of the tomahawk and cut it by the table.

We enjoyed it so much and cannot wait to come back.

author: Bill
review_text:
I don’t have too many steakhouse reviews but our experience at Mooo Seaport was outstanding. My wife and I, who live across town and don’t frequent Seaport, Ubered to Seaport last might for what turned into one of our best steak experiences in recent memory (yes it was that good).

We decided on the tuna tartare appetizer, followed by the Beef Wellington and cap steak (the latter, one of their specialties) and said we would be sharing everything. The tartare, a delicious combination of tuna, seaweed and a yummy sauce with seaweed and sesame oil flavor, was perfectly portioned on two separate plates for us, as was the Wellington, arguably the star of the evening (for my wife especially). Thin, crispy pastry surrounded the tenderloin and inside was an amazing duxelles with foie gras that topped the steak, served on a perfect red wine reduction.

However, for me, the cap steak was another level in terms of both richness and tenderness. Of course both steaks were cooked to a precise medium rare and paired perfectly with simple sea salt fries and a glass of CA cab.

Very solid beer and wine by the glass menus (and dirty martini loaded with blue cheese olives for my wife). Service was outstanding. In addition to everything being separated and perfectly presented, one of the servers from another table (Zach), whom we had known at the Capital Grille years ago, had recognized our name from the reservation list and came by to say hello! In addition, the manager came several times to make sure we had everything.

That level of detail, the “through the roof” level of the food and preparation, set Mooo above nearly every other Boston steakhouse, in the same conversation as Grille 23. Cheers, Mooo!

author: Olga Kiseleva
review_text:
Mooo Seaport is an elegant and beautifully designed place where everything feels refined and upscale. The experience starts with a warmly smiling hostess and ends with the sweetest busgirl — the service is truly top-tier.
As a lover of great food, I can honestly say this spot alone is reason enough to come back to the city. The steak tartare and bone marrow are among the best I’ve ever had. The tartare has that deep, slightly smoky flavor of perfectly aged meat, and the bone marrow — served under a crispy crust with roasted garlic — is simply unforgettable.

If you go, you must try these two. Just pace yourself — the fresh bread is delicious and fragrant, but don’t fill up on it or you won’t have room! The side of mushrooms is also a standout, and everything else holds up to the same high standard.
And please, don’t skip the crème brûlée — leave room for this dessert. It's the perfect finish to a truly memorable meal.

author: Kevin Murphy
review_text: Mooo... Restaurant in Boston is as exceptional as any high-end spot we've experienced worldwide. From ascending the stairs to departure, the staff makes you feel truly special—there's no greater satisfaction when spending hard-earned money at restaurants, retailers, or hotels. Our server was excellent, but Stefan, the Sommelier/Beverage Manager, stood out, easing our overwhelm with the vast wine list. After describing our preferences, he confidently assured us, "I have you covered." The first bottle was superb; the second even better. Food: 10/10. Staff: 12/10. Highly recommended.

author: Roberts .J06
review_text: Sunday brunch for this spot, for a chill, great scenery, great vibes with all the right songs, tequila & tacos! I got to go during brunch times, the waitress checked off the vibe check! Was able to help me out exactly with what I wanted! I told her what I was feeling and she reassured that what I wanted was THE items in the menu! I could have ordered TWO orders of the pancakes! But probably would have had to be carried out! Do yourself a favor & grab the Cornbread  Pancakes has is (if you like everything there) TRUST ME ! With the tater tots make sure to cut the egg over it before trying so it’s not as dry! Recently took family there cause I felt so highly about them, and it had been confirmed . THE brunch spot! We had 3 orders of the pancakes at the table! & the staff is truly amazing! Friendly, welcoming! Have my girl now that’s there, that is THE girl she’ll make sure everything comes out on point! Idk if I want to tell yall, cause then you’ll make it difficult for me!

author: Kevin Osborn
review_text: Nice Vibe and great,creative food. We went there for new years brunch and it was Fabulous. The service was friendly but a little slow after we got our food ( which was quick)

author: Amanda St
review_text: All in all a positive experience. Only complaints I have is they initially forgot the beef on the taco salad we asked for, our food came out at different times and I felt bad my step daughter had to wait another 5 minutes for her food…and then the restaurant called me saying I didn’t pay, all because they didn’t look under the check where the $100 that included a 25% tip. But the food was good, nothing special and the atmosphere was beautiful.

author: Lacey Martell
review_text: Food was delicious and the atmosphere was wonderful. We were sat next to the kitchen and were unable to chat much due to the noise, but our server placed us at another table which was great. I order my food without an ingredient as I did not like the taste of it, and 1/2 of my meal was made properly and the other half had the ingredient I requested not be included. Overall the food and drinks were delicious and at a great price and the service was great, I would just recommend double checking your food if you have dietary restrictions. Additionally, this is a beautiful restaurant location with a pretty interior if you are looking for a pretty place to have a meal.

author: The Hungry Road
review_text:
(Last visited October 19, 2023.) Hanging out in Boston for work and it's Taco Tuesday! So naturally, I do some Yelp'ing and found Citrus & Salt! Here's how it went...

Atmosphere/Appearance: Set right downtown Boston tucked among the skyscrapers is this gem. Obviously, it's downtown so it won't have a private parking lot. I'm sure there's plenty of street parking in a neighborhood nearby, but be careful to really read the signs carefully. Once inside it felt a little like a nightclub! Lol. Not that the music was loud of anything, but the energy inside or lively, the vibes were high and everyone seemed like they were having a good time. I was also surprised by how big the place was! So many downtown restaurants have a small footprint, but this one was about the size of 2 "normal" restaurants. The decor was awesome, the lighting was a little dark, but it was colorful and energetic.

Service: We sat at the bar and even though it was quite busy, we had no issues at all.

Food: My friends and I were sharing so many plates that I can't remember everything that I had. Lol. However, I remember liking everything that I tried. The drinks were also good! Everything was so picturesque, but the flavors definitely matched the plate's visuals.

Value: This place is a bit more "upscale" than your "traditional" Mexican restaurant. So you will pay more here, but it's totally worth it. I probably spent $75.00 myself on a few taps and some drinks.

In conclusion, I really liked it here and would absolutely return here! I have nothing bad to say about this place!

author: Jennifer Cintron
review_text: Great place — classy, sexy, and sophisticated. The drinks are top-notch, the food is delicious, and the whole atmosphere feels effortlessly stylish. Perfect spot for a night out!

author: Kirsten Turrisi
review_text: Lovely brunch spot! Beautiful atmosphere and amazing tapas! Perfect sharing sizes and the drinks were top notch!

author: crystalb822
review_text: I went to Citrus and Salt to celebrate my birthday, the restaurant esthetics were nice. I loved the vibe of the place. The food was good and I tried the octopus which was very good. I hope they create more dishes for the menu.

author: Sharanya Sarkar
review_text:
We couldn’t get a reservation at our preferred time since it was a Saturday night, but it worked out just fine. The bar was full service and had a great vibe.

The lighting and decor were beautiful, with warm tones and cherry blossoms that made the space feel magical. It was the perfect setting for a cozy date night.

The tacos were amazing. The fish tacos were our favorite — super fresh, warm, and packed with flavor. The ground beef tacos (gordita crunch style) were a close second. The duck tacos were just okay in comparison.

The drinks were excellent. I started with the mango cucumber margarita (because tequila is cheaper than therapy, right?) and really liked it. My partner had the espresso martini and loved it. For our second round, I had the "Beautiful Liar" with prickly pear, tequila, elderflower, orange blossom, and black lava salt. My partner went for the "Garden of Eva" with mezcal, watermelon, and basil. Both were nice, but we still preferred our first choices.

Overall, it was a fantastic date night with great food, drinks, and ambiance. We’ll definitely be coming back.

author: Dr. Sergio Nieves
review_text: My wife and I had an amazing brunch at Citrus and Salt thanks to Manuela our fantastic and attentive server.  Jenn, the manager, was a very hospitable host. We felt very welcomed.

author: Zee Ibrahim
review_text:
French toast was very tasty! Loved the whole meal. Ambiance was great too!

Definitely recommend!

author: Magda A. Jabbar
review_text: Nice vibe and colors, fresh food, service was a little slow. Grilled shrimp tostadas have great flavors, churros - not impressed.

author: Lorena Gomes Rocha
review_text: Citrus & Salt never disappoints! The food and drinks are always fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service is top-notch — friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Definitely worth a try, and absolutely a place I’ll be coming back to again and again.

author: Sanju santhosh shetty
review_text: Citrus and Salt is an absolute gem! From the moment you step inside, the aesthetic environment captivates you with its vibrant, yet relaxed vibe - perfect for any occasion. The decor is modern yet welcoming, with a mix of clean lines and cozy touches that create a warm, inviting atmosphere. The food is just as impressive. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted, bursting with bold flavors that hit the spot every time. Whether you’re there for a light bite or a full meal, everything is fresh and expertly prepared. Don’t skip the drinks - they offer a great selection, from creative cocktails to refreshing mocktails, all of which are a treat. A perfect place to enjoy fantastic food, great drinks, and an unforgettable ambiance! Highly recommend!

author: K.Z.
review_text: Very cute spot. The food was definitely visually appealing, but wasn’t quite what I expected. Service was great, drinks were good, and the music was a vibe. I’m not sure what standard prices are for drinks in the area, but expect to pay $18 per margarita. If you want to hear the latest reggaeton hits while eating a duck taco, this spot is for you!

author: Thuc Nhan Tran
review_text: We came for a Saturday drag brunch and it was so much fun!! The ambiance and decor in this place is absolutely stunning! The food was super fresh (from the ceviche to the chips, you can tell everything was made fresh) but could use a bit more flavor. Overall great experience. Would probably come back for the drag brunch experience but not just for the food.

author: Tonya C
review_text: It was a beautiful place with a good atmosphere. Made a reservation here for my birthday with a party of 5. We first got a table seating but requested a booth. The host was nice and accommodating and was able to move us. This place is great for social media photos. They had arts everywhere and that made it  photo worthy.  The food and drinks was good.  We got the Patron tower and let me tell you.  The MANGO patron slushie was the BEST! PARKING was easy at the garage near by.   As for food portion my opinion was not fulfilling for us 5. That's the only thing that was  negative for us. Overall the place is great! Recommend!

author: Catherine
review_text: Had a fantastic time here for a birthday recently. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere was fantastic. Technically everything is tapas style, but my friends and I all ordered our own plates as meals, with chips to share, and were satisfied. I had the avocado toast, which was very tasty. Tried a bit of the cornbread pancakes, and they were absolutely amazing. Will definitely be getting those as my meal next time! Vegetarian options are available. We were seated in a smaller private room (seemingly because it was a birthday, but it also might have been because our party was a bit big), but it will be fun to visit again and see more of the decor in the rest of the restaurant.

author: S Glover
review_text: A literal GEM in downtown Boston. Lobster rolls are everywhere but THIS place is one of a kind & truly special! Delicious food, tasty bevs, artsy decor & friendly staff all combine for the coolest vibe. Make this a priority stop when in Boston!

author: Jenn Salazar
review_text: You cannot walk by this place. You have to go in. The atmosphere is as beautiful and flavorful as the food. Everything we had was beyond fantastic. You have to 🏃‍♂️  and try this place!

author: Amy Rash
review_text:
I was recommended this spot by a friend, I owe her big time.

The food was amazing for a fast casual spot. We came at 12 pm on a Friday and we received our food surprisingly quick despite the line. Also the servers were so incredibly friendly. We ordered a lamb gyro, a pork platter, and the new lentil salad - everything was delicious. In fact it was so good that we went back in after we finished to order their donut and it was honestly the best decision we made that day - they were so incredible.

We will definitely be visiting Greco again next time we’re in Boston.

author: Sheraz Choudhary
review_text:
Upon entering the restaurant I could barely breathe and a few others patrons were also having a hard time.  There was something in the air that irritated the throat. I put on an N95 but did not leave.

The meal I ordered was $16 so not cheap but the ingredient quality was extremely poor!  My stomach was upset for a few hours after consuming the food.  The chicken disgusting and full of fat.

From other recent reviews it seems like this restaurant has gone downhill recently (definitely not deserving a 4.6 in its current state).

I rarely write negative reviews but GRECO has to improve its quality because for $16 there are much better places to eat at.

author: Behnam MA
review_text: High quality and delicious food, reasonable price, nice staff. It’s small place but it’s good for having a quick meal. Beef was fresh and delicious. Highly recommend to try their sauces.

author: Dirty Souf Yankee
review_text:
My first experience was good. Second two, meh.

Their avgolemono soup isn't made the way I'm used to but was still ok. Chicken souvlaki is good, Feta is not. Fries are ok. Rice pilaf is bland.

Their rewards system and online ordering are something no one seems trained on and is confusing. Online ordering also does not make anything easier. My food took nearly 30 minutes to come up.

author: T-Bone
review_text:
This was my first experience at GRECO. I went tot he Newbury St location.  I ordered the signature Greek salad with chicken.

I wanted to take a foto, forgive me for taking a few bites before I took the foto. This salad was absolutely_delicious_ and filling.  I loved all the ingredients.  After the first bite I immediately tasted the strong oregano, which I love.

This salad reminded of the salads I had in Greece years ago.  I'm a huge fan of the Mediterranean tomato/cucumber salads.  My Italian parents made it all the time when we were kids.

Looking forward to going back.

author: Abbey
review_text: I enjoyed the customizable aspect of GRECO's pita roll, with its various protein and sauce options. While flavorful, I found both the fries and the meat to be a little dry and not as tender as I would have preferred. It's also convenient that they have seating available in the store.

author: Daniel H
review_text:
Ordered the pork plate with Fries and no pita. Had hoped to get more fries instead of pita but was the same amount. The meal was fine. I’d get rice next time instead. 25% tzatziki on the plate. Probably a good deal in comparison to other offerings in the area.
It was a pretty easy and quick meal despite it being on a bust marathon weekend.

author: d
review_text:
Greco , Newbury St.

Quick service, and a great budget meal on Newbury. Store is usually busy.

Pork and chicken skewers. You can also get some of the classic Greek foods as well.  Compact menu.  Greek donuts bathed in honey for dessert!

Meats were fresh , nicely seasoned.

Seating indoors and out.

author: Layla Mansour
review_text: I had my doubts about their zucchini chips but they were fire 🔥 also had a chicken gyro (not pictured). It was pretty good and generous but I didn't care for the garlic skordalia.

author: Aysel Karakurt
review_text: The food was super delicious, very clean and spacious. I loved the olive tree picture on the wall. Thank you.

author: Sharanya Sarkar
review_text: Ah absolutely amazing food! Looked for the highest rated food place around where I was on Newbury street at that point, and this showed up. And the food was so comforting and amazing. We got the lemon rice and chicken, and lamb w/ spicy feta and had an extremely hearty meal!

author: Cami Tussie
review_text: Love this place, always my go to for fresh food on Newbury that tastes delicious. The zucchini chips are DIVINE. A must get when they are made fresh (some days you aren’t as lucky but it’s a risk worth taking). My favorite is the horiatiki salad with charred eggplant. The keftedes are so good. I wasn’t a fan of the Brussels sprouts, just to note, but truly you can’t go wrong with Greco. Expensive for fast casual but so much better than so many other options on newbury

author: Linjie Shen
review_text: The food there is pretty good. I tried lamb pita, the lamb was fresh and smelled good. The atmosphere there is really nice, I like the music in the restaurant. As for a fast casual,the waiting time here is not so long. so I really appreciate everyone to try here.

author: Rayan Kidia
review_text: I rarely leave reviews but I had to this time, I went with my friend at around 8pm and we both got the chicken pita sandwich and one serving of their greco fries to share for a total of 35 dollars (not cheap at all for what we got). The fries were served ice cold and both sandwiches were uneatable, the chicken was extremely greasy and flavorless, I asked to get it without onions and tomatoes and guess what happened... I got it with extra tomatoes and extra onions... The cherry on top was the stomachache we both got a few hours later. I would NOT recommend to anyone and I really don't think it deserves he 4.6 rating it got on here.

author: Paul Almashi
review_text: Absolutely loved GRECO! The food is fresh, flavorful, and truly authentic — every bite feels like a trip to Greece. The atmosphere is cozy and stylish, and the staff are super friendly and attentive. Prices are fair for the quality you get. Highly recommend to anyone who enjoys real Mediterranean flavors! 🇬🇷✨

author: Monica Tuccella
review_text:
The food was really delicious, it’s probably the best casual Greek restaurant I’ve been to. The staff is really nice too. Our overall experience was great and we are definitely coming back!

Keep in mind that the place is really small and there’s limited seating. It’s more suitable for a group of less than 3 people (only if you are looking to dine in).

Don’t forget to try the feta fries!

100% recommend it!

author: MS B
review_text: I've been wanting to come to this place for a while but was affraid that the kids wouldn't like it. A small spot, cozy and kids friendly. I had the lamb pita which was delicious. They have chicken and pork as well. I will definitely go back to try the plate dinner, the zucchini chips and donut holes. Do not hesitate go, check them out.

author: ILoveFood
review_text: It's like a fast food place, food is prepared pretty quickly. There's a small outdoor place with tables and chairs.

author: Joshua Fields
review_text: Beautiful Pita Sandwich! I got Bifteki with Spicy feta and it’s simply an amazing pita, the beef patties are so well seasoned and packed with flavor. The Charred Pineapple and Lime Mayo Sauces were power moves and would highly recommend them both.

author: Qifan Zhou
review_text: Had a fantastic lunch at GRECO today! I ordered the lamb plate with fries and yogurt sauce, and everything was delicious. The lamb was perfectly cooked—tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. The fries were crispy and seasoned just right, while the yogurt sauce added a creamy, refreshing balance to the dish. The portion is just right for a weekday lunch. Highly recommend if you’re looking for authentic Greek food in Boston!

author: Stephany Hwang
review_text:
The Cheesecake Factory has the best angel hair meatballs pasta. I'm in love with it. The Mexican style salad is also great.
Service was a bit slow considering how many tables were still empty, but they were overall nice and attentive.
Great value for price!

author: JF Bruns
review_text: 9/25 - Staying at the Sheraton and this was a close walk.  There was still a 45 minute wait on a Sunday @ 7pm.  Our group was lucky enough to score two high tops in the bar to cut that in half.  Our server was great, efficient & easy to deal with even when it came to dividing our ticket up 5 ways.  I enjoyed the Jamaican shrimp but the shrimp were a little overdone.  The wife had the crab cake bites, perfect size for her and she loved them.  Very limited beer menu but did have a full bar.  Enjoyed our visit!

author: sweethartzoya
review_text: Had a great meal at The Cheesecake Factory. The avocado egg rolls were a standout, crispy on the outside, creamy inside, and the tamarind chutney that comes with them takes it to another level, so flavorful. The brown bread with butter is always a favourite, soft and paired perfectly with the salty butter, the perfect start before the mains. Ordered pasta and, true to Cheesecake Factory style, the portion was huge and very tasty. Overall, a really satisfying experience and definitely recommend.

author: D S
review_text:
Best to go if you are in a group or a pair. If you are alone, you will likely sit at the bar or the high tables even if there are other tables available.

Food has good sized portions. Crazily huge menu hence I do not know what their speciality is.

Ordered some chicken breast cakes with some batter. Think that I ordered the wrong dish. Beer was ok.

Pretty dark environment in the evening.

author: Evelin Reichardt
review_text: Nice atmosphere. Great service. The food was prepared quickly. Everything organized. Super clean bathrooms.

author: Devane Sharma
review_text: Visiting from Asia, Cheesecake Factory was top of my list and it was great. The menu is overwhelmingly big, mains and the cheesecake and the over-the-top decor sets the atmosphere right! Everything feels massive and of course the food is great. I had the chicken parmigiana and the tiramisu cheesecake which were both awesome. Portions here are huge so I suggest skipping the complimentary bread.

author: Vicki L
review_text: I never have anything bad to say about this restaurant. Our favorites are herb crusted blackened salmon, Louisiana chicken with bow tie pasta and red velvet cheesecake. If you get lucky you will be served by students. They are smart and if you tell them how you like the salmon cooked the food always comes out exactly how you want it. The salmon we got this time is superb, the most delicious salmon I ever had. The sweet potato fries are really good too. We have a side order and we got a really big plate with 2 dipping sauces.  Of course I’ll keep returning. 5 stars

author: Kristie Ann Van Winkle
review_text: The Cheesecake Factory is a fairly reliable option for dining. As one person in our group said, the food is always good. The menu is amazing, extensive and there's something for everyone. My only complaint is it's loud. I've been to 3 different locations and it's the same for each one, loud. I think it's the design. This is fine for groups that are familiar with everyone else. It's challenging to have a conversation, which may or may not be a problem depending on your group dynamics. Our food was excellent. The service was good. I would certainly go there again. The cheesecake is next level. I would definitely want to try more of their cheesecake offerings.

author: ZJ
review_text: The food at this Cheesecake Factory location was delicious. My family and I came here for lunch, and they truly made it worthwhile. I ordered the steak, and it was incredibly flavorful and cooked perfectly. Highly recommend!

author: Kirtan Shah
review_text: Had a great meal at The Cheesecake Factory in Boston! The pasta was delicious, mac n cheese balls were super cheesy and crispy, and the s’mores cheesecake was the perfect sweet ending. Big portions and solid comfort food — definitely hits the spot!

author: Chris Cappola
review_text:
LOVE LOVE LOVE
Fav Place in the US. The Boston restaurant is such a feast for the eyes, beautiful inside. The food was amazing! The cakes are scrumptious and full of flavours - love the Fall range.
Our server Jairo deserves to be the Employee of the Month - he was absolutely attentive, proactive and very approachable.

Only feedback - we waited 30 minutes for a table. This despite at least 15 tables we saw visibly available.  We went to the bathrooms and could see so many available spots. The front desk hosts were so laid-back with no sense of urgency or care to have people seated.  This would deter us but after all it's the Cheesecake Factory!

author: Bogadi Prashanth
review_text: Dined at this restaurant yesterday as we attended a university event. Not so crowded around 5 pm. The menu is great, but the food quality isn’t great! Ordered Pasta Catbonara, with the pasta not fully done. Korean chicken with rice had rice undercooked but everything is served so hot!! Microwaved not sure. The original cake cake was pretty good. All in all a hit and miss at the place.

author: Dharven Panchal
review_text:
It's one of the best outlets of the cheesecake factory in Boston. The menu is elaborative with drinks and food options. The food quality is awesome. Fettuccine Alfredo, pasta, etc. Their cheesecakes are to die for.

We were all vegetarian people and still got decent options. Ample parking spaces were available.

author: Stacey McKenzie
review_text: As every other cheesecake factory, this was good. Food as always tastes great. Cheesecake cake was delicious. Drinks was ok. The service was great. This cheesecake factory is really big and on great downtown location. Paid parking cross the street

author: Abby Merritt-Evans
review_text: It was mid. My brother got a bistro burger, loved it, but it was cooked a little under. The carnitas my mom ordered were pretty gross. The corn still had bits of cob on it, the meat was gross, and the whole dish was cold. She also didn't get her order of rice. I had to send my chopped salad back because it was nasty. Swimming in dressing, the tomatoes tasted rotten, and the chicken was tough and basically inedible. The wait was long but understandable, I think they were understaffed. Minnie or Winnie I think was our waitresses name, and she was so so sweet. Super accommodating and understanding, too! Shes the only thing saving this review, so make sure to thank her!

author: Cheryl Valentina
review_text:
Who doesn’t love The Cheescake Factory! The prices are great and the quantity is humungous and its too hard for two people to even have a single dish! Go as a 3 people and you can still try maybe 3 dishes and top off with a dessert!

We had the Nachos and damn they tasted amazing!

Have to go back here!

author: Louisa Banuelos
review_text: The food was pretty good! The service was a bit non existent, but in their defense, it was super busy from the event going on, so I don't blame the server at all. Next time I'm getting cheesecake!

author: tim rasicci
review_text: Great service. Very busy. An area that seems to shut down early for some odd reason, the Factory fills the void!

author: Sangavi Eswaran
review_text: The Cheesecake Factory is an ideal spot for a dinner date, offering a diverse range of cuisines all in one place. It's a perfect haven for food lovers. The must-try item is their cheesecake, though the portions are ample for one person, the pricing is a bit on the higher side. Nevertheless, it's a fantastic place to indulge in a variety of flavors..

author: Shannon Dickinson
review_text: Huge portions of amazing food! And the cheesecake was fantastic!

author: Loyd Djirosse
review_text: My girlfriend and I came from very far to try this place. It took us an hour to get there just for the staff to tell us they were close? It was 10:15pm, they said they closed at 10pm on Saturday but everywhere online and even at the store it was written 11pm. I even took a picture of the sign saying “Open” but when we got in they instantly kicked us out. When I tried to have a conversation with staff to ask why they’re closing way ahead of time they just brushed me off like I didn’t take over an hour to come try this. Very disappointing. Whoever the owner is, you need to fix this or you need to update your time everywhere online, this is unacceptable. I never write reviews this is only my second time writing one and that should tell you how dissatisfied I was.

author: Derrick Liang
review_text: what an insanely large portion and so much variety in food in one plate. solid flavors too, I wouldn’t say the meat was incredible but it wasn’t distractingly dry or anything. It’s solid. it’s like a time machine to when things were 5$, i think 20$ is worth it when you get a bit of everything and they aren’t trying to pinch pennies on the size of a falafel or meat like cava

author: Jaime Mendez
review_text: Every time I come here, the food is amazing! The place is always clean, the music sets a great vibe, and the staff is super friendly. You can really taste the authentic flavor in every bite. Definitely one of my favorite spots highly recommend!

author: D S
review_text: Shawarma with beef is not what I expected, it looks more like shawarma, the meat is strange, as if pressed, in general the establishment is not bad but the name Boston Shawarma needs to be justified, this is not a real shawarma but a good parody. I will not come again, only once.

author: Zheng Xie
review_text: The Shawarma tastes great. But I don’t have any service. The sauce smells like peanut. The price is higher than I expected.

author: James Smith
review_text: Boston Shawarma is one of the best spots in town! The food is always fresh, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned. The chicken shawarma wrap is my favorite — juicy, tender, and full of authentic Middle Eastern flavor. The staff are super friendly and welcoming too!

author: Noyonika Parulekar
review_text: The staff is very sweet and friendly. Unfortunately, the shawarmas my friend and I got were bland and did not taste like shawarma meat. Similarly, the baklava was underwhelming — flavorless and lacking in pistachios and rose flavoring.

author: Ray K
review_text: Good tasting shawarma with amazing hummus! It’s a tiny rundown spot with just a few tables for dine-in, but the place was packed with students and locals on a weekday. The meal came with a nice portion size and packed with great flavors. Perfect spot for a quick bite too.

author: Omar Mabrouk
review_text: Chicken was super dry.  Family of 5 came on mothers day.  Service was quick. Free water bottles with each meal which was nice.  They do bribe you for good reviews in exchange for baklava.  Upon leaving saw a large Costco-like baklava box in their trash.. so it's store bought stuff.. staff was south American and they didn't seem happy to be there..

author: D. Smith
review_text: I was in the Northeastern University area visiting places I used to know when I lived here in the mid 90s when I ran across this spot. Im pretty sure this is the same spot I used to frequent back in the day, but of course the inside has been updated. I didn't really want anything too heavy to eat but decided to grab a lamb gyro wrap anyway. The lamb was very well prepared and the wrap was delicious. The taste of the meat and the sauce with the vegetables was amazing and I ended up eating the entire thing. I highly recommend this spot if you are in the area and have a taste for shawarma

author: Zachary Warmath
review_text:
Great value for money. I have never finished my plate ($17), and I always leave fulfilled. Also, free water with entrée is a great touch, and the honey walnut baklava is incredible.

I will keep coming back, even though it is near Northeastern.

author: Dirty Souf Yankee
review_text:
Excellent and quick service, but the food fell short.

The plate was not worth $20. Fries were lukewarm, some were cold. They had clearly been sitting out for awhile and we're not fresh.  The pita was thin and tough/chewy. It felt stale as well. The hummus was ok, good creamy texture but strong tahini flavor (not a fan). I wish it had a little bit of different flavor to it. Salad was ok, basic. Did not care for the garlic sauce, but their house spicy sauce was bomb! Falafel was pretty yummy. Rice was soft & tender. The chicken & lamb shawarma was tender, tasty and seasoned well. That was the best part of the plate.

I expected more given the high ratings and reviews here.  But it also appears they offer incentives for good reviews. *sigh* Id say the dinner plates are average, at best.

The cashier was sweet and lovely, though.

author: Huseyin Ertac
review_text: I've eaten here multiple times, and I have to say their shawarma tasted pretty good. They also give a free bottle of water when you buy a menu, which was great. However, it raised a huge suspicion in terms of hygiene when I saw rats walking around the last time I was there. I do not think I will be going back. They also give a free baklava for a 5-star review on Google Maps, therefore I don't believe they deserve this rating they have.

author: Laura Kyle
review_text: Delicious vegetarian falafal sandwich and fantastic service! I appreciated the free water bottle and the honey baklava was just perfect, not too sweet. I'll definitely be back for more!!

author: Carson Nguyen
review_text: The amount of good food that you can get for like $16 is insane. I got the Lamb Plate and it was able to feed me for two meals. And the hummus is incredible.

author: Jack Nedell
review_text: One of the best places to eat in this area. Their shawarma is fantastic, and their falafel too. Make sure you get a side of their homemade hot sauce if you like it spicy.

author: Aubrey
review_text: First time trying Boston Shawarma and I got the Chicken Shawarma plate and I was expecting the chicken to be flavorful but it wasn’t. Chicken was very dry, little burnt and had no taste. The rice didn’t have a taste either but it was good. Salad was fine, the orange sauce sorry I don’t know the name of it but it was very good and spicy. I wish I had that over the chicken to give it flavor but overall wasn’t satisfied with my meal and I felt like it was over priced too.

author: jay melo
review_text: Best Shawarma in Boston! Literally in their name also great verity of food and desserts to choose from. GOAT Combo is definitely my go to order. Amazing!

author: Aamer Mahmood
review_text: Boston Shawarma is an option for Halal food. We were a family of three and got the shawarma dinners which were about $18 each with free water. Portions were generous. Fries were cold. Salad was ok and the meat seemed hard. Seating was limited.

author: Anna
review_text:
I love this place. Right on campus and perfect when craving a chicken platter. Although sometimes my chicken comes a bit dry/stale but other than that can’t complain.
Every time I get a platter it lasts me 2 meals…portion size is worth it.

author: Julie Siddiqi
review_text: Delicious food along with wonderful Moroccan hospitality. My first time in Boston from the UK. I came to eat after Friday prayers and loved every minute of the experience. I ordered a kebab wrap then was given Harira to try. All of it delicious. I highly recommend this place in every way!

author: James Richardson
review_text:
From the moment we walked into Nachlo, we knew we were in for a special experience. This is, without a doubt, one of the best Middle Eastern restaurants I have ever had the pleasure of visiting. It's truly a hidden gem!

Every dish we tried was bursting with fresh, authentic flavors. The hummus was velvety smooth and perfectly seasoned, the falafel was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the kabobs were incredibly succulent—clearly marinated and grilled to perfection. I highly recommend trying their signature dish (whatever that may be, maybe a specific slow-cooked lamb or specialty rice dish), it was a culinary revelation. Portions are generous, and the quality of ingredients shines through in every aspect.

The atmosphere at Nachlo is wonderfully warm and inviting. The decor strikes a beautiful balance between traditional and elegant, making it perfect for a date night or a family gathering. The subtle background music and the comfortable seating added to the overall pleasant dining experience.

Our server was an absolute delight—attentive, knowledgeable about the menu, and genuinely friendly. They offered great suggestions and made us feel welcome and well-cared for throughout the entire meal. The service was prompt without ever feeling rushed.

If you are looking for an authentic taste of the Middle East, look no further than Nachlo. It's more than just a meal; it's a delightful experience. We can't wait to come back! Go, you won't be disappointed!

author: Sheila F
review_text:
I love the place!
The staffs are very friendly, full of smile. They are very accommodating for someone who is not familiar with the name of the dish.
The best part is the food, made fresh with halal ingredients and tasty seasoning!
It might be too spicy for some, but it is perfect for me.
The menu that I order always been packed with high protein from the meat or chicken and fiber from their salad.
The portion is so big, I can’t finish a meal by my self.

Totally recommended and will go back to try another menu.

author: Irzam Sarfraz
review_text: We had the philly cheesesteak, wings, chicken fingers and nachos here. Owners were very welcoming. Food was decent too. Overall, a good experience.

author: younes nabgouri
review_text: I tried today the Moroccan Lamb Tajine with caramlized sweet apricots. No Comment just an amazing delice . First authentic Moroccan place I visited in Boston

author: Catherine Mechael
review_text: Coming from an Egyptian, this is the BEST middle Eastern food I’ve had in a while. Try the chicken Shawarma wrap and the garlic sauce as well as tea to finish up the meal. very welcoming owner and very good customer service.

author: Nadim Ahmed
review_text: Truly the best authentic restaurant in the area, with a huge menu. The staff is incredibly nice and always a pleasure to interact with. I always go here for halal food whether Pakistani, Mexican, Moroccan, Persian, or American style. Their Pakistani chai is the best in the city without a doubt. Also, they have a dedicated prayer space available for anybody that needs it

author: MOURAD MOURAD
review_text:
I just loved that butter chicken so creamy and tasty.
The place is so clean from inside have a counter sitting and also family style tables

author: karthi m
review_text: biriyani is good becz it was different taste like nizam biriyani … goat curry was awesome .. mild spicy … feel little hot inside the shop…. staff are humble …. u have kulfi, sprite over there …. atmosphere is good

author: Saoud FS
review_text:
The people who run this place are wonderful and very courteous, the food's great and they've got a pretty wide variety of different cuisines on their menu.

Great place to drop by if you're a student!

author: Bernard Bulwer
review_text: Great variety and taste! The very best combos, so you won't be disappointed!

author: Riyadul Hoque
review_text: During my trip to Boston, I visited a Pakistani and Middle Eastern restaurant that instantly felt like home. The owner, who I believe was also running the place, was incredibly friendly and served us with genuine warmth and hospitality. We ordered classic Pakistani dishes, and the chef also Pakistani prepared them right in front of us, which made the experience even more special. The flavors were just like back home, and after five days of traveling, I finally got to enjoy a sip of proper desi-style chai and I absolutely loved it! This place is a gem for anyone craving authentic taste and heartfelt service.

author: Aliena Abidi
review_text:
Tried their Mango Lassi, Gulab Jamun and Chicken Biryani, very authentic and delicious.
Good hospitality, many good food options.
Definitely going to visit again.👍🏻

author: Gary Cooper
review_text: Highly recommend the curry goat, the staff is friendly and kind. We had the chicken shawarma wrap, falafel platter ,and the amazing curried goat all perfect. Please go , dine in and take it all in. Support this oustanding neighborhood spot.

author: Mark Merren
review_text: Ordered Chana Masala. The chickpeas were completely mushy, almost like a gravy. Didn’t seem fresh. As if it was old and reheated in the pan. I watched them reheat the rice in the microwave. And the Aloo Naan lacked flavor. It was late and was looking for a vegan option. Completely disappointed. I wasted $20. I couldn’t eat any of it all. Upside is the staff was very polite. Never going there  again though.

author: ahmad sadiq
review_text: I have been there just recently. The place is under new management. And they have changed their menu. They have amazing burgers and indian desserts. 👌 Must try

author: Ayman Siddiqui
review_text: Staff was extremely friendly and accommodating! Definitely the best service I have ever received from a small business like this one. The seekh kabob and raita were delicious. I would highly recommend to anyone seeking authentic Pakistani food and excellent service!

author: Adolfo E Estrada
review_text: Naan is great, hummus is awesomeness. Fried coliflower, everything is really good that I've tried. Staff is great and humble.

author: Marcus
review_text: Owner was a sweetheart and the hummus and grilled meat plate was to die for 😋

author: Niki Anand
review_text:
Takes like food from home, such kind people who make such such amazing
people. They provided my dad free chai and free water after we moved to the area.
If you want authentic food come here

author: p matzker
review_text:
We stopped in for lunch and the place was full. Only 5 minutes wait for a table for  four people. The waiter was attentive and brought us old fashioned milk jar for water. The water was room temperature. I would like if there is ice option for the water. It was nice to be seated right by the window with the cozy vibes.
The menu has breakfast and lunch options.

The place is small and is walkable to Massart Museum, Massart, Wentworth, MFA and Harvard Medical, Longwood Ave.

author: Marcus A
review_text:
Nov 11, 2025 7am, Came here for breakfast with my Mom. I got the dutch baby pancake
lemon ricotta, blueberry compote, fresh strawberries. My mother got it without the strawberry’s. She had corned beef hash, and I got 2 eggs over med with crispy bacon and cup of coffee. First off the Dutch pancake come in the skillet it was cooked in beautiful presentation! Also it was delicious OMG! Not to sweet but sweet enough, my bacon was crispy you get a lot of bacon (most places just give you 2 or 3 pieces, I got a plate) my eggs cooked as requested! My mother said her corn beef hash was delicious it was very good! Only mistake at restaurants was I ordered a fresh fruit bowl wanted to have before we got our breakfast, we where the first ones to arrive at restaurant this morning but the our server forgot about it, it’s to bad would have go a 5Star review. So I asked her to take off the bill. But other than that the food was GREAT! The place was cozy and had a great vibe about it. This is a local spot so I love supporting local businesses! You could see the kitchen area and the place was clean, table was clean we got a booth very comfortable and roomy! Also got a to go order after finishing my breakfast I ordered the sirloin mac & cheese plate this was the trifecta i had a bite after I came home while it was still hot, it was so so good! Mac elbows cooked and the cheesy Mac was delicious and the steak was plenty and great tasting! Will be back for lunch next time!

author: KakuBites
review_text:
Milkweed is a small American cafe offering an eclectic spread of dishes. Patrons frequent the establishment for onsite dining and takeout. Their service is friendly and attentive.

The warm interior is brightly lit in the morning sun with wooden floors, and wooden tables. There is a nice kitchen in the back with fresh loaves of bread stacked on each other.

The seasonal pumpkin spice latte topped with cream and a syrup drizzle was a favorite at our table.

The generous portion of oatmeal was covered with a healthy serving of toasted coconut and fresh strawberries and blueberries.

The vegetarian egg white scramble was tasty with kale, broccoli rabe, pesto, other veggies, and two slices of warm bread.

Overall, a pleasant breakfast establishment for a quiet morning alone or with a small group of family/friends.

author: Jovanna Carter
review_text: When visiting the boston area off of hunting avenue, you will find the most amazing Breakfast, Brunch and Lunch space. Food is handmade right in front of you, seating outside and inside they also were kind and make accommodations for large size parties. Great vibe in atmosphere.Definitely a welcome to the boston community.

author: Kevin Sarmiento
review_text: Food was really good and accommodating with options from American omelettes to Mexican breakfast burritos. Overall a fast service and savory dishes however the wait time especially during the brunch hour was long but not unbearable (30 minutes). Much recommended for those visiting Boston

author: Susan Myers
review_text: Two of us ordered Shashuka, and the dish felt like a warm very slightly spicy hug. The wait staff is kind and attentive.  I love the interior with the exposed brick and high ceilings.  I highly recommend eating breakfast here

author: Heaven
review_text: Great savory and sweet menu options. I ordered the steak scramble and it was an excellent portion size (I took home a doggy bag). Love the location in Mission Hill, it’s right across the street from a library and playground which made for a great start to my day when we were in Boston.

author: Rana
review_text:
The food was bomb! The service was good. Came on a Saturday around 1 and the restaurant was packed.
There's no reservation so it's first come first serve accept they weren't organized, we were waiting in line but they kept letting people that skipped the line first. We were sat at the counter table which didn't have enough room so make sure to ask for a table.
The food took a little long to come. And I was disappointed to find out that they cook everything in the same grill(bacon, ham, pancake, toast, French toast) since i'm a vegetarian. Other than that the food and lattes were amazing.

author: Winnie
review_text:
The food is so delicious!!!! And the lavender matcha is literally perfect.

I had the salmon cakes which weren’t too dry, the grits went so well with them, and the eggs with scallions made it perfectly breakfast-y!

If you want to go on the weekend, you’ll have to get there early to beat the rush, and even if you beat the rush it will still be packed.
The food is pretty expensive, but worth it in my opinion.

author: Aurora Wilks
review_text: Have been here a variety of times but got the Shakshuka for the first time(which is what they are known for locally) it has rich flavor and good portion, the challah toast is a great pairing. Also got the lucky charms coffee which was good but kind of underwhelming. The french toast is always a good order, also challah bread, good flavor and so soft. Finally, the scrambles are also nicely put together, good ingredient pairings but wish there was a custom scramble option. Overall good vibe, great service, cute interior, good local business to support.

author: Team DJLive
review_text: It was a smaller space but the food and service was good the server Alejandro was very nice they had the outside patio open as well and I had espresso martini so definitely different from the other location

author: Thavy Hout
review_text: Definitely a spot to visit if you’re in Mission Hill! Contemporary design! And delicious food! I had bacon and avocado scramble eggs - perfect brunch!

author: Salman Khan
review_text: I finally tried Milkweed after passing by it many times. The food was tasty and unique (the “veggie” gyro was an interesting twist to a breakfast sandwich). Service was quick and friendly. Limited seating relative to the demand, so expect to wait 20-60 minutes, especially on the weekend. Overall, though I’d visit again.

author: Pragadish Kalaivanan
review_text:
The host was very kind. Even thought it was fist come first serve, I had put my name down with my friend being late and he continuously checked in and got us seated as soon as he could.
The food was great. We got the morning madness which was  amazing, the portions were great with everything cooked well.
I was left trying to get all the butter off my plate.
The atmosphere was busy but cozy. A great brunch spot for any time.

author: Kristy Johnson
review_text:
Wow!  This is an EASY five star place, and I’d give it more if I could.  They have everything a cafe should have PLUS.  Not only is the menu extravagant and creative (everything form shakshouka to quesadillas to salmon), but they have strawberry chocolate chip muffins and matcha!!!!  The match tea was quality and the muffin had a decent amount of actual strawberries and chocolate chips (if you don’t want it sliced and buttered, let them know first.

There are candles.  There are fresh flowers.  The whole place is an elevated experience, and the service is fast and friendly.

Bonus:  the hours!!! Most cafes close by 6pm.  This place is open late!

author: Kayla Nygaard
review_text: The Nutella&Strawberry French toast was exactly what I was looking for - the perfect size to be able to finish in one sitting (for me, coming in on a very empty stomach). Their special Lavender Matcha Latte was so cute 😍 with a purple decoration on top and the Pomegranate Mimosa was the perfect way to top off my celebratory last meal working in the area. A little crowded but super cute; as a party of one I didn't have to wait at all. Staff was super friendly and food was delivered fast, but I never got a refill on my water (especially critical on a 100°F day).

author: Camila Restrepo
review_text: Milkweed its a go to if you are in the boston area. Everything I have tried from their menu has been delicious, flavorful and very generous portions. Their drinks, mainly the mango mojito and coconut margarita are sooo good. Service is also excellent. Love it here

author: Caleb Carter
review_text:
We found this very nice and enjoyable. The review by some other vegans was a turn off, but they delivered and the vegan in our family loved the food.

The restaurant is cute and has a patio which is nice. The interior is cool and gives a chic vibe.

The food was a good take on some southern classics and brought some good flavors. I wish they were more creative with their vegetables to give each meal a healthy rounding.

All in all, I would return.

author: Catherine Chan-Bhanushali
review_text: Lovely corner breakfast/brunch/lunch spot. I really like their steak and cheese scramble and their iced cappuccino is excellent.

author: Carolyn Sill
review_text: Food was excellent! French toast, sausage, corn muffin - all great. Plus a hot cocoa which was perfect!  Husband had the turkey BLTA which he loved.  It was a bit noisy and crowded but the food and service were great.

author: Clari M
review_text: This place is great! I get the carne Frita with arroz de morro y yuca con cebolla . (Pictured on my review)If you want chicken, the combo Dominicano is also amazing - you get a half roasted chicken with 2 sides - they have cho fan rice which is Chinese rice aswell. The relleno de yuca is so good too must try! There is no seating , you just grab your food to go. They definitely give you a good amount of food,which is why I love it there,they have small medium and large portion sizes .

author: S Jackson
review_text: My Grandmother's pigeon peas and rice was the best in the neighborhood. Alex came real close to being as good.  My chicken wasn't that fresh. But the Peas n rice is delicious! No dine in options

author: Mika Astono
review_text:
Really good Dominican food! No frills, uncomplicated yet heartwarming meals and a certain local local favorite

It’s a small shop with no dine in seating, but the portions were extremely generous and the Chicharrones were both tender and crispy. You can get a plate with different sides, or a sandwich(“chimi”)

author: Frank Fazzalari
review_text: This small in-and-out spot has a steady stream of regulars for a reason: it’s good, honest-to-goodness homemade food from the Dominican Republic. The tender and juicy rotisserie chicken is seasoned and cooked perfectly — they rest the whole birds and cut them to order, to go of course. Definitely recommend, as it’s a solid choice for takeaway! Saluti.

author: Alexandra Honor Arrivillaga
review_text: My husband and I have been coming here for years .  The food is delicious.  Authentic Hispanic cuisine.  No tables inside , it’s a takeout place only .  Parking is difficult but manageable.  The service is welcoming and friendly.

author: Justin Santos
review_text: Amazing food. Fast service. We did a catering order from them for my work and it's hott & fresh. Very busy location at it's peak but worth it.

author: JungoXL
review_text: Great Caribbean food and even Chinese-American style fried rice (Cho- Fan) with a Latino twist. Good people, good service, long lines most of the time but definitely worth the wait. No dining in, take out & delivery only.

author: K P
review_text: Food would have been perfect if not for the dryness... The Grilled chicken and arroz con gandules man.i could taste the greatness but it was shortlived. Smh should I ask for gravy or something next time?

author: Jennyfer Suero
review_text: Fresh food, great taste, amazing prices, I loved it! I want to go again and I live 40 min away. You need to try there chicken and tostones there natural drinks are amazing as well. Oh there chimis too was good omg everything was amazing just go and try it you won't regret it!

author: Jason McAfee
review_text: Food was great service was great. I had never been in a restaurant like this before. One of my first times in Boston. A lot of things with closed so I didn't choose this place initially but it was clutch. Empanadas were great The door they were made with flaky soft. Ingredients were good. Beef was a little dry the yuca balls were great. To see myself going back for some of their fried chicken as well. It was delicious. Not bad guys, thanks.

author: diana pierre
review_text: They gave me the wrong order and when I called them, they told me that I would have to come and pick up the right order when I explained I could not they hung up the phone. This place is incredibly unprofessional and they do not care about their customers.

author: Brendan Collins
review_text: Best food I’ve had in Boston. This place is one of my favorite restaurants in the city!

author: Jaycee Rodriguez
review_text: My husband always somehow suckers me into trying this place again after awful food & customer service experiences. This most recent one was no different. There is a lack of quality Dominican food in J.P. The chicken from here is WAYYYYY too salty and the rice was crunchy. Batatas were dry and had been clearly sitting for hours. Their prices are also OUTRAGEOUS! $2.75 + tax for a papa relleno smaller than my fist with almost no meat filling. I'd recommend traveling to Lawrence for decent Dominican cuisine.

author: Kevin Montoya
review_text: Great food, not a sit-down and est spot at all, but always ask for extra pickled onions

author: Christopher Vargas
review_text:
4-Star Review for Alex’s Chimis

Alex’s Chimis serves up some seriously delicious Spanish food, and the flavors never disappoint! Every dish is well-seasoned, cooked to perfection, and definitely hits the spot. If you’re craving authentic and tasty Spanish cuisine, this is a solid choice.

That being said, I do feel like the portions could be more generous, especially for the price. I’ve been to other Spanish restaurants where you get enough food to easily feed two to three people for the same price, whereas here, the portions are more single-serving. While the food is amazing, a little more value for the price would make it even better.

Overall, if you’re looking for great-tasting Spanish food, Alex’s Chimis is still worth checking out. Just keep in mind that the portions aren’t as big as some other spots. Definitely recommend for the flavor, though!

author: Mirlo Z
review_text: This place has outstanding food. Reasonably priced too. Will come back.

author: HAM cannon
review_text:
HIGHLY UPSET lmaooo like idk if the cook
Is new or if the cook is getting older but everything don’t taste the way it used to taste if you used to go here don’t expect the old goodness that came with it. Now it’s just tryna make money even the chicken sauce taste different or spoiled and I ordered on uber eats it came wrong so I went in to fix it and it’s still not what I’m used too. I’m disappointed.

author: Philip Zanghi
review_text: I have to say Alex Chimis has become my ultimate comfort food. Their carne frita with rice and Yuca with onions is otherworldly. This is a gem and an absolute 10/10.

author: D
review_text: Some of the best chicken you can get just make sure to ask for a sauce on top of your chicken .

author: Ron E Keyz
review_text: It's some of the best Dominican Food in Boston. Just don't be in a rush. Even if you call ahead it'll still take forever and a day to get your order. The only disappointing thing about the food is they don't make guisados but hey the good is great though

author: M. Carolina Ticona
review_text: The best Venezuelan empanada with ham and cheese I have had in Boston! Freshly served and a filling size.  The cachapa was also deliciy, moist and you can taste the corn! Was lucky to have it served with Queso De Mano and perníl (shredded pork). Also the best papelón I have had in a very long time. Reminded me of my childhood in Venezuela. The staff was attentive, friendly and patient with all my questions as it was my first visit. Can’t wait to return for breakfast for a cafecito and an empanada.

author: Ernesto Soto
review_text: Great variety of cachapas! Very easy to get if you drop off from Jackson Square station (T). The meat it's cooked to perfection and flavorful. Their portions are generous. Paellas seems to be very popular there was well. Staff is great, I will definitely come back again to keep trying other stuff on their menu!!!

author: Maria Guerrero
review_text: This place is amazing!!! The Staff and owners are always so sweet and super attentive. Great customer service. Their food is extremely good! Always fresh and great flavors. Their empanadas are always so tasty and filled so much with meat. Definitely worth every penny! Highly recommend this restaurant!

author: Omar Diego
review_text: WOW! What a treat this place is, the food is so good it transported me back home. Compliments to the Chef and Cooks. ¡Gracias estuvo delicioso!

author: Mead Baldwin
review_text:
I got the Domino Arepa grilled (bean and cheese) added avocado.

Super yummy. Not messy. I was very happy.

Definitely going to come back for lunch.

I’d recommend looking the menu before arrival because I don’t think they’ve printed it out yet.

author: Chico
review_text: I’m really sad they moved away from their old location in West Roxbury because it was so close to my house. Now I have to drive all the way to Jamaica Plains for this awesome food. I walked in for the first time today and I’m happy to see that they have more customers at this location. I’m happy for them. Good food, good prices. Nice, clean, and spacious restaurant. Eat in or take out.

author: Joseph Tella
review_text: This should be a 5-star review as these are truly the tastiest arepas in Boston (and make sure to try their side sauces!), but paired with some of the worst service.
