review_text: We’ve been here a bunch of times as they have great vegan sandwich options. The ‘steak bomb’ sandwich is one of the best vegan sandwiches you can get around Boston. The rest are hit or miss. Some of the baked good are underwhelming which is why I’m only giving a 4

author: Lexia Cicone
review_text:
We got a vegan wedding cake from Fiore's Bakery.

Pros: The cake was very affordable, looked beautiful, and tasted amazing. Even our non-vegan guests commented on how good it was! We also loved that they offered gluten-free cupcakes for our guests with dietary restrictions.

Cons: The ordering process was unfortunately quite disorganized. We received a call on the day of pickup asking what design we wanted, even though we had confirmed the details with an employee several months earlier. When we re-sent the design that had already been approved, the employee responded in a rude manner, and we felt the response was unnecessarily defensive. More particularly, the employee dismissed our concerns on the phone, continued to cut us off, and attempted to gaslight us into thinking that we caused the miscommunication (despite showing screenshots of our continual communication with our point of contact at the bakery about our design for over a year).

While the end result was wonderful, the experience leading up to it was stressful. I’d recommend Fiore’s for their delicious vegan cakes, but would be cautious about using them for weddings, and suggest confirming design details multiple times to avoid any last-minute confusion.

author: Rick Lu
review_text: Open early on Sunday morning...enjoyed blueberry scones and the raspberry filled crispy turnover.

author: Garrett R
review_text: This is one of my favorite lunch spots, especially as someone with a gluten allergy. They have lots of gluten-free options. I got the Christopher Robin on a gluten-free bagel and it was delicious. Sandwiches come with a small side of salad and breakfast potatoes which are both really good. I normally order ahead as it can be very busy in there. Seating can be limited because it is extremely popular and the inside is not huge so best to plan ahead. Would very much recommend.

author: Florencia Rojas-Miguez
review_text: The food used to be good. Now it’s inedible. I don’t know if they changed the baker and chef but this place isn’t as good as it used to be. We didn’t finish our food. Really disappointed that this place lost its quality.

author: Achyut Shrestha
review_text: Once I discovered this place, I stopped cooking at home! Best vegan sandwiches, great price, good people!

author: Steve Sharp
review_text:
Had a great breakfast sandwich with potatoes, salad and tasty coffee.
Staff were very friendly and helpful

Great deal for tasty food.

author: Buggie
review_text: Delicious food, not too expensive, good many for your buck. They also sell very pretty potted plants and the chairs are painted like flowers

author: Katherine Kisner (Kat)
review_text: Great food. I didn’t expect it to come with sides, but it was a pleasant surprise.

author: lara tang
review_text: They have the BIGGEST ice coffees lol! And I like the sandwiches on fresh bread. I like the avocado and the omelettes. Nice spot for breakfast!!!! I think the potatoes they come with are little weak like they’re never crispy but it’s free potato and not a bag of chips so that’s better. And I brought a cake to a house party and everyone loved it. So get the sandwiches they’re not a bad price.

author: A Dan
review_text: Love Fiore's. Each sandwhich comes with a nice lil side salad and some solid potatoes. My BF is a vegetarian and obsessed with the Vegan BLT. Meanwhile, I love their Christopher Robin, its a nice refreshing sandwhich. The folks are super friendly and its always such a child environment. Normally can get my order nice and quick. A true JP gem.

author: Alma Laraxadu
review_text: I’ve been getting delicious vegan cakes here for my son’s birthday the last few years. I always get the vanilla one and it NEVER disappoints. Probably one of the best cakes I ever tasted. definitely the best vegan cake I have ever come across. They also always have it ready on time. Thanks Fiore for making my kids birthday that much more special every year. Anytime I need cake this is where I will be heading. It’s so good I may not even wait for a special occasion haha :)

author: Vzar zack
review_text: Walked in and ignored for 10 minutes by someone walking back-and-forth with new items for the display case. Not even a hello, I’ll be with you in a minute. Forced to walk out when they disappeared to the back.

author: Kathy B.
review_text: Best breakfast sandwich in JP. Generous and delicious scrambled eggs, cheese, and sausage or bacon with tomato on your choice of bagel. Accompanying home fries are perfect along with lightly dressed greens.

author: Ben Aronson
review_text:
EDIT: I appreciate what they are doing with their “rice & beans” pop-up, increasing a star
Cute, homey neighborhood coffee shop with some thoughtful additions. The cakes look impressive, though I haven’t tried, and I think it’s super cool that they have various dinner pop-ups serving different parts of the community. I always appreciate a locally-owned coffee shop that opens their space for people to gather and this is the only one in the neighborhood. That being said, the coffee is only ok and the two or three pasties I’ve tried, including the scones, were seriously underwhelming. In the several times I’ve visited I have also not felt welcomed by the staff. I don’t need baristas to be singing hello but when I have other options, having a warm smile and an inviting feel makes a difference. Maybe the staff aren’t too happy there, idk, but my experience has turned me off from coming here.

author: Jann Elaine Eleodinmuo
review_text: I've tried this place a few times but sadly the coffee usually tastes burnt. The prices are reasonable. The atmosphere is cute; I love the plants. The guy who works there most of the time always seems like he doesn't need to be friendly and he's way too cool to serve anyone anyway, that it's annoying and inconvenient for him to have to do so. The bakery options- so many of them are vegan or gluten-free but if you're looking for normal stuff there aren't as many options, which is weird because traditionally a "bakery" sells things that INCLUDE flour and butter. But mostly the coffee having a bad aftertaste bothers me.

author: Mercedes Reid
review_text: So... I ordered a cake for a birthday dinner. I was rushed off of the phone by the person taking my order. I guess the store was busy??? Anyway, I asked for fresh fruit on my cake to which she told me it would be an extra charge, I said that it'd be fine and asked for strawberries. The cake had NO STRAWBERRIES AT ALL. So why did she charge me extra? Also, the cake was kind of dry. I felt so bad because it was a special birthday and the cake was the worst part of the experience. I normally order from here every year and this is my first complaint. I'm so disappointed. 😔

author: Rick Lu
review_text: Brunch after exploring Arnold Arboretum and opted for patio setting to accomodate fur company. Ordered arepas and totally enjoyed though a bit messy variety of veggie fillings from criollo arepa to rancho arepas...indoor seating nicely appointed. A bit of an issue with the sensor activated faucet and paper towel dispenser - moderately insensitive! But restroom clean and spacious.

author: Catherine M A Onyango
review_text:
I LOVE IT! I LOVE IT! I LOVE IT!

Have you ever craved something that’s not just good, but good for you? This is the place.

Juicy Greens is one of those rare spots where you feel like your body and your taste buds are getting everything they need. Every bite feels nourishing, fresh, and made with care. The flavors are vibrant, the ingredients are clean, and you can taste the intention behind the food.

As someone who cares deeply about health, balance, and joy in food this place hits all the marks.
The Golden Glow Smoothie is great!
#foodmadewithlove

author: Dinidu W
review_text: This restaurant is a health enthusiast's dream come true! Their dishes are both incredibly healthy and deliciously flavorful. The staff's friendliness and knowledge about the diverse, vegan-friendly menu add to the welcoming atmosphere. Although the portion sizes are on the smaller side, it suits those who prefer lighter meals. For anyone seeking tasty, nutritious food with great service, this is the perfect spot. Despite the smaller servings, the quality and taste more than make up for it. Highly recommended for a satisfying, health-focused dining experience!

author: Janet Rosetti
review_text: Great service, man behind the counter was the nicest, bilingual king, super friendly! he brought our drinks to the table and when my friend needed to use the bathroom it was occupied but the second it was vacated he called him by name and opened the bathroom for him. Music was great and the interior is adorable! I got a fruit smoothie and it was so refreshing, would definitely come back again

author: Bill E.
review_text: Great lunch break, 5 minute walk from Arnold Arboretum main gate.  Vegetarian, Vegan menu. Friendly helpful staff. Pleasant indoor, & outdoor seating with umbrellas.  3 of us had the Arepa Criollo, Power Caesar Salad, & Breakfast Burrito. Fresh, delicious, and filling.

author: Alyssa Sciannella
review_text: Vegan and gluten-free options. The Cesar salad was amazing! Staff were friendly and helpful with dietary restrictions. Food came out quickly and was delicious. There’s room to sit and eat inside and outside.

author: nidhi maniar
review_text: Great experience overall. Wholehearted food, always fresh, tasty and accurately made. I feel fulfilled and healthy. Every person I encounter in person or on phone makes me feel very welcome. Try their salad bowl and breakfast cookies are my Fav.

author: Karuna Integrated Wellness & Spa
review_text: I’ve been going to Juicy Greens for a few years and now that I am working in Jamaica Plain I go frequently and get a bunch of goodies for the work week. I LOVE their juices, I feel healthy and refreshed and having them on hand gives me a quick energy boost between clients. I LOVE absolutely everything I’ve tried, everything is fresh and yummy 🤤 THANK YOU JUICY GREENS!!

author: Cecile
review_text: So good!! I loved the atmosphere and the vibes, such a perfect cute place to stop by. The food was especially good, the avocado toast was amazing. The açaí bowl was delicious, the fruits were so fresh and good. Great place !!

author: Amanda Cahn
review_text: Came here for the first time today - great service, love the reggaeton, and the food was so good. Got the huevos rancheros arepa and juicy waffles. Drinks were also delicious - got the rosa dulce smoothie and hot chocolate. Will be coming back. Thanks so much!

author: Amalya Meg
review_text: The guys here all seem very nice and the food is good, but they kept me waiting at least 10 minutes after my to-go order was done because one guy didn’t tell the other, and they mixed up some things on the order. Don’t go if you need something quick.

author: Amena
review_text: I always order the immune boost shot and power jp smoothie. They both taste amazing and thoroughly blended! I always feel energized after. They are also extremely kind and helpful. Highly recommend this place and then a walk in the Pond near by!

author: Toyoko Orimoto
review_text: Beautiful protein smoothies! Also love their Pura Vida bowl. Cafe is cute, with indoor and outdoor seating.

author: Mariana Diaz
review_text: Zen Bowl with romaine lettuce and quinoa!!! I love coming here! Honestly, every time I leave, I truly feel nourished. Thank you Juicygreens for creating an environment where people can truly feed their body! <3

author: Israa Elgazzar
review_text: Tried the JP power smoothie and breakfast cookie! Smoothie was super yummy and filling. Breakfast cookie was alright but I would come back for more items off the menu. Cafe is really cute and welcoming.

author: blackjedi954
review_text:
**Review for JUICYGREENS**

I recently had an incredible experience at JUICYGREENS, and I can't recommend it enough! During my visit, I tried the croissant with egg, which was simply delightful—flaky, buttery, and perfectly cooked. I also sampled one of their bowls, and it was packed with fresh, high-quality ingredients that truly made it stand out. To top it off, I enjoyed a cup of their coffee, which complemented my meal beautifully.

What impressed me the most was the standard of excellence reflected in every aspect of the establishment. The ingredients were top-notch, and it was clear that great care goes into their food preparation. The friendly staff further enhanced the experience, making me feel welcome and appreciated.

If you're looking for a perfect breakfast spot in Boston, JUICYGREENS should be at the top of your list. I left feeling elated and satisfied, and I'm already planning to return tomorrow! Don't miss out on this gem—it's a must-visit for anyone in the area.

author: Celeste Oliva
review_text: It may have been that it was raining or a Sunday, but... waited 23 minutes for 2 breakfast burritos. That seems excessive given the areas numerous other spots that will turn an order over in about 10 minutes

author: Ben Aronson
review_text: This is a great option to have in the neighborhood. I appreciate the emphasis on healthy, quality ingredients and feel that the acai/cold bowls are above par. The arepas are pretty solid as well. The people were friendly and the inside seating is nicely decorated. Overall it's a nice place. I wish they were open a bit earlier, though, and i can be a bit difficult to tell when they are open from the outside.

author: Patrick Garner
review_text: I love the Zen bowl!!  I got it with the rice/quinoa and the massaged kale.  And I added mushrooms.  Wow!! I really appreciated the microgreens and roasted pumpkin seeds, too, what nice touches.  I wish we had this kind of fast casual vegan food in Florida 🌟🎋

author: Matt Luo
review_text: Fresh atmosphere that showcases the local culture of Jamaica Plain

author: Justin Snider
review_text:
Great local bar. Came on a Saturday to watch football and it wasnt super busy. Only had a few things on the menu but they were all good.

Would definitely come back.

author: Marie Gail Stratford
review_text: Perfect place to unwind at the end of a long day! I've recently moved into the neighborhood and was taking a walk after a long afternoon of virtual meetings. Stopped for a glass of wine and a nibble. The bartenders were both attentive and wonderful, making sure I had what I needed and felt welcome in the space. The food was good--especially the sweet potato fries. I will definitely be back!

author: Doron Bracha
review_text:
It's a nice down to earth neighborhood pub, conveniently located on a main street. Pretty good bar, decent food for a pub, at very reasonable prices. Comfortable seating, clean restrooms. We enjoyed a comedy show on a winter Saturday night.

Yet I can't rate it 5 stars due to a few things.  The interior decor is not as rich as in other pubs. They held our credit card thru the evening, which we never saw in other places. It made me uncomfortable thinking that they could take pictures of my card and use it as they wish. I understand they're afraid that people would run off without paying, but in this case they had all my info since I bought the comedy tickets online.

After the comedy show, we couldn't stay much longer for more food, drinks and conversation, because they played very loud music, so we left.

Good experience overall :-)

author: Jason Mackinnon
review_text: Had an incredible meal here! The burger was juicy, flavorful, and cooked just the way i ordered. Easily one of the best I’ve had in a long time. I also came in late when they were on "fried food only" but the owner made me a burger regardless.  What really made the experience even better was the service. Crystal was amazing—super friendly, attentive, and had multiple check ins with me. Top notch service.

author: Stefanie Nicolosi
review_text: Their Chicken fingers and fries do not disappoint. Karaoke is a fun time.  The drinks were lackluster but we didn't even arrive until after midnight.  Staff was likely just trying to control overdrinking. Reasonable prices and fun history.  All around good time.

author: Tom Duffy
review_text:
One of the best local pubs I’ve been to flying out of Logan stopped to visit. My niece came to Jeannie’s ordered some food but the grill was not on the owner. Hank said if you’ll be here a while, I’ll fire it up and cook for you. it doesn’t get any better, the food is fantastic as well as the selection of adult beverages
Can’t wait to stop back gotta try the chili.
Thanks Hank

author: Mich Bartolo
review_text:
Sep 2024:

For bar food, it was great. The fried ravioli was delicious and perfectly crispy. The fries were evenly cut and fresh, and the burgers were decent for a bar. The local drinks were a nice touch as well.

author: Kayla Nygaard
review_text: This place has a great vibe. The staff are so friendly and made sure to get me my food even when I changed seats. And the food (I got the warm pretzel app) was so good.  Definitely going to be back to try more!

author: D.
review_text: First time here and it was very nice. Everyone knew each other and the bartender. I found out that the menu that's on the website is about 3 or more years out of date. So they have a new menu at the bar to look at. Not a bad place to stop in to from time to time.

author: J H
review_text: I was an out of towner who needed a place to sit for a couple hours while I waited on a medical emergency to be resolved, and I didn't feel unwelcome here. This place had delicious fried pickles, cold beer, and by chance I stumbled in on Stand Up Comedy Night, so I had a few good laughs. Turned a crummy night into a good one, so thanks.

author: CKBates AKA Farm Grammy
review_text: Fun and surprising. Great stand up comedy in a small venue. Reasonable tasty food and Guinness well poured.

author: V P
review_text: I love coming here karaoke nights on Saturday, the Dj is good, drinks are good. Got Jell-O shots and drinks, yummy bar food. Cheaper than most places and a good time

author: Nuno Barbosa
review_text: Food was great. Bar tender was terrible! We were there for the open mic comedy night which is through RANDOM PICKS OUT OF RAFT BOX. As soon as the host noticed that we were a large group he asked for the name and just kept the card for the WHOLE NIGHT! Just so they could keep us around until the end of the night! That was a terrible experience! We could’ve definitely hung around after our friends set but the fact that they played us to stay just shows the type of people who run this business.

author: Artem Aleksanyan
review_text: I came for trivia, drinks and bar food. This bar would be perfectly fine except for the fact that they WILL NOT SERVE TAP WATER, instead offering plastic bottles of water for $1.50! Who does that?? I am shocked it is not against the law to serve food and alcohol without tap water for free but here we are. Apparently every other sit down restaurant, bar, and coffee shop I’ve ever been to in MA has been just doing it on good will. Shame these guys did not get the memo to be normal good guys. So disappointing.

author: travis stirewalt
review_text:
April 20th, 2024: It should be noted that this establishment does NOT serve WATER. I kid you not… They’ll only sell you bottled water at a premium.

This is the first time in 30 years I’ve patronized a bar that won’t give you a glass of water after ordering 50 dollars worth of food & alcohol.

I spoke to the owner (Hank) regarding the policy and he was incredibly rude & almost proud of it. He said it was “the way of the future”.

Well in the very near future (Monday morning) I’ll be reporting this to the city of Boston as I believe it’s unlawful to deny paying customers (or human beings in general) a simple glass of tap water. Pure greed, in such an inhumane fashion…

author: Jose Rodriguez
review_text: Awesome Pub and grill, the bartender was very attentive and the locals were very welcoming. A comedian by the name of Pierre made great conversation right off the back and welcome us in.

author: Molly Pratt
review_text: My friends of color call this "the racist place". On multiple occasions we have experienced microagressions directed towards us by multiple employees. If you are not white, be prepared to be treated rudely. Even though the food was good, we will but be going back.

author: Sumaiya Miah
review_text: racist and homophobic. joe told my friends from mexico "welcome to america" before they kicked us out. wish i could give negative stars. i will not be visiting again

author: Brian McCaffrey
review_text: Good pub food, a friendly and relaxed vibe, nice staff. Cozy neighborhood spot with live music, karaoke, and comedy nights.

author: Debra Doyle
review_text: The bartender was very rude! She had horrible customer service skills! I will not be going back there!

author: Rithvik
review_text:
I recently had a meal at Brassica, and overall, it was a great experience. The risotto was creamy and flavorful, and the pizza had a wonderfully thin crust, very much like a classic New York-style pizza. The rigatoni pasta was tasty, though not particularly standout, but still a solid choice. The fried rice was packed with flavor and really hit the spot.

The BK fried chicken (we ordered the larger portion) was incredibly tender and had just the right amount of sweetness served with a small portion of homemade mustard sauce on the side and lemon wedges, it was definitely a winner.

However, the real star of the show was the Brussels sprouts. They were absolutely fantastic, crispy, perfectly seasoned, and bursting with flavor. Definitely the dish that left the biggest impression, and I’ll be coming back just for those!

author: Steve Gonyaw
review_text: Loved the experience. The atmosphere, the food, the service…. All tops! Even on a packed Saturday night, my date and I never felt the pressure or stress of a busy night. Staff was warm and welcoming. Bartenders were fun and very fast with orders, they seem to love their jobs and that goes a long way for guests.

author: Ashley Farias
review_text:
The service was excellent. Staff was friendly, attentive and informative. I ordered the fried rice from their brunch menu and my sister ordered the melted butter pancakes. She loved the pancakes. While I enjoyed their unique touch to the fried rice and perfectly runny egg, I didn't love how much oil it was all swimming in. We also waited 45 min for our food.

Edit: I made I a typo and wrote "informal" but really I meant "informative"🤦‍♀️ Learning that they just expanded and were adjusting to the new space is great context for helping me understand the delay!

author: Hannagh Jacobsen
review_text: Amazing food! Have been here before but first time in the new space. The brunch is so good, get the fresh hot sauce or else you’ll regret it. The house hot sauce is especially important for the chicken and waffles. The service is great as it’s always been. The new space is much more comfortable but I wish the lighting were a little softer for those of us sitting at tables. 10/10 my favorite brunch restaurant in Boston.

author: Emma Reading
review_text: This was such a fun dining experience! It's a very eclectic array of foods with so many flavors to try. Our server, Josh, said the best way to describe the food they serve was "saucy" and that honestly is true. So many good sauces, with flavors from all over the world! We did The Ride, a fixed menu with 8 plates plus dessert. They were flexible with some dietary needs and our server was fun, knowledgeable, and had fantastic service. We loved trying so many different things and enjoyed some lovely cocktails alongside it all. Such a great spot to try new flavors and have a special date night!

author: Eagle Bound
review_text: We went for brunch and overall had a good time. We got the pretzel biscuit, brown butter pancakes, omelette, and breakfast fried rice. Everything looked great and the food did taste good, but towards the end of our meal we did start to feel it was a bit greasy and heavy. The vegetarian options were extensive, which I really appreciated. I would come back if I wanted to take some friends, but I think it’s slightly out of my budget to become a regular option.

author: Doron Bracha
review_text:
I'm sorry to write that our experience was mediocre and disappointing. We went there with another couple of friends for dinner on a Friday evening in mid August. The place was full of people, apparently having a good time. The staff was busy and diligent, kind and friendly.

The location is not so nice and the exteriors are somewhat rough, between a central bus station on a busy street with traffic and honking cars, and a parking lot of a funeral home, with big trash dumpsters.

We sat in the back yard tent, four people around a small table with small plates. We liked the concept of sharing various plates and dishes, but the portions were small and the food was very salty and greasy (gave me heartburn). The black cod was unpleasantly smelly (fishy), and the green salad was very bitter and salty. The only way to fill my tummy was to order some bread, which was served with way too much butter, really wasteful.

I saw a picture of fries in a review online and asked the waitress why it wasn't on the menu, she smiled and said it's a secret...  she also suggested the special of the day, but did not tell us the price, and that was not on the menu either. As a matter of principle and practicality, all items should be on the menu, and customers should know the prices before placing orders.

The prices are pretty high and they charge around 23% fee to cover gratuity for the waiters, kitchen and bar staff. We respect and support all those good people, but do not like to be charged such high fees. Either raise the prices and show them clearly on the menu, or take whatever tips people leave and split the money between all the employees. Customers should have the freedom to decide how much they want to tip, considering the quality of food and service they received.

We enjoyed spending a couple hours with our friends, but did not enjoy the food or sitting on the asphalt in the undecorated tent, with loud background noise. For us, it was not worth $40 per person (with no meat or seafood, with no dessert or coffee); there are much nicer places at that price level.

author: Candice Springer
review_text: Brassica has one of the best brunches in town. The cocktails are wonderful and the food is top-notch. I love their commitment to changing up the flavors just enough to keep you wanting more, but also keeping their tried and true gems on the menu (shout out to the chicken and waffles)! And, I always look forward to taking home one of their homeade doughnuts for later. They never miss!

author: Lillie Marshall
review_text: Awesome experience trying The Ride (their epic tasting menu) at their new larger location! Delicious, fun food, lovely staff, and great vibe. Incredible deal for how much food you get — I took home most of a pizza (never seen a whole pizza in a multi-course tasting menu!) and entire second dessert. Eating the leftovers the next day was wonderful, too! Highly recommend.

author: Sahra
review_text: Brassica is a truly unique restaurant and cafe. We went for brunch and were met with a warm quirky Brooklyn ambiance  with high hopes for the food. We started with two donuts to share- a  toasted maple donut and a Boston cream (can’t remember the specific names) but they were absolutely delicious and fresh. We also ordered the fried rice with fried chicken, which was packed with flavor Umami and spice-absolutely incredible. We also ordered the tamales which tasted truly authentic and the impossible burger. However, nothing compared to the hashbrowns, never have I tasted anything so deluxe and cheesy! We were all so satisfied and will come back again.🙏

author: Matt Sanda
review_text: Get the Detroit pizza. You can tell they have perfected the dough. It gives Tonino a run for their money! New location is spacious. Food is delicious. Cocktails are great. Cheaper than it seems on paper because gratuity is included in the prices.

author: Meaghan Kavanagh
review_text:
We had a good time at Brassica. The staff were great and organized. The food was good but some things like the brussel sprouts were mid for the price and very small portions with rice underneath (seemed like they were just trying to cut costs). Also the pizza was alittle burnt, beyond what I would have served. But I loved the housemade vermouths and would recommend if you are looking for a fancy meal out in Boston that has a friendly/local vibe.

Also definitely make a reso as it's a busy place.

author: Anastasia Ekman
review_text:
A small piece of pork belly that fits in a hand palm, topped with a marshmallow, no side whatsoever - $28.
An extremely thin and very simple tomato-mozzarella pizza, small - $30.
Cocktails - all around $20
It feels like a joke. Interior and stuff are nice.
But these prices are unacceptable. If at least we would see some craft in the presentation or something very special about the ingredients. They kept pushing us to order more plates. No thank you.
Editing after the restaurant’s response: I know what I ordered! The tomato-mozzarella pizza aka Detroit for $29.50. Saying that I’m unable to see the craft is an interesting assumption. I have lived and eaten in many culinary capitals of this world and I know what high-level craft looks like. Also, by saying this you are putting down some great local eats that serve fresh and yummy food for much less $.

author: James Douthit
review_text: Our group of 4 vegetarians went here and were utterly blown away by the taste. We got biscuits-and-tofu, veg sausage big mac, brunch fried rice, and tamale. Every piece of tofu had an impressively delicate but flavorful breading and the tofu inside was also brined and tasty by itself. This is some of the best food I’ve ever had in Boston out of over 50 restaurants I’ve been to, and it was all vegetarian. The gravy on the biscuits was a special highlight, it might be gross but we literally licked the plate clean.

author: Ellen B Cutler
review_text:
Saw Brassica recommended in the Boston Globe--among other restaurants--for a visit from the Michelin people. A foodie cousin was all in for a visit. We both took the T, she a couple of stops in JP, me, a bit more of a trek from East Boston. So getting there without a car is easy-peasy.

We had reservations although probably not required on a Wednesday at 5:30. Charming. Casual. A bit noisy.

Our server was prompt with drinks and explained the recommended approach: plates are small, so share. Foodie cousin and I opted for 3 plates: sole, flatbread margarita, salad. Weren't sure how much food it would be and it was plenty. Server started us on the fish and brought pizza and salad together. Perfect!

Not cheap but excellent value. A wonderful time was had all round. We'll be back.

author: Marek Michalak
review_text:
One of the best hidden gems on the Greater Boston culinary map!

Food:
Small tasting plates are the love language in this place and boy, they are wonderful! Most of them being Asian-fusion influenced. From the wonderful gochujang mackerel through one of the best brussell sprouts I've ever eaten to my absolute fave - the chive cakes with two types of curry sauce. WOW WOW WOW! One of the best dished I've had all year.
Their cocktails are also fun and inventive.

Service & Ambiance:
Our waiter was absolutely wonderful - warm, friendly and made us feel right at home.
I loved the interactions (though I usually find them awkward and forced) and it did feel like I was being welcomed into a spot owned by inclusive and quirky friends. It feels like a bar, a cafe and an upscale restaurant mixed together and I loved this low key vibe from the get-go.

If you don't go there, you are really missing out!

author: Laura DeYoung
review_text: Phenomenal meal tonight - thank you!!!  We went for “The Ride” - and enjoyed every dish.  Tons of flavors, and this was an incredible value to get to try “a bit of everything”, plus the creamiest Tiramisu ever.  The standouts for me were: Endive Salad, the Fish Collars, And the Pork Belly.  Yum yum yum!!  Thank you for s lovely evening, in a fun space.  Our servers were all incredibly friendly and good pacing.

author: Matthew Gall
review_text: Went for The Ride for 2...very enjoyable experience for a first visit.  9 courses (which included dessert) of shared plates.  Really enjoyed some unique flavor pairings.  Our server and rest of staff were great too.

author: N M
review_text: My family and I had dinner at Brassica last Sat. Would highly highly recommend this place for several reasons. (a) Eclectic, global menu (b) every dish, be it the rigatoni with chanterelle or the clams in a spicy sauce, the dishes were made to perfection and highly palate pleasing (c) warm and friendly service staff and finally (d) reasonably priced and no service charge. All charges and taxes are built into the prices on the menu. I so wish other restaurants would follow this practice.

author: Steven Weston
review_text:
Bittersweet

I don’t think the designer kept in mind what Brassica was before they moved. It used to be a hip, quirky spot with an artsy vibe. The new place has its own vibe, but it doesn’t feel like Brassica anymore, and it doesn’t feel like the same restaurant either.

Lighting is bright and a bit chaotic. The space reads as modern, with contractor-white walls, and bookshelves , office like floor. In the bar, you can see the sound system, lighting, and some odd shelves. The fake bar top and the blue floor tiles look like something you’d find in an maybe an office food court or something.. it can read like one of those coworker places or a franchised bar rather than a unique dining experience.

The food is still good, but it doesn’t feel as distinctive or exciting as It use to be.. portions seem a bit bigger too - which isn’t a good thing imo - the redesign lost the essence of what made Brassica special, leaning toward something more generic. I would have loved to have seen them leverage the older bones of the building and use warmer, more tactile finishes (tile, wood, stone) low lights, plants, brick to add character.

Quick fixes:
- Rework the lighting: dim down the general lighting, add a couple warm low vintage lamps, get your vibe back
- Hide or integrate visible tech: conceal the sound system and shelving behind the bar
- Curate the soundtrack: a more cohesive, hip vibe with music - turn it up a bit - supports conversation without overpowering it.

author: Val
review_text: Best no nonsense breakfast in town! French toast is great, service is friendly, & they accept credit card. A neighborhood institution for a reason, just wish it was open Sunday!

author: Jimmy Vee
review_text: I wanted authentic breakfast in the area and decided to give this place a try. I was impressed. And to see that this place has been around for quite some time, I'm glad I eventually had the experience. Food, service and atmosphere was wonderful. Great location, right across from Forest Hills T station. Free street parking as well. Their menu has many options to choose from. Staff was pleasant and catered to every request I had. If you live in or around Forest Hills, make sure to give this place a try. You won't be disappointed.

author: C
review_text:
This spot is a cherished favorite. Whenever I have the time it's a top choice for breakfast.  Service is unparalleled. Very clean and welcoming environment.

Its Saturday morning so theres about a 20 minute wait.  Reasonable.  I started off with a giant grilled blueberry muffin and medium coffee.  Deliciousness.

Ordered one egg full breakfast which included toast and hashbrowns with choice of meat.  Expertly prepared to order.

All I've got to say this is a solid choice with all the basic amenities available. I hope y'all never change.

author: Anthony De La Puente
review_text:
Nestled amidst the charming streets of Jamaica Plain, MA, lies the Forest Hill Diner, a haven of warmth and nostalgia that beckons travelers and locals alike. Here, every sip of coffee is an invitation to journey back to simpler times, evoking memories of cozy mornings and hearty conversations. Served in classic Styrofoam cups with traditional pull-up lids, the coffee speaks of timeless quality and care.

But the experience extends beyond the steaming brew. Forest Hill Diner’s pancakes are a symphony of flavors, each bite a delicate balance of fluffy texture, creamy butter, and sweet syrup. With every indulgent mouthful, diners are transported to a realm of pancake perfection, where every bite is a celebration of culinary craftsmanship.

Yet, it is not merely the food that sets this diner apart. It is the intangible warmth that permeates its atmosphere, the genuine hospitality of its staff that makes every visitor feel like family. From the moment one steps through the door, they are enveloped in smiles and kindness, welcomed into a sanctuary of comfort and camaraderie.

In essence, Forest Hill Diner transcends its role as a mere eatery; it is a sanctuary where the harmonious blend of good food, great coffee, and genuine hospitality creates an unforgettable dining experience, leaving a lasting impression on all who pass through its doors.

author: Darrell Maule (Dagga)
review_text:
Very nice and pleasant joint, workers are very friendly and food is pretty tasty.
Only real downside is the long wait for food depending on the amount of customers.
Overall would recommend....

author: Lauren Thompson
review_text: My roommates and I love this cozy spot. True family run place and it shows, from the fresh food to the amazing service every single visit. Our favorite breakfast spot!!!

author: Millie Stonerook
review_text: Went here for breakfast while on vacation. Great portion size and great price. Would highly recommend!

author: Andrew Bennett
review_text: This a classic old school diner, with eggs and French toast exactly the way I love them. Thank you!

author: Cory Schwab
review_text: Stopped in for a quick breakfast and really enjoyed it. Staff was friendly and food was delicious.

author: Danielle O'Garro
review_text: I'm 38. Tried them for the first time at 15 and still go to this day. Same staff, same food, same atmosphere and I love that they stayed true to themselves amongst all the change around them. The food is A+... and staff is friendly. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

author: Karma Fashion
review_text: I love forest hill diner breakfast and services I order every Saturday morning routine for pickup and the guy who takes the orders is always so friendly and patient with my difficult orders. And the food is good! Fresh and not greasy like some breakfast sandwiches at other places.

author: ihopetheyhaveicees
review_text: If you’re in the area and need breakfast this is the place to go. Haven’t gone there for anything else, but diner breakfasts are hard to beat especially since it doesn’t break the bank.

author: Ms. Teacher
review_text: Awesome breakfast spot right on the MBTA line across the street from Forest Hills T on Washington St you will find Forest hills diner. If you love diners, you will not be disappointed! They offer yummy diner eats and an actual diner menu in Boston- hard to find! Something for everyone on their menu!

author: T Keane
review_text: Nancy and Mary are sweethearts. Never had a bad meal. I always go there any chance I can get.

author: James Pappas
review_text: Nice people here and it's convenient. The food is a little slow sometimes and you go up to the counter to get your own food. But it seems like one of those places where everyone knows each other. They probably do. Decent prices for good food.

author: Damika
review_text: My first time eating here and the food along with the customer service was phenomenal!

author: Michele Redman
review_text: Really great onion rings, wonderful people serving delish food in neighborhood diner.

author: Kai Pierce
review_text: It's a little dinner with dinner food. You can't go too wrong. I'm not expecting Michelin star level service just a big plate of eggs and bacon and this place delivered.

author: Bill Sheehan
review_text: They don't have wait staff. You order when you come in. I am handicapped they brought me my food. They don't have a restroom. Food is great, large portions for the price and very good value. They are closed on Sunday

author: Kristina “Chicklassique” Mateo
review_text: The food is great . I love the Breakfast Sandwiches and Chocolate Chip Pancakes. The prices are $$$  probably because I usually order  Breakfast and  have it delivered so the prices I pay are higher then if I were to take-out or Dine-in I think.

author: Dave
review_text:
Walked by this place all the time and never thought to try Indian food in general. However, I came here soon after I tried Indian food for the first time a few months ago.

I was sort of thrown aback by how small the dining room is compared to other restaurants up and down that same street, which tend to go way deeper into the restaurant. Regardless of space, I was ready to enjoy the food!

I had to start off with a mango lassi, as is customary anytime I eat at an Indian establishment. It was really tasty, refreshing, and worth the price. I say this in appreciation of how the restaurant doesn't stuff the drink full of ice so you're getting a fraction of your actual beverage, it was ALL lassi.

I went with a classic, butter chicken. It was juicy and flavorful. The sauce was lovely to pour all over my rice. My wife ordered the goat curry and she was enamored. The goat was the least bit gamey and extremely tender.

I was excited that this place was so delicious however, I am kicking myself knowing I could have walked in plenty of times. I will continue to visit whenever I am craving lassi, naan, and hopefully a new favorite from their menu!

author: Chris Ayers
review_text: Solid Indian staples served by kind staffers. May be the best Indian food in JP?

author: Pelaiah Auset
review_text:
This is my favorite (go-to) Indian food restaurant in Boston! I have a very delicate palate & prefer authentic & real food- and the food gives authentic Indian!  I love that they have fish options , mainly why we chose this this spot -I had the Fish(haddock)  Masala, my partner had the Fish( haddock) mango, both were equally delicious 😋.
In a world of fast & fake food, this spot is👌🏽! The food is delicious, the service was lovely, the atmosphere is positive and there's on street parking ! I highly recommend - esp for vegan /vegetarians
🤍

author: Amory Emlon
review_text: We have been fans of Tikki for several years now. We've never been disappointed! The menu is diverse and delicious, and the kitchen always gets the spice level just right for us. The service is attentive, and the atmosphere is calm and friendly. Recently we tried the Tikki Masala app for take-out, and it was great, too. Thanks to Mr Sharma and his lovely staff!

author: Erin Elizabeth
review_text:
This was the hands-down worst restaurant meal of my life; the food was, quite literally, inedible.

The samosas came sitting in a puddle of about half a cup of cold, sloshing orange cooking oil.

The naan was burned black — to the extent where, when I opened the foil, all I could smell was burnt food.

The tikka masala sauce was the consistency of water, and — to top off the single worst meal I’ve ever ordered — they only sent about a teaspoon of each chutney; the little plastic containers were 3/4 empty.

Possibly the deplorable preparation had to do with the fact that I ordered it for delivery? I can't imagine that any restaurant would serve up half a cup of cold cooking oil, or burnt black naan, or teaspoon-sized servings of chutney, to people dining in person. Disgraceful.

author: Mary Lou Matteson
review_text: The food is delicious, there are vegetarian options, and you can choose mild, medium, or spicy.  It is perfect for our family where each person has preferences.

author: Mahsa
review_text: Liked the place, food was delicious and the owner is nice and accepts requests if you want to add or change part of the order that is written in the menu. Small place but cozy.

author: Steve.PM. “Spreadsheet Nerd” VBA
review_text: Tikki Masala was our first introduction to what proved to be a foodies paradise in the great city of Boston.  With family from Fall River, I thought that my nostalgia for New England was the root of my affection for this place. However, the approval from the rest of our ten group party affirmed that my affection was justified. Cannot recommend Tikki Masala high enough. The food was authentic Indian, the service exceptional and the atmosphere pure “whole in the wall”, “side of the road”,  “diamond in the rough” perfection. Will make a point to visit again when back in Boston.

author: MikaelaRoze Starr
review_text: Stopped in for a quick bite and was very surprised that it wasn’t busier. The food was amazing and the service was even better from Somdat. Will definitely visit again soon! 🤍

author: Murugan Namasivayam
review_text: We enjoyed the quality of the food and service. Veggie platter was very well made and crisp. My personal favorite was Veggie wrap that had chickpeas and tofu with the right amount and blend of spices.We also had biriyani, tandoori chicken and mango lassi which we enjoyed it.

author: Stephen Fallon
review_text:
I stopped in for take out after a long day of work on Saturday 3/22/25. I wanted to try something different from my normal order, the young woman working the tables suggested the Korma. Best thing I did today was take her recommendation, it was exactly what I was craving! Thank you for making my Saturday night!

I am sorry I did not get her name, but she was absolutely phenomenal!

author: Matthew Coronato
review_text: 10/10. Very accommodating with no rush. Came in from out of town with loads of bags and they had no issues. Quickly fed with very tasty food! All the meats were outstanding and tender.

author: Kurt Whittemore
review_text: I came here with my wife and had great Indian food and good service.

author: Megha Sheth
review_text:
Probably the only Indian food place that I'd rate at zero. The food was bland, it was apparent that no effort was made to look at the taste and spice level. The Dal Tadka had no Tadka and dal tasted uncooked. The rice that is served along looked re-heated than fresh made.

I'd recommend this place to No One.

author: Sara Perkins
review_text: Love it here! I never see that many people dining in but it’s actually a lovely place to sit down and grab something to eat. Large portions, amazing taste, good service. I also do pickup fairly often. Lots of vegan and vegetarian choices. 10/10 I hope they never close!

author: Courtney C
review_text: We ordered two curries and a daal. The dishes were really not tasty and extremely OILY. This is the worst Indian restaurant we've been to.

author: Tharen Mcgon
review_text: Excellent Indian flavors in a clean and comfortable setting. Absolutely loved it , would return !

author: joe Yaz
review_text: It was fantastic honestly. Really enjoyed the food very much. I don't normally eat indian food that often but it was absolutely perfect loved it. If you are in the area I'd definitely check this place out.

author: Atul Kumar
review_text: Really tasty authentic India food. We ordered dahi papdi and Mali kofta and it was delicious. The service by the girl at the counter was really great.

author: E L
review_text: We went in late on a quiet weekday evening. The restaurant is very cozy and clean, with good music playing. The food itself was also really good and the portion sizes were balanced -- most of us had just enough leftovers to bring home for a second meal. The owner and the server were both amiable and attentive. No complaints! It was lovely.

author: John Lumiib
review_text: Better than those chain restaurants out there. Really good and fresh food. Fast service as well. Plenty of choices including birria tacos and pupusas. They also have a wide variety of drinks, my favorite is their horchata. And they have desserts like tres leches, red velvet cake, and flan. They also have chilli mango slices. Staff is really helpful and answered all my questions.

author: Leigh Walter
review_text: Killer spot. Dropped in from out of town, asked for their recommendation and they set me up with California chicken bowl. 10/10 recommend. Great house hot sauce. Great flavors. Chipotle could NEVER. I was surprised how few people came in and out. Y’all are missing out!

author: Tete T
review_text: Very clean, swift taking the order, as well as preparing. Order was 100% correct nothing missing or wrong in the order. I have a picky eater or two and everyone really enjoyed their food, Nothing went to waste so definitely recommend. The photos I included is only half of what we ordered. We ordered a pretty good amount of items and still there are so many other dish options available including vegetarian.

author: Joao Garcia
review_text:
The guys that work there are ALWAYS on point, the food is so goooood, but the people behind the counter is what makes a place not just a recipe. Look at Mexican Food chains that do burritos, they have good recipes but the people behind the counter are not really good nor they know what they are doing and the end result is crap. At Achilito's in Foxborough its the opposite, the guys behind the counter make the whole place worth going to, they know what they are doing, they always pay attention to the details, the welcome me and my girlfriend with a smile, always with a smile great service and delicious food.

I highly recommend the Foxborough/Patriots Place location. 10/10

author: Miles Howard
review_text: Best burritos in JP, and I say that as a 10+ year resident. Delicious, generously portioned, and the range of toppings is fantastic. I’m lucky to live within easy walking distance!

author: Genie May
review_text:
Shrimp tacos are amazing!
Grilled shrimp burrito is yummy!
Big perfectly cooked shrimp!
The maduros are picked at optimal ripened!
The horchata is refreshing and gives off positive energy!
The tamarind juice makes you feel like you're on vacay!
Clean seating area!
First time here won't be my last!

author: Ford Mustang
review_text: Originally went to this place because of their allergen safety and vegan options. It appears they have since changed their menu and no longer accommodate any allergy. What used to be a place I loved going to has become a major disappointment.

author: Meaghan Kavanagh
review_text: Had a great burrito here with lots of good options to choose from. Super busy on a Friday evening so would not recommend trying to dine in but would definitely go back for takeout when I am in the area.

author: Ben Greenstar
review_text: good burritos, but they overcharge. $18.50 for one burrito, that's not right. they don't give enough meat, and then they charge you extra for every little thing or for a little extra meat. they charge you $1 for four little jalapeno slices, and anything else. Go to chillacates or Anna's instead.

author: Jordy Ramos
review_text: Great place and great food. It was kind of tight to sit down and it gets really loud and noisy. When there is more than five people in there. I would definitely come here again.

author: Kesina Gray-Graham
review_text: The vegan bowls are sooooo delicious! We drive from Roxbury just to get the bowls. They have gluten free and delicious impossible meat!

author: morgan hamilton
review_text: Really really good food, and decent prices for Boston! Food was fresh, delicious, and the service was excellent. Great spot for a quick lunch

author: Andy Gorman
review_text: Love this place! My daughter lived near here for several years. This was her favorite. The food and people are fantastic. The plantain burrito and bowl are the best!

author: Taya Fox
review_text: The food is amazing and the staff are very nice… 10/10 would recommend

author: M Castillo
review_text: Guys this place is worth going to everything is delicious and fresh

author: TheCrowYouKnow
review_text:
Authentic Mexican food right in the heart of Jamaica Plain. Cross the street from the Forest Hills T station to grab some tacos or a burrito, then enjoy some homemade flan and a pineapple Jarritos. Grab and go or stay in and eat at the counter. Either way, Achilitos can't be beat.

Plan ahead if you're driving there. Street parking is very limited. Or you could park at the Forest Hills T station then cross the street. Your best bet is to take the train to get there.

The prices are a little higher than I expected when I walked in the door, but the food is really delicious and everything seems to be authentic & homemade.

author: Jonny Glassman
review_text:
Achalito's is sorta like Chipotle if Chipotle was much, much better. You can build your burrito, bowl, tacos, or whatever as you move down the line choosing from a wider variety and fresher ingredients than what Chipotle offers, and you'll wind up paying about the same price. They also have a menu you can order off of if you don't want to build your own (I always order off the menu, they have tons of great options).

I've ordered from this place at least once a week for almost every week of the year. They never skimp on portions, the food is always the perfect temp, and it's made very quickly. I cannot recommend Achilito's highly enough.

author: Nikkia G
review_text: Stopped by today around 830ish to discover they were closed with a sign that said “CLOSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE!” with lights on and everything. So as you can imagine, I was just as shocked to see they were closed so early. It’s sad when neighborhoods staples like this come to an end. I was sure this place was gonna be one of those fast food places that was or sure would stick around for awhile longer. Hopefully this was just a short hiccup in the moment and looking forward to being able to have these random moments of pop in’s again.

author: Kai Malone
review_text: Love the JP spot. Haven't visited other locations, yet. Food always good. Good prices. Friendly and helpful staff. love the environment, just wish there was more room to sit and enjoy your food. The seating faces the street and is always clean. Perfect treat or meal at the end of a long day.

author: Sonja Metcalf
review_text: I was happy to find a place with vegan cheese and impossible vegan meat! I got the nachos and they were so good!

author: Skand Shekhar
review_text: We had the worst experience with veggie pizza and meat pizza. Ordered 2 pizzas that were completely soggy. We called the store and they completely refused to admit and give us credit without driving back and returning the pizza. Do yourself a favor and avoid ordering from here if you don’t want to spoil your party. AVOID!

author: Ash Bentley
review_text:
I’ve lived in the area for almost 8 years and this used to be one of my favorite spots. They had the best, freshest chicken tenders and crispy fries.
I’d crave them when they closed for vacation. Sadly, it seems like there’s new ownership and the quality has dropped significantly. The fries have changed, the tenders are now small and tough (almost like they’re cut in half), portions are smaller, and prices have gone up. To top it off, I found a short curly hair on my plate today. RIP to what used to be a great restaurant.

author: Gunar Allen
review_text: I’ve been going here since it was my big fat Greek pizza and despite management changing a handful of times it remains my favorite pizza place. The buff chicken calzone is superior and their pizza as well. They’re always so friendly too.

author: Tom Bresnahan
review_text: Great neighborhood place. Everything was delicious and prepared exactly to special requests. Pizza, salads and wings were just great. Strongest recommendation!

author: Justin Rice
review_text: Ordered delivery - they messed up the pizza. Not a big fan of it either way. Ordered a Peppers+Onion pizza, half meatball. Ended up with half cheese somehow. Arrived very quickly.

author: Emma
review_text: The staff are always really nice but it is clear their chicken tenders & fries are frozen. Pizza is ok.

author: Nelson Fuentes (GunnShootz)
review_text: Really good service, quick, friendly, professional. Also great food

author: Alexsis Gauthier
review_text: Friendly and respectful. Made sure we had everything we needed and some. Have some good deals for bigger groups. Chicken tenders were amazing. Real chicken not the fake rubbery chicken. Fries were good, tried all of them. Pizza was a hit with the kids (even the very picky ones!). If you’re looking for a place to hit quick or dine in, it’s here!

author: Shawde Soares
review_text: I ordered a steak and cheese and oh my gosh AMAZING. Steak seasoned nicely! Definitely worth the try

author: Venus Garay
review_text: They are professional and very friendly,their food is delicious!! Great service!!

author: J “Snag” Keith
review_text: I don’t know what they did, but while the pizza was always on the better end of serviceable and always great delivery, it’s become one of the best pizzas in town. We favor Greek style with airy crusts and bold flavor and they’ve been firing on all cylinders lately!

author: paola diaz
review_text: New owners are friendly, breakfast is one of the best, and more than all is the new hours.

author: Jay Suave
review_text: Great local pizza spot! Staff is always cordial and quick. Happy to support them wherever I can.

author: ivelise barrera
review_text: I love getting the cheesesteak subs from here! Highly recommended.

author: SHANK OnTheBeat (SHANK)
review_text: This place always hits right. Order anything on the menu, and you will be satisfied!

author: Nisla D
review_text: I ordered a greek salad with grilled chicken it was so delicious. Me and my fiancée loved it.

author: Peter “Tasp01”
review_text: Love thier grilled chicken salad, HUGE! makes me feel like I'm not on a diet😁😁

author: Kenneth Mallon
review_text: Get a wrap, calzone, or quesadilla, the sandwich bread and pizza crust are mid.

author: A Urena
review_text: The food is really good, price reasonable. Staff is friendly.

author: J. Palmer
review_text:
Palmer, thanks for choosing Round Two for dinner. Hope to see you again soon! 🍕
 …

author: Food & Footprints
review_text:
Wide variety of dominican food. They had everything from rotisserie chicken, beef, and meatballs to oxtail and goat.
We ordered mangú with salami, and white rice, green pigeons (guandules) and goat. On both plates we asked for a side of avocado.
Food was very well seasoned and cooked, we will be coming back.
Prices were fair ($12-13 for the mangú and $23 for the goat) side of avocado was $2.5 and juice was $5.

author: Christopher Benitez
review_text:
If you're craving the real taste of the Dominican Republic, drop everything and RUN—don't walk—to this incredible Dominican restaurant serving up some of the best mangú and authentic Dominican dishes in all of New England. Yes, you read that right. Delicious!

From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with warm smiles and an unmistakable aroma that hits you right in the soul—like abuela's kitchen on a Sunday morning. The place is spotless, cozy, and full of good vibes. Whether you’re grabbing breakfast or lunch, this spot NEVER misses.

Their mangú? Creamy, rich, perfectly seasoned and paired with the most mouthwatering onions, salami, eggs, and queso frito you've ever tasted. It's the kind of meal that makes you sit back, close your eyes, and say, “THIS is what life’s about.” And everything else on the menu? Equally 🔥.

The food is always fresh, the portions are generous, and the prices? Very reasonable

Customer service is great. The staff makes you feel like family from the second you walk in. It's no wonder regulars keep coming back, and new customers quickly become loyal fans.

This small business is easy to find and deserves all the love. So next time you're thinking about where to eat, skip the chain restaurants and do your taste buds a favor—go here ASAP.

⚠️ Don't sleep on this place. Your stomach will thank you. Your soul will too.

Dominican flavor. New England’s best. Support local. Eat unforgettable. GO NOW. 🇩🇴💥

author: Katie Manzo
review_text: Food is absolutely delicious. The Cubano sandwich, Pollo lunch plate (with the yellow rice & beans), and mofongo were incredible. The empanadas were very good (small but cheap). The tostones were thicker than I expected, but were still good. Staff was very patient (I speak little to no Spanish) - highly recommend this place.

author: Barbaro Moya
review_text: If you are looking for a good food, a lovely Staff and a friendly ambient. This is the place.

author: cleavroy T
review_text:
I was happy  that someone  understood  me but didn't  mind waiting for them to cook ,ask the price they show the bowl
But look at what they gave me for the price very turn off   .
There cooking look very good.

No quedé contento con lo que me dieron por el precio pregunto que talla pero mira

author: Alisha cruz
review_text: We were visiting from NYC and wow. I knew once I saw the menu that this place would be awesome. Authentic Dominican food. We had the mangu platter and the serving size was great. The taste? Amazing, everything balanced each other so well. I also recommend getting a fresh fruit juice. The chinelo was such a refreshing, sweet unique taste. I wish I had something like this back home! The staff was also very friendly.

author: Mary Carmona
review_text: The chicken was salty and the sweet plantain tasted old. She was nice but the food was a big no yesterday. So disappointed.

author: Abismael Diaz Melendez
review_text:
Outstanding service and absolutely great food.
¡Fenomenal!

author: ramon perez
review_text:
The food is decent but prices are very hi for a regular Dominican food Restaurant.
The breakdown on the prices when you add something extra is really tricky.

author: Winfield Chan
review_text:
The two times I've come, they have gotten my order wrong (regular plate instead of family size or queso instead of pollo pastelito).

At least the food is good. I recommend the picaderas and pollo guisado to share.

author: Laurent Dubois
review_text: We went in 15min before they closed and they were already cleaning up. When we asked whether they still serve food and what they recommended as we never had Dominican food, they took the time and explained all the dishes to us. We ended up getting a platter with different samples for takeout. It was amazing food at a very reasonable price. I'm a big eater and just came from a run, so I was very hungry: But the plate was so big, that I was more than full afterwards. So, we will definitely go back to try the other dishes they have. This might become my go-to-place!

author: James Knauer
review_text: Large selection of food, it tasted great, plenty of indoor seating.  Spanish/English menus

author: Stephan Papandrea (Skpapandrea)
review_text: The food is great and inexpensive, the staff is friendly, and the restaurant is kept very clean.

author: Lauren B
review_text: Had to order a bunch of tostones for a last minute cultural event at my sons school and     they were perfect, hot, crispy and packed well... everyone loved them and they were better then the ones I make myself😉 and way faster😂 Cant wait to go back and try the Mangu... everything looked so good😍

author: Norah Burch
review_text: My car broke down, so we ducked into this place for a quick bite to wait while the tow truck showed up. I had a Cubano sandwich. I have only had Cuban Cubanos, but this Dominican one was AMAZING. It was like you take all the good bits from a normal Cubano and make them better. I want another one. Right now. We also got some pastelitos which were likewise amazing! I can't wait to go back here!

author: Nadia Williams
review_text: Food was cooked very well, spices on point, good texture. My picky daughter loved it. Good Caribbean food. Options to eat in on glass plates is a plus

author: Cole Kehn
review_text: delicious local spot, I am obsessed with their pastinis!!!!!

author: Raisa Ceron
review_text: Was visiting Boston for the weekend and was craving a Dominican breakfast. Listen my mom is a great cook but I have never had Mangu this smooth. Everything was delicious, would definitely recommend and have again when in Boston.

author: Sheila Agosto
review_text: The stew chicken was too salty for my taste, only eat one piece out of the three on my plate. Also, the white rice had a burnt smell to it.

author: Angel Carta Blanca
review_text: Well to start this off on the right note. I dont think yall wanna eat from here. Some if not all of these meats sit for days on display.

author: Alexandra Honor Arrivillaga
review_text:
“ The food here is ok , not great “
We went here today to try this place . We got the pernil , arroz , and plátano .  The food was ok ( fills a hungry stomach ), but not great . The beef empanadas are good though. If we are ever in the area we will come back for those .   They have a big parking lot so parking is not an issue.  The staff is super friendly.  The vibe is warm and welcoming.

author: Isis Adams
review_text: Probably the worst tasting so-called Puerto Rican food I’ve ever tasted in my life. All the food was bland and had no flavor. Spent $70 and I expected the food to be way better than what it is. I definitely will not go back.

author: Mary Carmona
review_text: I'm late finding this place. Order a soup, bacalaito, stuffed sweet plantain, and cooked banana with pernil. All was good, employees were sweet and the place itself is so cute. Parking is a plus.

author: Maria Goines
review_text: I am a Puerto Rican person. I went here really expecting to find good Puerto Rican food. The food had no flavor. There’s a certain flavor. Puerto Rican foods have all the food basically taste the same. I got what they call little which is not the actually ribs. I don’t know where they come up with these different names. Their beans were watery no flavor. We had a dinner of the steak with onions. You can even taste the onions I’m sorry, but it was the worst Puerto Rican food I’ve ever tasted it.

author: Anthony Nygren
review_text: So glad I tried this place! Mango smoothie might be the best I've ever had. Alcapurria was hot and delicious.

author: Yianni Dimitriou
review_text: It was my first time getting authentic Puerto Rican food. My girlfriend and I got the fried chicken, with yellow rice, and fried plantains. The crust and seasoning on the chicken was oooooouuuuuweeeeee goooooood!!! They did not have flan today so I got the tres leches dessert instead and it was really good! The hot sauce was almost like a spicy vinaigrette — really enjoyed it with my rice. The service was excellent and food delectable. Thank you!

author: Michelle T
review_text: The food was terrible the service was terrible everything was cool we told him to heat it up it took them forever we ended up getting up and leaving

author: Jose Cora
review_text:
My parents are Puerto Ricans and their culinary skills are 😘👌

My dad's hobby is roasting pork on the weekends. My mom chefs up arroz con guandules, yuca, guineitos and morsillas.

When I go to Spanish Restaurants, I always check to see how they compare to that old school style way of cooking my parents have.

The lechonera 👍👍
The food is excellent!!!
I definitely recommend this restaurant!!!

author: Juan World
review_text: Went there food was good i ate the plantains with fried meat very tasty my sister gad the tamarind juice n she loved it the pasteles en oja were great but the young server with red hair was real off she was like a robot made us feel kinda unwanted she never smiled real dry

author: Gerardo Cruz
review_text:
Got alcapurrias for takeout. They didn't have enough so I got some fresh ones!

Good size and value for about $3

author: Lucille Rose
review_text:
Food is delicious!!!!!
Everyone is friendly
One long table, no decor on the table, or tablecloth on it. So it doesn't really feel inviting to sit and eat.
No music playing
So it feels more like a come order, take your food and go type of place.

author: Common Courtesy
review_text: La Lechonera is hands down one of the best spots for authentic Puerto Rican food! The pernil (roast pork) is perfectly seasoned and tender, and the arroz con gandules is full of flavor. Everything tastes homemade and cooked with love. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, and the service is always warm and friendly. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or sitting down with family, La Lechonera delivers every time. Highly recommend if you’re craving real, delicious Latin food!

author: PIRM
review_text: I purchase a pionono it had no flavor what so ever and they only add a tiny bit of meat very stingy the pasteles as well no meat no flavors and expensive.

author: Kora Blair
review_text: What can I say? The food is delectable and the service: exceptional! It taste like a bit of my childhood. I just love being in La Lechonera and enjoying the cuisine! I wish they offered seating. I’d love to sit down and have a proper Puerto Rican meal!

author: Heriberto Cardona
review_text: I come from Swampscott just for the food the best food Puerto Rico 🇵🇷

author: Manny Negron
review_text: It has been roughly 1 year since I ate here. Wow how the place has changed. Ownership is definitely different. Customer service is cold and borderline rude. Food is rushed and it shows. This was a great little mom and pop spot years ago. Not anymore. What a shame.

author: Monica King
review_text:
The food is great and the staff are so nice.
Very helpful helping me with my selections.

author: Margo Conley
review_text: Best Puerto Rican food in Boston. Been coming for years. Sometimes a bit salty but tastes like grandma made it with lots of love. Authentic flavor. Literally all dishes are flavorful and delicious. I love the soups, beans, arroz con candules, alcapurrias, pollo guisado, Pollo frito, tres leches etc.

author: REO
review_text: Even though the owner's aren't puerto rican anymore they kept the the tradition and menu the same as the original owner's...really good  authentic tasting Puerto Rican food!!!

author: Evelyn Mendivil
review_text: I enjoy this place, it is not overpriced and food tastes good. The staff is also welcoming and kind.

author: Arty
review_text:
I liked everything besides being rushed by the hostess by being asked to follow her multiple times, when i already was. Food is great. The hostess was nice too, it just doesn’t have to be a rush during a meal, praying, sex or bathroom time.
Everything and everyone was awesome. Free refills. Paid $21 per myself😂Gladly tipped. Everyone was full and happy.
P. S. Please consider mixing up your music playlist.
Thank you, FG & B.

author: Selva Murugan
review_text: Come with a heavy appetite and you will not be disappointed. Has a huge selection of Chinese food and includes hibachi grill and sushi. The desert is good too.

author: S.
review_text: So this is the best buffet on this side of town. Everything is pretty tasty well the dishes I choose 😋.  They have these little shrimps made with a bomb garlic sauce and they aren't over cooked not gummy but soft melts in your mouth. Rice both yellow and the brown one is my favorite with mushrooms in it not alot of them just enough for the flavor. When I ask to have something filled they don't give you no attitude they tell you how long the wait will be and bring it out in that time. Very pleasant ☺️. I do the take out plates so for 2 it cost like $30. Don't know how much buffet is but I think it's around the same price. Good eats to make the belly happy 😊

author: Cynthia Francis
review_text:
Don’t go to a buffet when you haven’t eaten all day!
I planned to take the food to go but when I realized how much food I had, it made sense to just pay the buffet price and sit down and eat!
The worst decision! I had three employees come to my table asking for my receipt! The last person was a rude teenager- braces wearing kid! Just as I was about to tell him to go get your father. My waitress came to the rescue and set him straight.

She gets a tip!!
Ruined my appetite!!!

My plastic glass was broken!

The food is not good and my tongue is coated with MSG! 🤮

author: Shivam Patel
review_text: Was looking forward to coming with my friends after looking at some of the reviews, especially the crab rangoons. Well, you get what you pay for. Stay away from the seafood later in the day. Everything else was ok, chicken dry/overcooked but edible. We accidentally paid extras for soda (which was fine) but we had to ask our server for water instead 3 times, she kept asking us what kind of soda. Not sure why that’s an issue, you’re getting extra money for nothing? Can tell the staff has an attitude problem, from the front desk to the waitress, maybe just a bad day? A couple of waitresses were talking amongst themselves near us and kept glancing at us, not sure if they had some issue with us? We were still polite regardless because we don’t have time to cause problems. What finally did it was seeing a mouse scurry from the buffet food area running towards behind the front desk from where we were seated. Was hoping to come back with my family, now you won’t see us again. Hope others have a better experience. Or just get a much better quality plate from anywhere else for $18. Reviews from other take out restaurants nearby say they have generous portions anyways. Will be going there in the future

author: Khadija
review_text:
It’s cheap. The food is decent. I wouldn’t get my hopes up going into this place.

If you’re big on volume but not big on eating a good meal, this place is for you.

If you have any allergies, run.

As a picky eater who also has allergies, I found this to be a pretty big disappointment. I wouldn’t come again.

author: Lilith Purpura'Regina
review_text:
We go here literally every week! It's the best buffet in the area! And the people are super friendly! Shout out to my boy at the front desk! The dude with the cool hair is always super nice!  And the food is usually really good! Like any buffets, they have off times. But I've never left regretting eating there! I definitely recommend to everyone!

P.s. gotta try their crab Rangoon! It's one of the best I ever had! They fill them so much! And you gotta get the Hibachi rice and put the drippings from the beef roast on it and a little soy sauce.... literally to die for!

author: J B MacDonald
review_text: The Chinese food part was fine, but the seafood and desserts weren’t eatable. A little Overpriced and they make you pay before so for the people that only have card, you can’t leave a tip for the server. Also I can find better food and prices at another buffet only 10 minutes from my house. This was almost an hour drive. Don’t come here, MID!

author: Khalida
review_text: Had a family dinner here. It was okay. Food options were plentiful but nothing was that good. I will not be returning. I felt a way about being asked to pay before we even sat down. It was a bit janky. Nice people.

author: Hank Goldman
review_text: This was our first visit to this newer location.  We were there between 2 and 3 on a Thursday.  The food was well stocked and hot. It was not as fresh as we have experienced at their other locations but I think that was to be expected because it was pretty slow while we were there. The one real disappointment was the server.  It was very slow yet we had to chase her down for refills and to clear a large pile of plates.  We love the Flaming Grill Buffets and will be back again.

author: Darryl Paraison
review_text: Some Food is good while others are bad, the crab lagoon, mac and cheese. Pizza taste horrible. The rice and chicken taste pretty good, the spaghetti is flavorful

author: Cor Mango
review_text: My family first time dining here. I've never seen so much food! Although I'm vegan their were plenty of vegetables, rice noodles, and fresh fruits. My family are not vegan reason for the none vegan photo's. The dining area was very clean. Waitress always cleaning the tables. My only issue was that they was sweeping around our table which cause to cough, sneeze and my mother constantly blowing her nose. Otherwise we enjoyed the food.

author: Lindsay L. Bigby
review_text: Place was pretty slow though it was peak lunch time. I had a hard time finding my plate for the first round because most things looked dried out or I recognizable. A few months back it was decent. Hoping it's a bad day vs a trend.

author: Gary Markosyan (LaserHere)
review_text:
This is the Place to go for everyone with kids who are "constantly hungry".
I do not know how they can meet ends with such low prices! Good selection of food to feed whole family.

author: Abner Bonilla
review_text: It is what it is. If you’re looking for cheap food and lots of it this is your place if you’re thinking you’re going to get filet mignon and lobster tails for the price your gravely mistaken based on that that’s what I judge it on the service is great and when you walk in, they usually are friendly, they clean up the tables right away. It is handicap accessible, and there is plenty of parking out front. For what the price of the food is the food is fine. It’s a really big area. Have fun and enjoy.

author: Jurassic world
review_text:
This place is a hard NO for me, and it’s all because of how horribly we were treated after our meal.

Paying upfront at a buffet is totally normal, and we did so without any issue. The meal itself was nothing to write home about average at best. But what absolutely ruined the experience was the behavior of our server, Jenny.

As we were leaving, Jenny confronted us and flat-out demanded a tip aggressively and in a tone that was completely out of line. This was after we had already paid and were getting ready to walk out. She literally dragged us to the front and wouldn’t let the issue go, making a scene as if we owed her something beyond what we had already paid. Tipping is a choice not something that should be shaken down from customers under pressure.

To make things worse, Jenny took the customer copy of our receipt, and forced us to sign for a tip. That receipt is supposed to be ours to keep for verification, tracking expenses, or just basic transparency. Without it, we have no idea what the exact final charge was or if anything extra was added. It felt sneaky, dishonest, and completely unprofessional.

There’s no excuse for this kind of behavior. It’s one thing to ask politely if we’d like to leave a tip. It’s another thing entirely to harass customers at the door and confiscate receipts like we’re being scammed. We left feeling uncomfortable, disrespected, and frankly disgusted.

Avoid this place unless you enjoy being bullied for more money after you’ve already paid. Jenny’s behavior was outrageous, and if this is how they train their staff, then management is just as bad.

Spend your money somewhere that values basic customer respect and knows how to operate a restaurant without resorting to intimidation tactics.

author: Daniel
