review_text: This place used to be amazing. Now it is just ok. Only got one refill. Plates stayed on table for a while. Hibachi person looked like he couldn't be bothered to put effort into making your food good.

author: Henry Paige
review_text:
1. the sushi looked dry. 2. The rice tasted like it was cooked with dog food - I tossed that out.
3 the vegetables were good and beef and broccoli was great

author: Danny
review_text:
Food is cold

PS: much cleaner and better food. Will come back more often. Just quick question: why collect people money beforehand?

author: Johnny Wyatt
review_text: Food was pretty good. No long line and service was impressive. I found it very unprofessional of the young man behind the counter constantly on his personal phone the entire time for the people in line ahead of me and through my entire check in. Needless to say he was still on his phone as I left

author: Indira
review_text: Went to D Coal Pot for the first time again in over a decade, and it’s just as good as I can remember. The owner saw us pull in and when we asked about parking told us to just causally park in the back (which I believe is made for employees). The atmosphere was decorated in flowers and herbs, along with some outdoor seating. We were greeted by the owner and had a great time ordering our food and getting to know the staff. We ordered doubles, bake and salfish, bake and shark, aloo pie… we also got some pepper sauce and chutney to go. Love this place, had a nice lunch listening to some Bollywood tunes. Took me back to Guyana 🇬🇾♥️🫶🏾

author: Uyen Tran
review_text: The food was delicious. We had the jerk chicken and the buss up shut. The owners/chefs were so kind and friendly. Definitely will be back!

author: Marcia Oppong
review_text:
Wow 🥹
The food is tasty and flavorful; not too salty, which I appreciate. Great value for the price as well, especially in today's inflated economy. More than anything, I am so grateful for the patient and generous service given to me and my family. I should have asked the woman's name, but God bless you so much and may God continue to prosper your business!
Oh, and outdoor seating - perfect for us; it happened to be a beautiful day! And sorrel was tasty as well.
Wish I were Keith Lee and could have tipped her a month's rent lol ❤️

author: Duraging
review_text: Food bussinnnnnnnn. Tasting exactly like home!!!. Very lovely family owned business and they are true Trinis super nice too! I know where my favorite spot up here is now🥹❤️❤️❤️. - Ariel and Kellan

author: Jai Ramkhelawan
review_text: Nice little spot, with some character from old days in T & T. Passing through from NY, decided to stop by and get some doubles. It was really Good! Also tried the currants roll, it was about best I had. Fresh food, friendly and courteous service. Met the Owner, a real gentleman, that made us very welcome and shared some insights on places we were visiting. I recommend this place and will certainly visit again if I am in town.

author: Jason Fisher
review_text: Norma and her Grandson, Taire, were PHENOMENAL and beyond kind. Food was STELLAR and I could tell they made it with their heart. Give them a stop for sure if you’re visiting St John and be sure to try their Salmon!

author: Sheryl Sutherland
review_text: So it was my first time going there and I really thought I was going to get a authentic Trinidadian experience. The servers weren't authentic Trinidadian people but they were Indians so obviously they know about Curry and roti but the food didn't have that Trinidadian taste was definitely a big know in the flavors of the food it was definitely missing that Trinidadian seasoning

author: Dezyre Akins
review_text: Food is missing FLAVOR. You see the curry but the food is missing some seasoning to make the curry come out. The roti itself is thick, hard, chewy and cold. Ali’s is definitely 1000% better.

author: Home Brewer
review_text:
The minute I entered their restaurant, Dev/Dave (pardon me) and Asif were very friendly. I told them it was my first time at the restaurant and asked what each of the dishes were.

Dave had such a warm demeanor and talked about all the dishes with passion. I asked him to tell me about the dishes but he gave me a bite of everything to try before buying.

Doubles - 5*
Dal - 5*
Potato curry - 5*
Polourie - 5*
Callaloo - 4*
Flaky roti - 4*
Stew & curry chicken - 3.5*

I bought doubles, potato curry, curry & stew chicken, Calalou, flaky roti & polourie.

Doubles was amazing, so was the potato curry.

Polourie is a fried dough ball topped with tamarind chutney, spicy sauce w/scorpion pepper(I think) and cucumber. That was great!

I'll be back to try some of their goat & fish dishes.

author: Ian Tallmadge
review_text: Cannot say enough good things about this place. Everyone working was super nice and made great recommendations. The food was absolutely out of this world good. New favorite spot in this area by far - don't miss it!!!

author: Sabina D'Silva
review_text: Came here today.  The food was not displayed in an appetizing way. They didn't have curry shrimp or aloo pie on a Saturday at 2 pm. Kind of unheard of for a trini roti shop. Prices were not displayed. Bought 3 doubles.  Definitely the worst doubles I ever had, as it had no flavor.  The channa was hard. $3 for one doubles was extremely pricey, especially considering the quality. I took a look at the chicken curry and it looked thin and watered down so I didn't bother to buy anything else.

author: Nambians
review_text:
Good Trini food, in a small setup. This is a takeout style restaurant.

Updated 4/24/2024

Food is worth the wait!

author: Randolph Vialva
review_text: Searching for some quality West Indian food  (roti or doubles), this is a great place to get your next meal. Service is pretty good, too.

author: Heath Kinzer
review_text:
Delicious food and amazing service!

•Excellent for vegetarians
•Large servings
•Charming patio with flowers
•Owner is a lovely person

Highly recommend!

author: Shraddha Khirwadkar
review_text: I recently visited D Coal Pot in Boston and had an amazing experience! The curry was absolutely delicious—full of flavor and perfectly spiced. The roti was the perfect complement, crispy and fluffy. The best part, though, was the friendly service; the staff made me feel right at home. I can't wait to come back for more!

author: mushy mintu
review_text: Best food I've had in YEARS, hospitality was wonderful, they gave us more food without asking and were extremely nice. 15/10

author: Alexander Jacobs
review_text: D Coal Pot is my favorite type of restaurant. It feels like walking into a family friend's house with the great food and cozy atmosphere. The staff are friendly, warm, and professional. I've tried most other Trinidadian spots in the city and D Coal Pot is by far the best - the roti and doubles are tops. Recommended to all my friends.

author: Jambago Williams
review_text: Outstanding customer service while  serving Delicious Caribbean food , and pastries . The currantt  and coconut rolls is to die for. As for the doubles, curry chicken, curry goat, stew chicken  and rotis are all incredibly delicious. Let’s just say I recommend everything on the menu.

author: John Gobin
review_text: Amazing food, all fresh cooked every single day, make sure to order ahead or else!!! Doubles, aloo pies, the shrimp curry, and their pepper sauce is sublime! The paratha roti is cooked fresh to order and the dhal puri is sooooooo good. Owners are such great people and make you feel like you're back home in the Caribbean. Also does catering orders, highly recommend!!!

author: RiRi Ung
review_text: Food full of flavor and soul. Not over powering but warming spices. Can't beat the deal for doubles. I love the goat curry and all the sides. Stir fried cabbage, mashed pumpkin, potatoes, chickpeas. My favorite place to eat in Hyde Park

author: harrymik100
review_text: This is one of my favorite places to eat. I come here for breakfast, but I will stop in from time to time for the fresh baked goods. The pan de bono, the empanada, the buñuello, are perfect. The coffee is great, and perfect with one of the baked goods, but even better with a hot breakfast. My favorite is the Calentado Paisa. Grilled sirloin steak, scrambled eggs with tomato and onion, rice and beans, served with arepa with cheese. The chicharron is the best I have ever had, also. If you have a big appetite or even for two people, the Super Bandeja. It is a little of everything, and a great way to find out how amazing it all is. I noticed the people don't only come here for the food either. The Chef/Owner, Miguel, will come out and greet guests, and they love him. His sister Erica takes care of the restaurant side and is so hospitable. She knows almost every guest by name. She will burst out singing from time to time, and if you are there to catch it, it's amazing. Definitely check this place out for amazing hospitality, service, and even better food.

author: Solomon Clarke
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Great experience at Delicias Colombianas! The food was delicious and Carolina gave excellent service — friendly, attentive, and fun to chat with. Looking forward to coming back!

author: Meriel Marmanillo
review_text:
Just had an amazing meal at Delicias Colombianas Restaurant! The food was absolutely fantastic – every dish was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Seriously, you have to try this local spot.

But what really made the experience special was the incredible service. Our server, Carolina, was so attentive and helpful. She clearly knew the menu inside and out and made some great recommendations. You could tell she really cares about her work and making sure everyone has a great time.

If you're looking for delicious food and top-notch service, this place is a must-visit. I highly recommend it and can't wait to go back!

author: Victor Price
review_text: Great place. Pleasant atmosphere. Excellent customer service. Food well cooked with acceptable portions and presentation.

author: David Bello
review_text: I recently dined at your restaurant and had a fantastic experience. The food and atmosphere were excellent, and the staff's warmth and friendliness added to the enjoyment. Special thanks to Carolina for ensuring everything was perfect. I highly recommend your restaurant to everyone. Keep up the great work!

author: Alex Cole
review_text: Delicious food options in a fun atmosphere with attentive staff. They also offer some items to cook at home, such as packs of arepa de choclo and quesito Colombiano. They make a delicious jugo de mora en leche that I almost always get as a treat when I pick up food.

author: Andy B
review_text:
If you’re searching for a dining experience that combines mouthwatering food with outstanding service, look no further than Delicias Colombianas in Hyde Park.

From the moment you step inside, you're enveloped by the inviting atmosphere that radiates warmth and authenticity. The decor reflects the vibrant culture of Colombia, and it sets the perfect backdrop for the culinary journey that awaits.!

Each dish is a masterpiece, bursting with flavors that transport you straight to the heart of Colombia. Whether it's the arepas, empanadas, or the traditional bandeja paisa, every bite delivers an explosion of taste and a comforting familiarity that keeps drawing me back for more.

But what truly sets Delicias Colombianas apart is the incredible service, and that’s where Caroline shines! Every time I visit, she greets me with a warm smile and genuine enthusiasm that instantly makes me feel welcome. Caroline's attentiveness and personal touch elevate the meal to a whole new level; she's never too far away when you need something but also knows the perfect moments to check in, allowing for both personal interaction and the space to enjoy your meal.

In short, Delicias Colombianas Hyde Park is a culinary gem, and with service like Caroline’s, it’s a destination I wholeheartedly recommend to anyone seeking authentic Colombian cuisine in a friendly and welcoming environment. Treat yourself to a meal here — you won't be disappointed!

author: Sharryn Gedeon
review_text: Great ambiance and staff is lovely. The owner Caroline definitely invests in their property and staff. Place is always clean and inviting. Food beautifully presented and love the music! I definitely will be back!

author: Daniel Glickman
review_text:
A surprisingly good place to eat where you would not expect it.

Best for Spanish speakers but they will do their best to accommodate and explain the dishes to you.

The food aims to punch above its weight and while it’s not quite upscale it’s definitely very tasty.

The staff is the highlight, very chatty and eager to provide a good time.

Enjoy!

author: Kiauna Washington
review_text: Attended on Mother’s Day. They were very friendly and accommodating, though we didn’t have a reservation. There was live music. A little confusion at times due to the language barrier, but I used google translate to assist. Overall things went smoothly. Would definitely eat here again. Highly recommend the modongo soup and truffle fries. Drinks were really good too…best mojitos since my trip to Puerto Rico. Plenty of off street parking in the rear.

author: Mahesh Balkarran
review_text: Their fruit juices are freshly made. The food is definitely homemade and fresh. It's one of the top columbian restaurants i been to. Delicious and friendly staff. Portions are huge and definitely would be a regular customer if i live here.

author: Catherine Flynn
review_text: Everything was delicious and portions were plentiful (so had.leftovers for lunch).  It was my birthday and they made it very festive!

author: C C
review_text: Colombia's food is amazing. I  recommend this place to anyone who wants to try some amazing Spanish food. It's excellent. the staff are very friendly and courteous

author: K O
review_text: Delicious food and generous portions. Service was so kind and attentive, the atmosphere was clean and very nice. If you're in the area I definitely recommend it!

author: Samuel Cintra
review_text: Carolina was our server and she was amazing!! Food and drinks were great and I loved celebrating my birthday with y’all!!

author: IamGloria Louis
review_text: I absolutely love coming here . I’ve been coming here for about 3 years and the service here is amazing . Carolina de Hyde park is such an amazing server ! Very welcoming and kind . You will not regret coming here .

author: Elmer Castillo
review_text: If I could give Delicias Colombianas six stars, I would. This place is a true gem and the perfect spot for any occasion. Carolina is an absolute star. She is always so friendly and attentive, and she remembers my favorite order even when it's been a while since I've visited. She makes every dining experience feel special and personal.

author: Joshua González
review_text: Wow, this place was incredible! I was just passing through and heard great things about it from a friend. The service was top-notch! We had two people with allergies, and the server was an absolute lifesaver. She knew exactly what ingredients were safe for us and made some amazing recommendations. The food, drinks, and ambiance were all 10/10!! Thanks for a fantastic night, Will definitely be back next time I’m in town!

author: samuel gerald
review_text: I ordered two Salmon Mariners. I asked her can she change the rice to picture number two with rice and vegetables she told me it would be an  extra charge. I said OK not a problem. The order ended up being $60.00 When I opened the package and seen I was overcharged for rice with Sazón seasoning I was very disappointed because I planned on spending a lot of money with them. Unfortunately, everyone’s looking for a fast buck.

author: Valerie Johnson
review_text: Prepare to be delighted by Delicias Colombianas! This hidden gem consistently delivers on all fronts. From the moment you step in, the service is truly exceptional – warm, attentive, and incredibly friendly. But the real star is the outstanding food; every bite is a delicious journey of authentic Colombian flavors. Pair that with the casual and inviting atmosphere, and you've got the recipe for a perfect meal. Don't miss out on this fantastic spot!

author: Adrian Bridglal
review_text: Service there sucks as staff would rather have conversations than serve people and get a line moving in for far too long. I have supported this business and every time I come there people walk out from behind the counter to go do something other than serve the customers while a line builds up. There’s usually one person, servant, and they will all look at you and leave you there to suffer like you’re begging for the food do better only one you have potential to be great I walked out of that restaurant today and told myself I will not come back and support a local business that can get things done right simple service etiquette they lack.

author: roxanne charles
review_text:
This is my 2nd review with the same issue different staff. I went there this past weekend after running errands. Out of all the many many Jamaican spots I enjoy them overall for the food. I come from Dorchester (in traffic) to receive the rudeness. The server was a man (again) very rude and lack hearing. He looked as if he was high. I asked for a large jerk chicken rice and peas. He proceeds to put white rice. I was trying to get his attention and clearly he is not hearing me. At that point I asked the female server to take my order. I still had to watch the customer behind deal with his ignorance. He had the nerve to go back and forth with her about her order.
To the owner: Customer service its the key to a successful business. If you choose to keep ignoring these complaints regarding the rude staff, your business will eventually suffer in the long run. This is insulting to our people who want to support black business. We have to do better and hold staff accountable for their unprofessional behaviors.

author: Dameain Mims
review_text: The food is excellent. I recommend the curry chicken or stew chicken but my favorite is the escovitch chicken it's a fried chicken in a hot pepper sauce with carrots and onions. I usually order the escovitch chicken with cabbage and yellow rice and veggies with the stew chicken gravy over the rice

author: swalrond
review_text:
Food is hit or miss but the attitude especially with the female staff is uncalled for. Not sure why so many Jamaican resturants tend to hire these disgruntled women. I've had decent experiences with the men there but a good majority of the female staff will make you go elsewhere and not spend a dime in there.

To the owner please explain why I can't be sold a small plate with just meat and no rice or cabbage? If I'm paying the same price and not asking for more meat than they would normally put on a plate that includes the sides, whats the problem? I'm asking for the same portion they would give if it was meat with sides but I don't want sides for dietary reasons but your female staff says they cannot sell it that way.
Are you losing money on the rice not sold if its not included in the plate? Make it make sense please.  You can only buy a medium oxtail but not a large or small. Makes no sense. Food is not consistent but I've always supported this place and gave it many chances but like many others I don't think I will continue to do so.

author: L Frederick
review_text: I ordered a medium jerk chicken. The portion of the rice and cabbage was suitable , however i was given 3 pieces of the chicken thigh back bone which is unacceptable. The taste of the food lack that Jamaican flavor. I called to give constructive criticism but they said they are to busy to speak with me why am leaving this feedback. Boston have a big Caribbean community step your game up only one! Don't be the only one!

author: Gabriela Contreras
review_text: I spent $18 with a soda included. The portion served is very generous which is always an extra ⭐ since it was my first time, I had to ask for my options, the person who was serving took the time to explained me and everything was nice and easy.

author: Joseph BROWN (Mr. Brown)
review_text: Me and my family was there tonight and yooooooo the customer service was stop on. I did not have tip money on me and i fault bad but since my son goes to school i will send the tip money with him. Thanking the crew

author: C
review_text:
After shopping we worked up an appetite and stopped in to sample the jerk and curried chicken offerings.

It's like the other Jamaican spots.  Food displayed cafeteria style.  The servers were more than generous with the portions.  My shopping buddy likes the fluffy rice and beans.  The curried chicken had good heat to it.  The jerk chicken succulent and flavorful.

I will try lunch next time.

author: Ta'Shana Brown
review_text: Today, I had a very bad experience with the servers/cashiers at Only One Jamaican Restaurant on Hyde Park avenue.   I was purchasing a soup and I asked if the boiled dumpling was made with cornmeal. The response given was, “I don’t know sir”. Instead of attempting to find out for me, she alongside another worker decided to make other comments as if I were to know what ingredients were used.  This is very bothersome as a paying customer.  The customer service was overall terrible.  At the end of it I left with regret and unable to properly enjoy my meal.

author: Physique Fitness
review_text: Very busy here but food was good beef pattie was good but idk what happen I think they forgot the cheese. Awesome got the oxtail and rice with cabbage. Wasn’t spicy which was good cuz I’m pregnant

author: Kevin Stallings
review_text: i’ve ordered here multiple times , i’ve only been disappointed , because i didn’t order more food ! i love everything they sell, the food is absolutely delicious ,the portions are enormous, the bag of food for the $60 i spent was easily 25 pounds or more , no kidding , the chicken soup is excellent & my daughter absolutely loves it , the sweet & spicy chicken is incredible , the Oxtail is amazing , all the vegetables are done perfectly , all of their Rice is done perfectly  , i have to buy 6 beef patties in order to get one , thats because my kids love them so much  , Honestly I can’t say enough about the taste ,freshness & generous amount of food at the price you get,  at Only one !

author: Olivia Walsh
review_text: I stop here at work every chance I get. I usually get jerk chicken but today I got curry. Both are delicious and you get a lot of food for a good price.

author: Charm
review_text: I was very disappointed by my oxtail lunch 11/7/23 the oxtail was full of fat more fat that meat. We all should know oxtail cannot be cooked that way, because you will have more grease than gravy. Everyone talks about how great the food is at Only One well lets be more consistent and on point or get a better cook. Very Disappointed...........

author: Elle Barnes
review_text: I went in to purchase a salmon plate with rice and peas and cabbage. I asked for jerk gravy  on my salmon while placing my order.  I notice while the server was closing my plate she did not add the jerk gravy, so I asked her could she pls add it. She responded with a nasty attitude “ I’m not opening the tray again it will be hard to close” so I said ok that’s fine, do you mind putting some in a small container. She does, when she comes back I said thank you. She rolled her eyes and sucked her teeth as she was walking away.  And I left that plate on the counter .  There is NO way I was paying for her attitude. It sucks even trying to support this business. You have to mentally prepare yourself to be miss treated . I’m all set ! They really need  learn customer service ! You can’t buy everything online - I will never support this business again 🤷🏽‍♀️

author: Andre Thomas
review_text: If the food was great, I would tolerate the poor customer service.  But since it’s not, they need a better staff there at least late night.  What happened to service with a smile, what happened to eye contact when talk to customers.  How about not being rude to someone helping you get a check? Do better late night staff on 10/24! Or I will find another place who wants my money!

author: c man
review_text: Out of all the ONLY ONES RESTURANT LOCATIONS … this one has a more fresher and cleaner feeling and look. I also find the food better especially the chicken soup. BUT THE COCO BREAD & CHEESE LEAVES A LOT TO BE DESIRED AND THERES NEVER NOT MUCH CHEESE. THE CHEESE ISNT MELTED AND IT JUST VERY VERY LITTLE AMOUNT OF CHEESE. IF THAT GETS FIXED theyre absolutely for me THE JAMAICAN RESTURANT IN BOSTON.

author: J Celtic617
review_text: I've been here multiple times over the past few years and I love this location.  I have personally never experienced any bad service. The food Is delicious  and portions are worth the money

author: Shaquanna Brown
review_text: Food is usually good -- pretty much what we'd expect of an average / slight above average Jamaican food takeout restaurant. For the dinner plate, I would prefer for the meat portions to be larger and the rice portion smaller.

author: Brendan Thomas
review_text:
EDit 1/6/2024: I updated my review to reflect a few changes I noticed since I first wrote this.

I was one of the first to eat from here when it opened five years ago in the former D'Angelo's location. They food is outstanding, the service is friendly and the space is VERY clean.

That's where the compliments stop unfortunately.

Three and a half years after the Pandemic closed the dining area, I was able to use the dining area myself. The staff person I spoke to said they reopened the dining area "a while ago" but I saw no proof or evidence of that--as in customers eating in--until I finally asked a few months ago.

It would help if they simply posted signs saying indoor dining is open again. I have no idea why they never did that much so people can know.The only possible explaination I can think of at this point is they got used to not having to bother cleaning those spaces several times a day. .

That aside, the prices on the entrees and even side items have been gradually increasing without notice. When they first opened in 2018, the Oxtail plate came in three size options (Small, Medium and Large). In the summer of 2019 they announced due to rising prices on oxtail meat, they were dropping their Small and Large options for the Oxtail and would sell the Medium at a higher price in a styrofoam container. It started at $18 and is now $24. About two years ago, they brought back the Small size that started at $11 and is now 14. I like their Oxtail but I'm not willing to pay $24 for a "Medium" Oxtail. I'm better off buying the meat and cooking it myself in that case (and you can buy raw Oxtail meat at some meat markets in the Boston area).

It's sad that Only One has decided to pass those rising costs onto their customers, most of whom they know live in the neighborhood--myself included. Other entrees have also had price increases in recent years. The pandemic sucked for everyone financially. People get you need to be profitable to stay in business and pay your employees but this is really pushing it.

One myth/rumor I've heard for a while that I can personally confirm is NOT true is some think the food is cooked at another location and brought there. This is NOT true. All food is cooked on site in the kitchen in the back. The food is SAFE, Sanitary and good. They also take custom requests on all orders within reason. For example if you want to mix and match certain items in the same plate, you can. Just ask.

On that last point, here's a tip you can use at not just Only One but any other West Indian restaurant that plates the food in front of you: If you want more, speak up. That's how you get more bang for your buck.

I always tell them to drown the rice with gravy no matter what I order for example. I don't like my rice dry but I know others only prefer enough sauce to cover the meat. One time the sever looked at me like I was crazy and I said "I'm paying for it and I'll eat it, keep going." My mother tells them not to skimp on the meat which they will if you let them. Why should you pay $14 for a Small Curry Goat with mostly bones for example? It's something to think about. When in doubt, see how others order their food and take cues from them.

I live in the neighborhood and walk there but the very limited parking is shared with the other businesses including the health center. If you don't mind walking a little, you can park in the Shaws Parking Lot. More so if you plan to eat in.

author: andrea Isaac
review_text:
45$ for two plates whole medium of oxtail was fatty got my food early morning so I was clearly the first order. Sad, I'd was gonna go my money back but I wasn't wasting my gas to
Go back across town! Not even given forks. NEVER AGAIN

author: H Woodson
review_text: Food was just alright. Everytime I visit Boston I look for black owned restaurants and the atmosphere was great but the Restaurant Pasta is waaaay too spicy for my liking and the Mac and cheese had no flavor. The calamari was very chewy. The oxtails were good but fatty. The water boy stayed on his job and I approached that. The manager did give us a round of drinks on the house though so that was nice of him. I would go back though just to support.

author: Cordero Emile
review_text: I went here last week and I had the time of my life over here. The interior of this place is beautiful combined with the food and service makes this one of the Best Black Restaurants and Restaurants period in Boston. The complimentary muffins they give you is so addictive, while the drink I ordered was a Red sangria tasted so right and the Rasta Pasta with chicken I ordered is one of the best I’ve eaten. I would definitely come here again. In addition to what I previously said, here are more photos of Park 54 and it’s food I ate at later visits and also when you stop by at Park 54 I want you to give praise to the Chef Khadijah who works there. She is the best Chef I ever met and that woman works too hard to not get the respect she deserves.

author: Ar Monsanto
review_text: The food is extremely delicious and not overpriced. The space is cozy and perfect for a date night or hanging out with friends. There’s a variety of ways you can experience oxtails. Say yes to the shrimp and grits!

author: O
review_text: Food, vibes, and service were immaculate. Drinks were good. We really loved the shrimp and grits and the fried chicken wings (not pictured). Service was truly above and beyond exceptional, so attentive and professional. Awesome music was playing. The bar looked fun too.

author: Tyre Kenney
review_text: I’m from Baton Rouge, Louisiana and live in Atlanta now so I know a thing or two about soul food. This place is topping any soul food spot in ATL and will give Louisiana restaurants a run. Shoutout to Juceila our waiter and Mai the cook who did his thing on the snapper (that didn’t make the pic cause we were already smashing). 12/10 recommend. Will be back.

author: barbara Mosley
review_text: First time there service was great, drinks were good. I ordered the Hennessey barbecue honey wings and the spicy calamari. Well the chicken was over cooked and didn't taste like Hennessey barbecue honey.  Calamari was cold. Didn't even wanna take the left overs. Beautiful establishment in need of a dance floor or at least have  karaoke night. They have a DJ but no dance floor. Big screen TV's that are awesome for watching the games!!!

author: Clifford Sorrell
review_text: I came here from Philly excited to try the shrimp, lobster, crab and grits. Unfortunately the grits weren't ready to my disappointment. I had the oxtail, rice beans and collars which were amazing. The white sangria was to refreshing. The chef came out later and apologized and gave me an order of the shrimp and grits to go which was appreciated. Great atmosphere and service I also seen Jason Tatum.

author: Ashley
review_text: Nice venue, drinks were very good. Street parking. Food was decent definitely would return.

author: Charlene Elizabeth Clark
review_text: Celebrated a Repass Here and It Was My First Experience and It Was Amazing, Can't Wait 2 Revisit and Be An Actual Customer.. Staff was So Amazing All Out Food Was Free and I Still Left a $30 Tip Chicken Wings  Were Bussin 9/10 Cannied Yams 8/10 Greens 💚 8.5/10  Can't Wait 2 Customize My Own Plate 2 Eat

author: MrsJ Brice
review_text: My first time at Park 54 on a Date night with my husband and I give everything 10/10. The food was delicious, portion sizes were on point. The cleanliness , the look and atmosphere all around was top tier.  The servers were very attentive and friendly. And I love to dance when I eat my food cause food is my happy place lol, and you can’t help but vibe to the dope mix of songs in the background. I think I danced through my whole meal. We will definitely be back again.

author: Chika Brown
review_text: Not crowded at the time of our visit. Food was subpar. Fried pork chops were good… lemon pepper wings were way too salty, loaded fries were mediocre, corn muffins and candy yams were good. .*Updated review… revisited with a friend and the hospitality provided by the owners was top notch! Thank you for the friendly convo and welcome you provided.

author: Gvel Cmajor
review_text:
If you haven't been, YOU NEED TO visit this gem in Hyde Park. Service is great,  food is amazing and the patrons seem like friends from the neighborhood decided to go eat at the same time. Lol. My wife and I went around 1230 for brunch on a Sunday. I'll be honest, for two brunch meals at 35 a pop,  2 mimosas a piece and 2 desserts to go,  the price was 200. 🤯 just don't get the mimosas. Lol but this is an absolute must!  You'll thank me later.

Oh,  yeah,  the DJ and music was so on point!  I just wish the volume was a tad lower. But all in all no complaints!

author: Nieca Baybez
review_text: I’ve been here 4x’s and each visit was a great time!! The food and drinks never disappoint with reasonable prices, not overpriced at all. A restaurant like that is hard to find- it’s usually hit or miss but not here and I love that. It’s a nice ambiance, atmosphere, & vibe. They definitely cater to the people, even down to the music. The music is not loud which allows you to still communicate with your guest. Love that! If you’re thinking about going, Go! I’ll definitely be going back.

author: Abri
review_text:
5/5 Food
5/5 Customer Service
5/5 Ambiance
4/5 Drinks (pricey downtown prices)

Amazing experience!!! It is fun, the music and live music is great!! The food is so delicious. I have been at least 4 times and everytime has been a blast. The servers are kind, friendly, and helpful.

This time we got corn and garlic parmesean wings and it's was busssinn (so damn good) the time before we have gotten lemon pepper wings and shrimp ceasar salad which is also very food. The catfish stripes are also very delicious. The cornbread appetizer is to die for, my absolutely favorite. The drinks are kinda of pricey but are very good. When crowded the food takes a long time but the servers sometimes bless you with a free drink if the food takes too long.

Highly recommend.  If you don't like loud music and loud talking don't go here.

author: Kristina Bates
review_text: The Restaurant was clean and well put together. The food was great & the blueberry lemon drop was excellent. Coming from a 20 year Server/Bartender our server wasn’t very attentive ☹️. We just felt like she disappeared a lot during our meal, and it was weird because the restaurant wasn’t crazy busy. But she was sweet! The guy pouring waters was extremely nice and sweet as well, The chef even stopped by to ask us how our meal was. Overall I’d return and hope the next time our server would be more attentive.

author: Melnea Cass (IYADONNA)
review_text: I love this place! Seriously, they can have all my money because I had an amazing time here. The food was amazing. I had the Rasta pasta, I also tried the Mac & cheese (I kept stealing my mother’s catfish strips tho. Those were truly top tier. Staff was very polite and inviting. I can’t wait to return!

author: Kat Olowu
review_text:
11/13/22 - 6:15p reservations
Arrived right before 6:10 and got seated right  away.  It was a busy night.  Although our server (Lindsey) was great, the kitchen was behind and our food took an hour to come out.  Service and food were GREAT but the timing to get the food was poor.  Despite the delays with the kitchen, I would give this restaurant another try as the food and service were great.  The server indicated that it's typically not backed up like it was tonight.

author: KATHERINE HANDY
review_text: I tried park 54 for the first time during dine out week, we were a group of 4. The food was great I had the fried snapper, I was surprised it was flour fried I'm use to skin fried snapper but it was still delicious. I will say the peach cobbler came out cold, the manger did apologize about that. The lemonade and cornbread are absolutely delicious. The hostess did come over and tell us she needs our table about 10 minutes after we paid despite the 5 tables around us being completely empty and upstairs was empty as well we were there around 430 pm on a Thursday.

author: Shena Diaz
review_text: Everything is great here and I mean everything but I am very pissed off that I just spent 88.28 in this store tonight and  got some candies yams that were ten dollars…. I was never in my big back mind thinking they were ever gunna turn around and give me the smallest container of yams going…clearly this is a big order for more than one person but the serving of these yams is for one person and yet they are charging folks ten dollars for it with my order being 88 dollars the least they could have done was throw in a free cup of yams I means why not I purchased two cups anyway if you ask me

author: NiMan Liu
review_text:
It was pretty busy, but once someone came over to help us an excellent dinner took place. Steak medium rare was cooked perfect. Red snapper had a fantastic crisp. Candied yam was to die for.

Edit: Red velvet cake and banana bread pudding was amazing. Too bad they ran out of peach cobbler, definitely coming back to try that.

author: Michael Johnson
review_text: Was doing some shopping and ended up stuck in the fuel tanker roll-over traffic jam for hours. Made the best of the situation by stopping in and grabbing dinner solo. There was a wait for a seat at the bar, but seats opened up quickly! Bar staff was quick to take drink orders and patient with dinner decisions. Tito's dirty martinis were perfect. Ordered the "Chicken Critters" with two sides; house salad and fries...salad first. The house salad (which I think might be called "Road House Salad" was a 10/10!... Fresh crisp lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and even egg slices that made it seem like a small chef salad. After the salad, there was room for only half of the chicken tenders and fries. The tenders were crispy and didn't need any dip/dressing but had a small side of ranch. The fries were great....right out of the fryer. Didn't ask if they were fresh or frozen. (Ask your server)

author: Jim Haynie
review_text: Cold day today on New Years Eve!   The wind was blowing through the windows!!   Someone needs to send them a case or two of caulking to caulk inside and out.  Freezing near any windows.

author: Bradley Nakaji
review_text:
The family was impressed with the steaks at Texas Roadhouse as the meat was prepared according to their indicated preference. Salads were crisp and fresh tasting. Potato sides are calorie bombs when ordered "loaded". The veggies can vary from fresh to canned (corn and green beans).

Service was excellent. Both server and management were a pleasure.

author: Mark Czako
review_text:
It’s always a pleasure to come here! I always get seated and served within a couple of minutes the waiters/waitresses are very kind (important to note that I sit down at the bar most of the time).

The only thing this specific Texas Roadhouse could improve on is the Steak Fries… Sometimes come out cold, but overall they could have a little more crunch. The sirloins are top quality, I never had to chew on some raw portion. Clean meat, properly grilled! Highly recommend this restaurant!

author: Aline Martinian
review_text: I ordered the 8 oz. Sirloin with rice and grilled shrimp. Second side was green beans. Steak was delicious but a bit overcooked. The green beans.... let's just say I would jot order again. Way too overcooked, soggy. Overall a good experience. Wait staff very nice. I changed my review to a lower star level because within 40 minutes after eating here, I got severe stomach and intestine pain and cramps and have been in the bathroom for the past 3 hours off and on. Horrible! Will never rat here again!!!

author: Aref Aasi
review_text: This place never disappoints you. This Texas road house branch has been our favorite place to gather with our friends. I love their bread & butter!

author: KC KC
review_text: Long wait on Friday night but no one seemed mind at all! Good food and good place to hang out and wait staff would come out to celebrate your birthday at your table, Texian style! very fun place to be

author: Ericka Henderson (BlackGal)
review_text: MacKenzie and Maddhie were amazing 👏Thanks ladies and working as a team "You Rock" 🏆 see yall soon 👋 I'm still eating the 🥩today! My son ❤️ his Togo order as well.

author: Patrice Martin
review_text: Our server Zay was fantastic. He was friendly and knowledgeable. I had the Dallas filet and it was cooked perfectly and delicious. Zay suggested mushrooms and onions and that was a great addition. The mashed potatoes are perfect. The broccoli was cooked perfectly and buttery. The bread is sweet and yeasty. The kitchen was slower than expected: on that day, we probably waited 30 minutes for the salad to come out and the food came out 10 minutes after that. It was busy, and I was visiting with friends, so I didn't mind it so much. Overall, this visit changed my perspective on Texas Roadhouse. I will consider visiting the one closer to my home in the near future.

author: Pilai W
review_text:
From the moment we walked through the doors, the ambiance of the steakhouse set the tone for a memorable evening. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with dim lighting, rustic wood accents, and the subtle aroma of grilled meat in the air — it felt both elegant and comfortable.

Our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely enthusiastic about the menu. He walked us through the different cuts of steak, cooking styles, and mocktails with patience and professionalism. We started with a salad and bread— both fresh and full of flavor. But the real highlight of the evening was the steak.

I ordered the ribeye, cooked medium rare, and it was absolute perfection. The crust on the outside was seared just right, locking in the juicy tenderness within. Every bite melted in my mouth. My partner had the filet mignon , and it was equally impressive — tender, rich, and perfectly seasoned. The sides — especially the garlic mashed potatoes and grilled pork chop — were the ideal complement to our meal.

What stood out most was the attention to detail. Everything from the bread service to the dinner was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. Even the mocktails list was extensive, with great recommendations that matched our meals perfectly.

The prices were fair for the quality and portion sizes. We left feeling full, satisfied, and already planning our next visit.

If you’re a steak lover or simply someone who appreciates a great dining experience, this steakhouse is a must-visit. From exceptional food and service to an inviting atmosphere, it’s truly a five-star experience from start to

author: diesse dasilva
review_text:
Great restaurant experience.
One of my favorite places to go with the family.
For starters they have the best dinner rolls by far, paired with the most delicious cinnamon sugar butter. Their complimentary peanuts are always on point. Their steaks are perfectly cooked whenever I get them, always  medium-rare and paired with ribs. Their salads have always been great. If you're getting a margarita go for the extra shot.

author: Cédric Hochsticher
review_text:
Friendly staff. Great Steak! I think this is the highlight of this restaurant. They have plenty of steak options, which is great.
It was my first time there, but I’ll come back!

author: S S
review_text: Juan was great he was my  waiter the  food was decent .The steak was overcooked some what hard to chew wanted medium rare but it is what it is …

author: Terry Singh
review_text:
We ordered takeout from this place. We always get the family meal. And they do a really good job. A lot of food for my family for we enjoy everything. The salads fresh, we usually get whatever. Is available usually use the chicken grilled chicken BBQ style or the chicken tenders? We haven't tried the other items yet. We're going to we're planning to they give a lot of bread-and-butter and their bread is to die for with the butter.
When I go to pick up the staff is great.I really like this location

author: Jacob Barbato
review_text: Busy and lively atmosphere, kitschy decor, and fresh cut steaks. Appetizers and entrees round out offerings, full bar available. Service is quick and friendly. Affordable prices for families.

author: Jessica Mao
review_text: Delicious food with generous portions, fast service, and a great overall atmosphere！

author: Victoria Figueroa
review_text: Biggins was our server today, and I must say that his attention to our preferences and his ability to anticipate everything we needed made him an outstanding asset to this location. Since it was Mother’s Day, he remained composed, detail-oriented, and truly enhanced our experience. I was out with my mom, uncle, and grandmother, and while we don't go out often (mostly just on holidays or special occasions) we felt welcomed and never rushed. Overall, it was a wonderful experience. Bravo! A genuine personality goes a long way in service, and Biggins exemplified this. Thank you all once again. We will definitely come back on our next outing!

author: Anders
review_text:
Beautiful restaurant, very friendly and helpful staff, hot delicious food and reasonable prices.

Classic American chain location serving it up hot and juicy. Not a lot to like here if you’re vegetarian or looking to broaden your food horizons. The main attraction is steaks, but they have beef, pork, chicken and salmon done several ways. I really enjoyed the table buns with whipped cinnamon butter.

Of particular note were the rattlesnake bites, jalapeño red pepper and jack cheese balls fried and served with ranch dressing. I had the half rack of ribs, which sadly was somewhat overcooked and parts were inedible, but was very tasty nonetheless.

author: Malena Mendez
review_text:
I had such a great experience tonight!
The place was full of life with a fun and welcoming atmosphere. The food was absolutely amazing everything was fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly.
Our server, Maddi, truly made the experience even better. She was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. Thank you, Maddi, for the wonderful service! I will definitely be coming back.

author: benjamin flores
review_text:
If I could give them less than 1,000,000, I would because they played with my son's feelings, who for over a week had been asking me to take him to dinner at this damn place.
I finally had the day off from work, and I'm taking my son and the rest of my family.
It was a day like today, a Monday at 6:30 pm. My wife arrived, checked in, and was told that in about 20 minutes there would be a table for us.
More than an hour passed and people kept arriving.
The place was getting crowded, but it was full of older people, and obviously they were letting us wait. 2 hours passed. I got desperate and spoke to the person who checked me in and asked what was going on, and he clearly told me that there was still no table for me because the place was very busy with older people who did drink, or had consumed alcohol. Then I realized that the problem was that my party was less conducive to them because no one drank alcohol, and the older people who arrived for 5 to 10 people, or more, did drink, and obviously they were going to consume more than us at the end of the night. I understand that that's the business, liquor, but I hate it. They made me waste more than 2 hours sitting there watching how they served the others just because I was accompanied. From my children and my wife, I think that for those of us who are parents, they understand that it is not a family place, but rather another bar only for those who drink alcohol. A very, very, very bad experience. I spoke to the person in charge and he told me to wait for 10 more minutes, and I replied, "Are you sure?" And smiling, he said no, because if someone else who drinks alcohol eats, we'll give them the table because selling alcohol is our priority, and food is something extra.
I feel very angry. Looking at my son, I said, "I think children aren't welcome here." I said, "He looks down and answers, 'Okay, Dad.'"
Honestly, I'm frustrated with this place. I know very few people will understand the frustration you'll experience, but I advise you, if you're looking to get drunk, you're in the perfect place.
But if you go with the family, you're not welcome.
I would tell them more about my bad experience, but I'm at Chillies Chelsea, where they served me right away.
Please don't go there. If you want to have a family afternoon, they only want drunks.
People who only want to drink alcohol.
Hurry up, do it yourself.
Don't go.
Don't go.
Don't go.

author: Mehrshad Zandigohar
review_text: This might be my new favorite place! The food tasted amazing and surprisingly affordable. Especially compared to other Brazilian ones that are disturbingly overpriced. All the staff were super friendly and chill. The variety of the proteins carbs and veggies made me excited. I couldn’t ask for a better steak buffet tbh. Very memorable night. Will 100% revisit and happy to provide the 5 stars.

author: Jane T.
review_text:
Pro: Food was great & the portion size was great for price. Meats were tender. A lot of side options at the buffet. Tres leche was decent. Great atmosphere, especially in the bar/karaoke room.
Con: The service was almost nonexistent for what appears to be a slow night. The only time the waitress came to check up on us was to pay the bill.

author: Kevin Choe
review_text:
First time at Brazilian Grill — and I’m in love! 🔥
Tried the Picanha for the first time — juicy, tender, and packed with flavor! 🥩
Even the salad was impressively fresh and crispy 🥗
If you’re into grilled meats, this place is a must-visit!

author: Julio Cesar Costa
review_text:
The extensive gourmet salad bar and hot side dishes were high-quality additions that beautifully complemented the main attraction.
This isn't just a meal; it's a vibrant, authentic, and delicious celebration of Brazilian cuisine. Five stars—we can't wait to return!

author: Wigor Lopes
review_text: We simply asked for the all-you-can-eat service (rodízio), but we don't eat meat. The meat server only passed our table twice in over an hour that we were there, and we still had to pay even without eating the rodízio. The food itself is wonderful, but the service left me quite disappointed. I hope you can resolve this issue. Also, the rule that the rodízio is only available for parties larger than 4 people isn't good: if I am dining alone, I cannot order it, which makes no sense

author: Jennifer Elveus
review_text: I visited Oliveira’s Steak Bar and Grill and honestly had a really good time. The tropical mojito was delicious — fruity, fresh, and not too strong. The buffet offered plenty of options, everything well-seasoned and tasty. The service was friendly and the place felt warm and welcoming. I’d definitely go back and recommend it to others.

author: Tyler Fritz
review_text: Always amazing food.  They recently had a comedy night for $40 that included the buffet and comedy show. It was a great time!

author: Aoxue Chenqi
review_text: It’s a place where you can order as much meat as you want at a reasonable price, and if you so desire, the sides are delicious too, so what more could you ask for?

author: Veronica Steele
review_text: My husband and I ordered frog legs, fish muqueca and the thinly sliced beef with onions.  We mistakenly ordered twice as many frog legs (asking for 6 legs total but receiving 6 pairs = 12). They were very good but be warned the chili infused oil served on the side is extremely spicy. The food was very good but such large portions we took the rest home and got 2 more dinners  for 2 out of it, so it was very good value! We also had a pitcher of sangria. Our server was very helpful with the menu as I have food allergies. Everything is cooked made to order so the cooks had no issues. Everything was very delicious and again we really got 6 meals out of it. Thanks for a great meal and family friendly atmosphere!

author: Wm Private
review_text: Great Brazilian food fresh hot tasty. The pricing is very competitive compared to other restaurants. You can either do pay by weight or Rodizio style we did the pay by weight

author: Adonis ElFakih
review_text: This branch of Oliveira is pretty lively, there is a dance place attached to it and people stream in and out to it. The predominant style of food here is to fill your plate from the salad bar which is amazing but the way, then stop by the meat station and order whatever you want. They weigh your plate and give you a receipt. When you finish you pay for the food you ordered. I found this system much better and cheaper than waiting for them to bring the food to you. The average plate was strong $20 as compared to the all you can eat for $39. Parking is super difficult even though there's a parking lot.

author: Sophia Seña
review_text:
First time here and probably our last. An uber driver recommended this spot to us so we wanted to try it out. Food was okay, some of the meats were underseasoned and overcooked. Highlight were definitely the picanha and the plantains.

Service was super weird though - our server wasn’t attentive to us but was super attentive to the table next to us. The manager would check in with that table and refill their waters but ignore ours even when she had a lot of water left and we trying to call their attention.

author: Joy M Gonzalez Guillen
review_text: Great selection of buffet and meats. We enjoyed our time. To Note: the unlimited food option is cheaper than I’m used to for adults which was great! However, they charge $18.99 for kids under 10 years of age. We have a 1 year old who loves to eat and would have had to pay this price (which didn’t make sense to us) so we opted to pay by the pound for him. Overall a great experience, great service, and amazing food.

author: Colombian Brat - Follow me
review_text:
Don’t think about, JUST GO!
If you're looking for a taste of Brazil, this restaurant is a must-visit! The sides are delicious, and the fresh-cut steak is simply mouthwatering. I highly recommend pairing your meal with a Guarana Soda or a Caipirinha for an authentic experience.
Steak:For any Brazilian, the picanha is the best. The buffet-style setup is unique—choose your favorites, and your plate is weighed to determine the price. It's a fantastic way to enjoy a variety of dishes without breaking the bank.

Ambiance:Perfect for friends and families, the environment is welcoming and impeccably clean.
You'll feel right at home.

author: Eric Hanscom
review_text: The place is fantastic. Everybody is so friendly and outgoing. You’ll never find a cold beer anywhere else?

author: Quianna Long
review_text:
Very, exciting to go to this location.

I enjoy the atmosphere & the food is always great and delicious. Yum !

They deliver too !

author: Giovanna Locatelli
review_text: The best fried fish and draft ever!! I felt like be in vacation on the beach. The service is perfect and friendly, specially Stephany and Alexandre! I will be back. Highly recommend

author: Nátalli Leotino
review_text:
I had an incredible dining experience at Oliveira’s! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting.  The service was outstanding – the staff was attentive and friendly, making sure every detail of our meal was perfect.

The star of the show, of course, was the meat. The variety of cuts offered on the traditional rodizio service was impressive, and each one was cooked to absolute perfection. The picanha was incredibly tender and flavorful, and the garlic steak was a standout. The meat was seasoned just right, and the constant flow of fresh cuts kept us coming back for more.

The salad bar was also a pleasant surprise, offering a wide selection of fresh vegetables, cheeses, and traditional Brazilian sides like feijoada and pão de queijo. The caipirinhas were the perfect complement to the meal, and we couldn't resist ordering dessert – the passion fruit mousse was light and refreshing.

Overall, this is hands down one of the best Brazilian steakhouses I've visited. The food, service, and ambiance all exceeded expectations, and I will definitely be returning soon! Highly recommend to anyone who loves great meat and a truly authentic experience.

author: Señor O.
review_text: Expensive, dirty, and too noisy. I say expensive because the lack of cleanliness and the noise made it a rather unpleasant dining experience. It was rather uncomfortable, as were the chairs, which were cracked and somewhat broken.

author: Nevin Simon
review_text:
Got Oliveira's yesterday for lunch and I think I made a great choice!

The door dash special was what I ordered, which includes Medium Rare and Garlic Beef Steaks, Chicken Wrapped in Bacon, and Spicy Sausage with some vegetables.

Garlic Beef Steak stood out the best, really well marinated! The garlic butter really gave the steak a great flavor!

Wished the spicy sausage had some more spice to it and the chicken wrapped in bacon didn't have much of a bacon flavor to it, but both were still delicious as were the choices of steak.

If you want good food, especially for a great price, I would highly recommend Oliveira's. I would order again or go to the restaurant when I get the chance. It's worth it!

author: Thayara Dalfior
review_text: I ordered 2 xtudos and a cheese pastel and the main ingredient was oil. The pastel was honestly unbelievable it was so bad I didn’t let my daughter eat it. Waist of money horrible food.

author: Lígia Xavier
review_text:
I give up eating pastel here in the US ages ago. Lots of good Brazilian food here, but pastel is something that people just cant get it right.  Usually the dough is all wrong and is poorly fried.
Today my husband convince me trying this place, since they call themselves "Pastelaria" and is not something general like dinner or restaurant. And they have a lot pastel options, so we're hopeful that it might not be good like it is in Brazil, but wouldn't be bad. And it was terrible! I'm so sorry. But it was awful. I never take food back to the kitchen, I think thats so disrespectful, but today I almost did that. But we end up staying quiet and trying to eat the piece that we're not so damaged by oil. Pastel is a deep fried food, so of course is oily. But our was insane! So much oil!

author: Francisco Mercedes (x_franco5)
review_text: Great service, amazing food, I love doing take outs they have great Açaí smoothies & Omelette, always love going for the morning to get my day started on a full stomach

author: Laurence Jackson
review_text: Their sweet bread (pao dulce?) has a soak that is AMAZING! Next level! The pao de queixo is as good as any in this beautiful Brazilian-American neighborhood. My wife had the acai bowl and a chicken-filled bread that were both wonderful. And such friendly service! Even we, who don't speak Portuguese and ask way too many questions, were made to feel welcome. We will be back for pasteles!

author: Andrezza Oliver
review_text: Sorryy, i forgot to take the photos before eating 😅 the food is just AMAZING! I feel just like in Brazil. The ACAI is the best in Everett! The Pastel?? Fresh to order. Just thank youuu ❤️❤️❤️

author: Luping Robyn Xu
review_text:
My favorite place in Everett
Burger is huge! I like their special beef patties too

author: A V
review_text: I often buy my breakfast. The sandwiches are always fresh. I always see the people who work there very quickly.

author: Myeta Petruccelli
review_text: Service is horrendous. The ladies that work in the front do not know how to answer a phone and have no sense of urgency. Don’t waste your time coming here.

author: Eliezer DeOliveira
review_text: Great Brazilian bakery option. The atmosphere is loud, and there is too much stimulation.

author: Gerson Roca
review_text: Service is very slow, they take their time. So, do not go there if you are in your way to work.

author: Hillary D.
review_text:
Made to order pastel! Also great coxinha! And the best acai bowl in town!

Edit: The girl that works the register with red hair needs to read this. She always has a bad face on, never says Thank you. I tipped her anyway because she must be very sad. Everyone else is friendly.

author: Leo He
review_text: First time trying a Brazilian Burger good food, great employees and atmosphere all around. Will be back soon

author: Joao Soares
review_text: Food is good here but they just take too long to get stuff done. Need a better staff!

author: Joana Ferreira Garcia
review_text: Pastels are good but the service is so bad... these girls would rather be anywhere else...and it makes you question why.

author: Estuardo Montoya
review_text:
I loved
The X egg - with everything.
The food was delicious.
The place:
Very nice.
The prices: very good across the entire menu.
I recommend it:
And I'll definitely be back to try other dishes.
They have a wide variety of food, and cakes.
...
Everything looked very delicious.

author: Vanessa Cruz
review_text: Okay, my experience with this bakery has been terrible since I moved to Everett! The food is relatively good, but you need to improve in many important areas, such as the staff paying more attention to the orders of those who arrive first. It wasn't just once that they delivered orders to people who arrived after me! And every time, the orders were WRONG! I gave up buying directly at the counter and decided to call ahead to try and speed things up, and whoever answers the phone never knows the price of anything!!! The menu available (by photo) on your internet isn't updated, and you never change it because nobody says anything! As if that wasn't enough, the last time I called, I asked the price of a simple cheeseburger, and the girl said she didn't know and would check at the counter. She left me waiting on hold for 8 minutes and didn't call back, and on top of that, hung up on me! That's no way to treat anyone! You have terrible customer service, I apologize! I much prefer Santana's; they always provide excellent service and have NEVER gotten my order wrong!!!

author: Lázaro Salvador
review_text: To begin with, we arrived at the place and were served there. I ordered a pastel (a type of Brazilian pastry) and a ham and cheese roll, and soon after, she arrived with only my pastel and didn't have the roll. She didn't even mention that they didn't have the roll, and when I went to check, they hadn't fried the roll yet, and I had to wait even longer.

author: Curiosidade
review_text: The prices aren't low, and they don't have a wide variety of food products. Unfortunately, I wasn't very lucky with my order; I ordered a roll with cheese and corn, and it was sour, the dough had no flavor at all, and I threw it in the trash after just one bite. The employees work without enthusiasm or enthusiasm. The place is good, but it needs some adjustments and attention to detail regarding the food.

author: Aline Martins
review_text: I've never been to a place as dirty as this, it's a dump, it's embarrassing, because we Brazilians are clean. The table was dirtier than the floor with grease, the napkin holders hadn't been used in a year, zero stars. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, it's horrible.

author: Tainá de Araújo Henrique
review_text: The food is very good and very affordable, I love going there, not to mention the waitresses are lovely.

author: Sarah Chansriharaj
review_text: Food so good and delicious! Very small place but plenty of seating but no bathrooms.

author: Benson B
review_text:
Ordered delivery on their app yesterday. It took an hour and 22 minutes exactly to arrive. The shop is just a bit over half a mile away. No update in the food or delivery status regarding the delay. The food was cold, my wings were soggy and the breadsticks were an unholy brick of carbs and cheese.

Called their shop and got put on hold forever only to find out they don’t know why there is such a holdup, because they depend on third party drivers.

All I know is I spent 50$+ and received terrible service and goods. Might as well stock up on frozen pizza from stop and shop, the food will be way cheaper, timely, and taste about the same.

(They also forgot to give me the one of the dips I paid extra for, so that was fun.)

author: Raymond Ng
review_text: Thus pizza hut skimps on everything. My orders always have underwhelming toppings. That's really the only thing I can say that gets my fired up. If I order a pizza I just want to see a nice amount of toppings. Always under the bar. I once got the wrong order and wanted to get a refund and they always Pass you off to a manager who is never there. Tried calling the customer line and they tell you to call the store. Pizza hut just isn't for the customer anymore, and have resulted turning the one beloved restaurant to all pizza hut express that you'd find at a target.

author: Honestadie
review_text: You walk in and there's no one at the counter, just a bunch of people waiting for service while everyone talks in the back. Lady literally slammed on the counter and no one came out. Terrible service

author: Leydiperez Makeup and hairstyle
review_text: A horrible experience. I ordered through Uber Eats. The first time I waited two hours and it never arrived. Today I ordered for my son's birthday and the pepperoni arrived burnt and smelled awful—disgusting.

author: Luis Ardon
review_text: The worst delivery experience possible. It’s almost like they try to get it wrong every single time. I keep ordering because it’s conveniently close to home but they either don’t deliver and don’t communicate it to us making us waste time. Or they get the order wrong and miss items. Or they deliver the food without notice and we find it full of flies and bugs hours later. TERRIBLE service. I never write reviews but I have to at this point.

author: Gianna Freitas
review_text: foods good, but horrible service. a guy came here 3 times with the wrong order, horribly busy, barely doing orders and EATING PIZZA instead of DOING THE ORDERS??

author: Frankie Bradley
review_text: So I called in to order the new knotted pizza 🍕 and the lady told me 21.50 then after taxes 23.99. I went to order it offline and it came up to 17.11 now this lady is rude and I always have issues with her and her attitude towards me. So I hear her ask someone and they told her 19 I told her that it was 17.11 online then she asked someone again I believe in Spanish and told me they give it to me for 17. Im afraid to eat the pizza cause they special her are very petty. If I get sick 🤢🤒 y'all know who did it. I'm so hungry 😭 should I trust it? To be continued 😆

author: Leslie Perez
review_text: Do not order from here. Waited 20 minutes for my order. Cashier hid in the back for over 10 minutes. Had to assert myself just to give my name only for my pizza order to be wrong. Place was full of Uber eats drivers who apparently get priority.

author: Tony Yip
review_text: Hit and miss.   I ordered two different orders from them during the Xmas week.  One was done correctly and tasted so good.  Another time was done so sad and very little topping and didnt have enough cheese and the crust was so thick.

author: joe rocca
review_text: What a horrible experience. I called in for an order to be picked up on my way to work. So I have something to eat. The call center sent my order elsewhere. I walk in the manager is staring at his phone Before he took a good solid minute To even acknowledge I was standing there. They had to remake my order didn't even offer a discount. The girls on the inside don't even speak english. And it took up about 25 minutes to make my order I don't see this business open for too much longer the way they run it..

author: Rob Lewis
review_text: Worst place, I ordered online 20 mins, another 15 waiting in the store, even when fully staffed still slow

author: James Tene
review_text: Jolson was very helpful and friendly so is the rest of the staff and every time I get of a stressful day from work or school I always leave with a smile on my face. Sometimes even if this place is packed I can always count on getting my food before my 15 minute break ends. Every time I enter I am in awe seeing how clean the floors are. I recommend this place 110%

author: Tameika Rosario
review_text:
8/22/24
Order 2 pizzas & a pasta through the app. App said my food would be delivered by 5:57pm. By 6pm, I decided to call the store. A lady picked up, then put me on hold for over 5 minutes, & never returned. As me & my daughter sat outside waiting another 15 minutes, I decided to call the store again.
That’s when XAVIER answered the phone. I stated my issue, & he told me he couldn’t understand me. I said okay, and proceeded to slow my speech & speak again, only to not be given the chance becuz HE HUNG UP THE PHONE ON ME! Now let me state that I am literally LESS THAN 5 minutes from this location, had my husband NOT calmed me down, Xavier & I would’ve met in person!! Horrible customer service, & Xavier better hope he doesn’t see me becuz I WILL REMEMBER THIS! I work in retail, & this is unacceptable to me

author: Jeremy LeBlanc (Jeremy)
review_text: I haven't had Pizza Hut in a long time it's got to be better than Little Caesars because that was so horrible the final results was a really big let down , especially because of the tremendously delicious advertising, ughh absolute falsely faked by the ads and it upsets me tremendously, trash that was a robbery at 7:11 211 which is robbery in progress and is no better than a 7-Eleven Pizza you can't get with food stamp!! SMH

author: Jonathan Diaz
review_text: They take too long for the order to be ready bad customer services, don't come here unless your willing to spend an extra 40min wait go to another pizza hut please

author: Daniela Gutierrez
review_text: I’ve been waiting for 15 minutes for someone to come out. I tried to say hello and I even shouted a little but no one listened to me, they were in the back talking entertainingly, until the phone rang and it was my savior. Otherwise I would have waited half an hour or more.

author: Lee Leblanc
review_text: Snotty workers and people who care about nothing but there money they didn't want to make a medium stuffed crust they told me it was only large pizza nobody spoke English in America employee did not make me feel welcome and gave me the stiff upper lip face because I didn't want a large but at least the food was served hot if that counts for anything

author: Shahil Patel
review_text: I love this Pizza Hut, the service, wait time and quality of the pizza is excellent. Specifically while I was there, the manager Vianna and Lilian were very kind and made the experience of visiting here great.

author: Asia Edwards
review_text: The food is great. I love their lemon pepper wings. If you like Wing Stop, then please give them a try. Their cheese sticks are so delicious. 😋

author: Hayden Leung
review_text:
Your typical Chinese-American buffet. The typical price for lunch is around $13, but I visited on Indigineous People’s Day where the all day price was $18.

Interiors & Atmosphere:
- I was seated away from the food area. This section had a slight antique, musty odor. The inside is rather old and could benefit from some modernization.

Food:
- Selection is pretty typical with a variety of meats, fried foods, seafood, and stir-fry’s. Sushi did not seem very fresh.

Overall, I’d say this place is worth it for the price and when you just need to get your fix of  Chinese-American buffet food.

author: Justin C
review_text: It’s your basic Chinese buffet place, but the hibachi grill guy was pretty good at making my fried rice. All you can eat so no complaining, and decent selection of food. I left with a full stomach.

author: Yong Zhou
review_text: We usually come here when we're nearby shopping for groceries. It's usually not crowded before 2 p.m. on Sundays. There's a wide selection of crayfish, seafood, crab, duck, pork, chicken, sushi, hibachi, fruit, and more, so if you're hungry, you'll likely be able to fill up easily. The food is just okay. Don't expect the same quality and taste as you'd get at a specialty restaurant. However, considering the price we paid, I think it's well worth it.

author: J P
review_text:
This place is definitely not worth going out of your way for.

The selection was not very good. There were only 10 Chinese-American options in the buffet, the rest were things like chicken nuggets, desserts, salad, pizza.

The food we tried wasn't great... It was edible. It didn't taste like it had gone rotten or rancid. Most items were hot enough in the steam tables. Nothing to write home about.

The dining room looked fairly clean and I didn't stick to the table, which surprised me. At the end of dinner, I looked up, and you can see from the picture that they don't clean their ceiling vents or filters, so all that crud is falling and blowing into the food and onto your plates.

I walked into the bathroom. It was gross. This bathroom hasn't been cleaned for more than a day. It was filthy everywhere.

I hardly ever say bad stuff about a restaurant.
I will never go back to this one because it was gross and I can't imagine how it passed health inspection, and the food wasn't great.

Great prices, but not worth it

author: Grace Charmenita
review_text: First of all, food not taste so good,but have a lot of option. Second , sushi rice taste weird and I found a Little Rocks inside from couple of sushi. Third, the Salmon they’re cut so thin and small,doesn’t have a couple option for sushi and doesn’t have sashimi(even the price $15/person) I’m from New York,I know the price is reasonable for buffet here,but I know you still can upgrade it,that’s why you guys have 2 location now. Fourd,all the server speak so loudly to each other and laughing so loud ,it’s not polite when you’re working like that, it’s not beside each other but the gap so far and they’re talking to each other like have no customers,that’s not good SOP. Fifth,server was rude! I’m coming with my husband for my birthday, they put me in small booth seat for 2 people, I mean we’re big person even not so fat but we can’t sit there because our winter coat also so big,we need space to put it so we can sit more comfortable and enjoy the food. First time eating we want to ask the server but they didn’t ask us how’s everything, until we move by ourself and one of server from far away ask like why you want move to other tables(which is that time not busy and not full table around us ,maybe 1 section side just have us and 1 family of 3 , that’s it) and then my husband just said because we need to put our winter coat we don’t have space. And then she ask,how many of you, we said just 2 people. And then I think either the manager or the lady owner said it’s okay, so just it’s okay,why need ask so many times? I mean even we just 2 people’s why we can’t move to the other tables? Next time you need to see if even just 2 people if they’re bringing a lot of stuff or have a big winter coat,just give them booth seat with 4 people not just for 2 peoples. I know maybe there have server who got section side for them to paid their salary but it’s not how to service the guest especially when you’re in buffet which is need more higher service not just let the customers pick and eat and go home,it’s not to go shop. I hope you guys upgrade it everything, but for now I will not recommended this place for buffet, I will see you guys later and I will try to edit this review if you guys done upgrading this.

author: Mark Altreuter
review_text: All-you-can-eat is amazing. So much variety and no time or plate limits. I highly recommend the Hibachi station. If you want to get your money's worth, just throw a bunch of steak on the grill. I had hibachi steak with some teriyaki sauce and it was delicious. Desserts were ample and the cheesecake to die for. Sushi was okay. The rice seemed thick/dense. *Note: I went on a Sunday afternoon and had the Sunday all-day buffet.

author: Farz Tex
review_text: The food was just okay below. Good quality. The service was super friendly and the restaurant was okay clean but the bathrooms were really bad And the sushi was not fresh at all but the rest of the food was just okay. The staff were super welcoming and very professional.

author: Michael Pay
review_text: This place was very clean, had a good selection of seafoods, sushi, hibachi grill, and they had a ton of varieties of ice creams. Their dessert chocolate cake was very good as well! We were comparing the buffet with a restaurant downtown and the quality of food and taste weren't that far apart and the whole buffet was the price of a single dish! Would definitely come back again, the only problem is we end up eating way too much food! 🤣😭🤣

author: Lisa Xiaremba
review_text: I’ve wanted to try this place for a while since it’s in the plaza with 99 Asian Supermarket - I have to say I was pleasantly surprised! The seafood and dinner buffet are the way to go here, surprisingly fresh and tender black pepper crab, and they have a more Cajun-y seafood tray for the dinner buffet as well with some really juicy shrimp. Lunch buffet I’m not sure is worth it compared to other Chinese buffets. Also don’t get the sashimi on the sushi station, it tastes a little like death. But the sushi is okay. Also, can we talk about the stir fried cabbage. That was surprisingly flavorful…

author: BR AL
review_text:
I went to this buffet last night with my girlfriend, and the place was completely packed. The first thing we noticed at the entrance was the strong smell of detergent and the amount of cleaning chemicals sitting out in the open, which already felt unusual.

When we sat down and went to get food, most of the plates and serving areas looked messy and not properly cleaned. The utensils used to grab the food weren’t actually dirty, but it looked like leftover food from previous customers was still stuck on them. It didn’t seem like they were being replaced or wiped down regularly.

I went back to the table and saw that my girlfriend had filled her plate but looked extremely uncomfortable because of the place not being clean. At that point, I told the waitress that we wanted to leave. She noticed we had only been there for about five minutes and asked if we didn’t like the food, and I confirmed.
