Despite leaving immediately and not eating anything, they still charged us the full amount. She even pointed to the tip line on the receipt to make sure I didn’t forget to add a tip, which felt inappropriate given the circumstances.

author: Sherman Hanke
review_text: Helpful staff, accommodating sushi chef. Even right at opening, much of my food was lukewarm tho. They seem capable of doing much better than what I saw.  I'll try again and update!

author: PH Chan
review_text: I visited here for dinner early on a Thursday evening. Asian buffets are my guilty pleasure. Please don’t tell my Chinese mom ; )  Maybe I caught them on an off night, but it was disappointing. The good: large selection of Asian entrees and some not-so-Asian offerings too (including cheese pizza, mac & cheese, and tater tots). The roasted meats were solid. Duck was surprisingly good. BBQ chicken and pork ribs were also solid. Sushi was good too. Mostly assorted rolls, but everything was well prepared. The other seafood dishes were also tasty. They were fresh and nicely sauced. Desserts were cafeteria quality, but there was a big selection of ice cream bars and cups in a freezer nearby. I didn’t try the hibachi, but it looked good too.  Server was friendly and efficient. The not-so-good: pretty much all of the fried foods were limp or soggy, including the fried shrimp dishes, Gen’l Tso’s chicken, calamari, potstickers, eggrolls, etc. I think this could have been because it wasn’t too busy when I was there, and they were bringing out lots of food. So a lot of the food was sitting on the steam trays for long enough to loose its crunch. But that also meant that the food on the top of the piles got kind of cold. So my recommendation would be to either visit when they’re really busy and replacing the food quickly or get a seat where you can see when they bring out the refills and make your choices accordingly.

author: Jaime Smith
review_text: I just tried this place for the first time not long ago. It was pretty good. The buffet is a pretty decent size which means the variety of food they have is good. I enjoyed it & the price is great!

author: William Tun
review_text: For the price this is a best buffet in the state of mass. Even better than other flaming grills. The staff there is wonderful. Amy is a great server like always. Thanks again guys will definitely come often!

author: Shu Ou
review_text: Friendly helpful staff and hot good food. Check out the hibachi at the farthest point from the door!

author: Almighty LO
review_text: I not only lost my appetite but I became nauseous within minutes and then I took a uber to the hospital. Nothing was fresh, food was reheated and lukewarm. I honestly don’t understand how this place is still in business. I didn’t finish my food I paid but then I was harassed to leave a tip

author: Dante Gell
review_text: Flaming Grill Buffet has a good variety of food, but the best part is the service, especially from the manager. She's super attentive and makes sure everyone's having a good experience. The food is what you'd expect from a buffet – lots of options and a good value. Definitely worth a try if you're looking for a casual meal with friendly service!

author: Paabii “Aayusna” Atokved
review_text:
Perfect  place to stop if you are seafood lover.  There wide varieties of grill and fried dishes with dessert  makes it worth it.
There hibachi is my absolute favorite all the time.

author: Josh
review_text: The food is really good here. And there is SO much of it! The variety is good. And the quality is good. The staff are efficient, but not overly friendly nor obtrusive. It is also VERY reasonably priced.

author: Yusuf Nasrullah
review_text: Fantastic place actually! Nice hot food with great crabmeat, fried shrimp, beef with scallions, hot and sour soup and fried rice. Very nice desserts and fresh fruits for dessert. Good price for a lot of food, comfortable air conditioning and hanging out with a group of hungry friends!

author: Alexandra
review_text:
The food is really good. The burger patty is soft and juicy, honestly one of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Highly recommended!
The only thing I’d suggest is getting it to go since the place is a bit small.

author: Joslyn Deschenes
review_text: Great date spot- cute bar set up setting looking outside. I tried the buffalo chicken fries and the I’m Crazy for Cookies shake, and both were amazing! The fries were loaded with tender chicken, just the right amount of heat, and plenty of flavor. The shake was rich, creamy, and packed with cookie goodness—basically dessert heaven in a cup. Friendly service and a fun vibe made the visit even better.

author: Cody Belanger
review_text: We tried the Ice Cream Chicken Sundae Sandwich, the Sweet & Spicy Fries, and the Hot Mess & Cheese Express, every single item was a 5/5! I was especially excited (and curious) about the ice cream sandwich, while my wife was a little hesitant, but even she loved it! The food was incredible. Just make sure you show up hungry, you’ll want to try everything!

author: Abigail Thompson
review_text: Went in about 20 minutes after open. Got water, bottle was so dirty, and there was floaters. Server never can to take our drink order, so we order food and drinks at one. Chicken tenders was fine, not bad. I got merica burger, medium. It was raw, like mushy raw. Server never came to ask how food was. I had to go up to the bar to ask for our check. Would not recommend and will not go back.

author: Nephileen Kattel
review_text: When I walked in I was hit by a very unpleasant smell of feet/sweat. I was thinking maybe it was the bathroom or something, but idk it just smelled bad. Then the food came out, and the chicken sandwiches were nothing like it showed in the images!! They weren’t crispy and it was really below average. The fries were great though….

author: Cassandra Montes
review_text: The food was amazing. I had the Hot Mess & Cheese. Best burger I have ever had. The prices are also amazing for the amount of food.

author: david we
review_text: I ordered the Merica smash burger with the better than ketchup. The smash burger itself was very tasty but for me the bun kinda brought it down a bit. It would be nice to have a brioche bun or something softer than these harder sesame seed rolls.  Cheese fries tasted good too thanks to the cheese but the French fry itself was nothing special.

author: Heather Pontius
review_text: Amazing food. Little bit of a weird seating area but its meant for take out. Excellent burger.

author: Ivna Aragao
review_text: They have a greta combination of ingredients, but the burger was a bit rare and falling apart. I haven't quite summed up the "want" to go back, despite how good the food looks. Also, avoid parking at the gyms parking lot, next to their place.

author: Minor
review_text: As a first-time customer, I can confidently say Crazy Good Kitchen lives up to its name. From the moment I received my food, it was clear that care and attention went into both preparation and presentation. The flavors were bold, well-balanced, and genuinely satisfying—nothing tasted rushed or generic. Will definitely be going back often.

author: arpita
review_text: Quaint place to eat in Boston. I'm from Texas and don't get opportunity to eat outside. This was perfect time to do people watching while eating good food. My son is picky and he finished his plate. Reasonably priced.

author: Apex Imagery
review_text: Crazy Good Kitchen lives up to its name! Their bacon double cheeseburgers are packed with flavor, the Parmesan truffle fries are absolutely incredible, and their milkshakes are the perfect sweet treat to top it all off. Highly recommend for an unforgettable meal!

author: Rachel Iacomini
review_text:
I want to start by saying I’ve had burgers and truffle fries here before and they were solid but today’s meal was not great at all and I’m super disappointed.

I ordered online directly from the website and went to pick up right away. Was there within 10 minutes and it was already ready….red flag! I got home about 7 minutes later and the food was so cold, it just didn’t feel fresh at all. I got the 3 piece buffalo tenders and truffle fries and first of all these are in WAY too small of a container. Separate the fries and chicken please. 🙏

The chicken tenders were super odd….never seen anything like them and honestly I didn’t eat them at all. They really ruined my appetite.

They were HUGE pieces of chicken tenderloin that were poorly breaded, and not crispy at all. All the breading (which was minimal) was soggy and falling off. Partially due to it not seeming fresh or recently fried and then partially from being in a super cramped container with no air vents.

This time the fries seemed different as well…like frozen ones when I swore they used to seem fresh and I thought they used to have rosemary but I might be wrong.

Not sure if management changed or the quality is just going down hill but I’m not sure I’ll be back.

author: Sierra Harken
review_text: The shakes are insanely good! The burgers and fries are also great. This is truly a staple so make sure to come hungry. We found there’s good availability for seating if you go in person, but typically get this as takeaway.

author: Dr.Foodie
review_text: A solid place for good burgers and chicken sandwich. Haven't tried the shakes yet. It's outdoor dining on a patio area with a nice cool breeze. The steak and cheese fries were delicious and I do recommend. The only thing I can't wrap around is the price as it is more than 14 dollars for a chicken sandwich/burger.

author: Sergio Solis Checa
review_text:
Burgers are good and very similar to the pictures, but dining in ia definitely not a good choice.
There are like bar seats for roughly 15 people, and we did that because we don't live that close. However, it's not comfortable, not enough room, temperature and wind were bad.
I could definitely have the burger again, but at home

author: Chris Ayers
review_text: Exceptional burgers & fried chicken sandwiches at this small stand. Eat your lunch and watch the happenings on Eastern Ave.

author: Shu Ou
review_text: Fantastic burgers. Mango shake is very thick: might need a spoon!

author: Kathleen Sullivan
review_text: Picked up a shake for my husband. Service was excellent.  The pickup area and stairs could use some sprucing up. That may be on the “to-do” list in the spring.

author: Peter Sujanani
review_text: Tired the Hot Mess & Cheese Burger. It had me licking my fingers and was cooked to perfection, a juicy dripping messy burger, aptly named, just the way I like it. Also got the But Make It Spicy Chicken sandwich. It was a top quality breaded chicken breast with the right amount of heat complimented with the perfect crunch of the slaw. The buffalo tenders were top notch as their quality chicken and Buffalo sauce was one of the best we've had with an awesome balance of heat and tangy flavor. Such Yummy Deliciousness made for a memorable meal.

author: ariel M
review_text: We made a reservation for New Year's Eve for the 5 of us but the restaurant is huge so we probably didn't even need one. The parking lot was very full but we managed to find a spot. We started wit the nachos and added pork and Guacamole. They were delicious and the chips themselves are seasoned and spicy! For an entree, I had the braised short rib and the blue cheese mashed potatoes were fantastic. The rest of the family had the burger deluxe, OG classic pizza, and hot bird sandwich. For dessert, the kids had sundaes and my boyfriend and I split the apple pie cheesecake and it was good. If we are ever in the area again, we would definitely go back. The bar area was huge and looked like a good place to watch sports as well. We were seated in quieter area off to the side (which was great for us!) and they gave us a sling for our baby car seat. Our server was excellent and everyone we came into contact with was very friendly and nice. The drink lady seemed quite extensive but we didn't order off it. They have a kids menu but my kids ordered off the main menu. Our total bill before tip was $144.

author: Larry Morton
review_text: First time here loved it. Food was great. I had a chance to set up the way back bar before my girlfriend and family came. Then we moved up to the front for dinner. There’s multiple places you can enjoy a good meal or drinks with friends. I highly recommend it during the Woburn area or anywhere close to it to stop in. This was Christmas time which made an extra special. God bless all of you and come down to Sam Walker’s American tavern for a great night feel like to see the full video. Go to life with Larry on YouTube.

author: Joshua Einhorn
review_text: We have been waiting for this grand opening for a while... To say the least it was worth the wait! Noting we went on a Sunday evening with the family so it was a bit busier, but that did not affect service whatsoever. For a place that's been open for only two weeks now they seem to be running smoothly. I had the Walker Burger Royale. It was pretty amazing! Hit the spot. Great portion sizes all around the table. Loved the idea of the "cocktail for a cause" libations. The Late Check-out is something I would definitely get again! Usually go for a beer but this was a pretty solid choice. Great options for kids too. Have a feeling this spot is going to fit right in to the Vinnin Square scene... and fills a void of a gathering spot for locals that the area has needed for some time as an alternative to the growing options on Humphrey St and Downtown Marblehead. Would come back again... and again! Still cannot believe the transformation this place did as you would've never expected this with the way it was set up before.

author: Chris Duffy
review_text: We went to Sam’s for breakfast today. Our server Caroline was amazing. The staff was friendly.  The El Jefe Burrito was top 3 breakfast sandwiches I’ve ever had!  We’ll back next time we’re in town

author: Marc Cooper
review_text: Great breakfast joint!!! Ainsley was an awesome server.  I highly recommend the, "In Yo' Face Breakfast Sammie Sandwich!" Soooo good. It's fried eggs, bacon, American cheese, advocado, with a spicy aioli sauce on a soft brioche bun. 😋 oh yeah, the advocado toast with corn and tomatoes is ridiculously 🔥 as well. Yes, I read a lot of reviews in order to find this gem.

author: Jennieanne Steinman
review_text: I visited this place with my husband and 17 year old son a few days ago for brunch. We were quickly sat and really liked the comfortable vibe. The menu had plenty to choose from. When the food came, my husband and son's were fine but they brought me the wrong food. The waitress took it away and said she'd have the correct food brought over. Unfortunately, when my meal finally arrived, my son and husband were done eating so that was kind of a bummer but they didnt mind waiting for me to eat. The chicken in my sandwich was so dry and tough that it was inedible. I ate some of the bread because I was honestly so hungry at that point. The waitress asked if I wanted a box and I let her know that I didnt eat it because it was tough and dry. She just quickly said "sorry about that" and quickly brought us our bill. I was honestly bummed to pay $17 for an inedible sandwich that I got at the end of our visit with barely an acknowledgement at all about it. That being said, my son's pancakes were awesome and the portion was huge. My husband's chicken and waffles was great.

author: Joseph Meoli
review_text: Greeted  , nicely and professional and were seated in the bar area ..  a little loud to our liking for brunch .. but very clean … Our waitress Erin was very nice and introduced herself .. took drink order and gave us time to order very professional and helpful with explaining any questions.. superb service… waited a little long for food ,, but was definitely worth waiting for our country Benedict , and Breakfast egg rolls.. food was delicious..  recommend both ! And ask for ERIN O ..  for waitress she was just superb .. Bon appetite

author: Juliana
review_text: Very very good tavern food!! Highly recommend this place they a lot of good apps and different dinner choices to choose from. I recommend the buffalo chicken dip for an app and for your meal you can’t go wrong with anything! The steak frites were incredible with the sauce !!!! And the burger so juicy and flavorful this place is bomb can’t wait to come back!!

author: Chuck Paone
review_text: Nice place for a quick meal, drink or a long hang with friends and family. Easy to locate right off of Rte 93 with wonderful rustic atmosphere. Attended as part of a large holiday party. The food was great, appetizers were a big hit with the Italian egg rolls the stars. Large party orders can be a challenge for one server, but ours was professional, patient and perfect with the delivery. The only reason there is not a 5 star review for the restaurant and service is the head of house at the door was maybe having a bad day, but wow not exactly a warm greeting or helpful when we arrived and asked about our reservation. Hopefully she has a better day next time.

author: Pamela Barron
review_text: A-mazing food taste and presentation!  A delight for the senses. Atmosphere has a cozy, but busy bar vibe.

author: Kayla MacDonald
review_text:
Sam Walker’s has been our go-to spot ever since it opened in Woburn, and it just keeps getting better! It’s the perfect neighborhood place, whether you’re meeting friends, grabbing a casual dinner, or riding out a New England snowstorm. The food is fantastic across the board, but the nachos and the brisket mac and cheese are absolute standouts! The bar selection is always great too, with fun local options and seasonal picks.

The atmosphere is welcoming, the service is friendly, and the whole place has that “local favorite” feel that keeps you coming back. Sam Walker’s is truly one of my favorite spots in the area, and I’m always happy to shout out one of my favorite Toast customers. Highly recommend checking it out!

*This review was made in connection with a Toast promotion.

author: John Van Note
review_text: Traveling solo from Missouri had great experience with staff(Bridgette), Had chicken Parmesan It’s a simple dish, but done very well here. This Midwest boy enjoyed the place. I was not prepared for the strength of drinks, but I loved it.

author: Jake Flynn
review_text:
Ahhhhh Sam Walker’s…not to tout myself but we go to Bowery and Chubbs more often than I’d like to admit. And trust me I get a chub for Chubbs. Both are sister restaurants and in the same restaurant group as Sam Walker’s, evident by the identical menu font…FINE.

Sam walkers offers similar fare but more of a combination of all the offerings at Lucy’s, Chubbs and Bowery. Great beer selection friendly staff and good food.

However……..
It’s almost like you get the selection of all three restaurants, the nachos from Chubbs, the Italian egg rolls from Lucy’s and the pasta from Bowery but somehow it just doesn’t hit the same level, just being honest. Maybe because they are trying to do all three. Overall it is good though and is a great value.

Espresso martini didn’t skip a beat from the sister restaurants, identical, delicious and large like Jack G’s peepeee.

Overall I think they could try to do less with the menu and offer some more uniqueness/originality for the benefit of quality over quantity. This is my constructive criticism though if they ever ready this. I would come back.

author: Kathy Troxell
review_text: We are traveling from Oklahoma and staying at the BW Plus, directly behind the restaurant.  We decided to walk to dinner and hadn't been to a Walkers.  Hopefully it won't be our last!  Jessie was a great waitress!!  Highly recommend.

author: All Year Inc
review_text:
We had such a great experience at Sam Walker’s on a Saturday evening!
The place was super busy and they put us on a waiting list with 30 min estimate time, but ended up calling us in 15 min. The atmosphere, food and service were amazing!
Unfortunately my wife forgot her purse and we realised that next morning, we called the place and we were told that they found it,  that was such a relief since she had everything in there, documents, credit cards and cash! Thank you guys for being so kind and honest! Definitely coming back for another lunch or dinner and we recommend the place to our friends and relatives.
By the way the espresso martinis are the best there🍸

author: Paul Craven Craven
review_text: What a fabulous brunch experience and the staff was absolutely amazing especially Caitlyn as she had so much going on and was so friendly and sense of urgency was absolutely 💯 above and beyond and the food was great and so that means we will def be coming back and thank you for a great breakfast brunch experience as it was my daughters birthday !!!

author: Jenn D
review_text: The reviews are very overrated for this place. We got steak tips, which only had 6 pieces for over $30 and chicken parm with was completely burnt on the bottom and dried out. The waitress was nice enough but barely checked in on us. I would not go there again

author: Nikita
review_text: Came here to celebrate, and were amazed with the food and service!! Our waiter was very friendly, and fast. I demolished that chicken burger in 20 seconds flat, and everyone at the table loved their meals. Loved our lunch, thank you!

author: Grogu
review_text: Food was good. Serve attentive. Bathrooms clean. There was lots of free parking but the noise level im the restaurant was extremely loud. It is impossible to hold any sort of conversation. I would not recommend it for a date night or a place to go if you want to talk to each other.

author: Tameka Osborne
review_text: Great place for a high end sports bar and food experience! Great drinks and food at a reasonable price.

author: Karli Hall
review_text:
We stopped here on our way through town. Everything was absolutely delicious! We were a party of 7. Staff was very friendly and accommodating. Restaurant was very clean.

Pictured are the Chicken Cutlet Alfredo, Faroe Island Salmon and Pokémon bowl.

We also tried the Calamari, Ceviche and Clam Chowder.

Street Parking was easy enough. Prices were good based on portion sizes and quality of food. Highly recommend trying this one if you are in the area!

author: Peter Schimpl
review_text:
We visited Dryft at Revere Beach for dinner and overall had a very enjoyable evening. The location is fantastic — right on the beach, with nice ocean views. Being so close to Revere Beach gives the restaurant a relaxed, coastal feel.

We were seated inside right away (no wait), at a nice table from which we could glimpse parts of the sea and catch some of the ambient beach vibe. The service was friendly, fast, and professional — our server was attentive and made good suggestions.

We tried a variety of dishes: burger, fried seafood, and a New York strip steak. The burger and seafood were very good — well-cooked, fresh, and flavorful. The steak, though, came slightly stringy, which took away a bit of the enjoyment.

If you’re in the mood for dinner with an ocean view (which of course factors into the price tag), Dryft is a solid pick — especially for seafood or light to mid-range dishes.

author: Ivna Aragao
review_text: This is one of my favorite restaurants near the Boston area. It is very well located, in Revere beach, and they provides quality food for those looking for a sitdown restaurant. My fav are the truffle fries and the octopus appetizer, but Ive also gone there for brunch and also loved the options we picked.

author: Frank Qiu
review_text:
The environment is nice.  New with ocean views and the music is just right.
Two out of three dishes are very good.  The salmon Benedict and the duck confit are tasty.
The calamari came out lukewarm and not crispy.  The service brought it back and coming out overcooked.   It is suspected to be fried again instead of a new make.  I don’t like it at all.

author: Lalita Chindarad
review_text:
1 star specifically for the host and one of servers’ behavior/attitude.

The 5 stars only go to the small, wavy blonde hair server who took really good care of me after I got seated.

Food was great, fresh, tasty, high quality!Five star all the way for the food!
Lots of wine options except no Moscato, little disappointed but that’s understandable I went with Vinnicombe Riesling German instead which was not a bad choice at all.
Atmosphere/the view was amazing, ocean view  dinner vibe.
Where the 1 star came from you may asked.
When I entered the restaurant, I told the host that I want to sit at the table outside and it’s just me, party of 1. The host, who is the first point of contact, the first impression of the 5 star restaurant completely failed.
Not friendly, not smiling, not very welcoming.
After I told her my request to sit outside, she told me to wait a moment then went to ask what looked like to be the manager.
Let me explain little more, all outdoor seatings were set up neatly and 100% empty when I got there. I was thinking to myself while waiting to get seated or maybe those tables were all reserved and if it’s not available I’ll just leave because I really want to sit with the view as I am not from around here and it’s not like I can come back tomorrow to dine in again.
Then the host finally came back after good 2-3 minutes and walked me to the outdoor seatings area.
Out of maybe 15 empty tables, she decided to sit me at the table by the door where the door keeps on opening and closing.
Then she said “just this table right here ok!” with an attitude. No sense of hospitality at all whatsoever.
I was about to leave at that point but I really want to enjoy the twilight, food and dessert so I was like whatever, let’s just ignore.
My server, I don’t remember her name, small with wavy blonde hair helped my dinner felt less awkward. She was attentive, smile a lot, and knowledgeable about the wine options.
The food came out in timely manner and perfect timing between the appetizer and the entree. I asked for extra sauce for my calamari as the meal arrived and informed my server to keep the calamari on the table as I still want to finish up my calamari later. As I finished my salmon, sat back for couple minutes, a new server came and took my “not finished” calamari plate away without asking.
Dear Dryft, I felt like your food and atmosphere is 5 stars all the way but your FOH team still needs improvement.
It’s Tuesday evening, with party of 1, from the time I seated around 6:30 pm to almost 8 pm when I finished, outdoor seatings were 80% empty… Dryft closed at 10 pm, absolutely no need to rush to take the food away from the guest without asking. It’s not even that busy to cause to host to have an unwelcoming attitude.
Party of 1, I paid over $100, wine, appetizer, meal, dessert. I think next time I will spend it elsewhere. I don’t mind the prices but what I do mind is if the overall quality of the restaurant match the price I paid. In this case, the food and atmosphere matched the price I paid but not the service.

author: Opal C
review_text: I’ve been here many times, and my all-time favorite things are the tres leches tiramisu 🍰and the red sangria 🍷 — both are amazing. I also really love the salad here, though it may depend on the season.

author: William White
review_text: Celiacs review:  A little bit of finer dining for the area.  Dryft was a surprise for me.  My server Mary was exceptional.  Attentive, knowledgeable about food allergies and was very helpful in selecting my food with helpful recommendations.   The menu was clearly marked.  They have  separate fryer and home made pasta. There are multiple items that can be made gluten free besides what’s clearly marked.   The meal:  food was quick. The truffle fries were just ok.  The truffle aioli that came with it was great.   If I had a recommendation id say skip the truffle fries and get regular with the aioli on the side. Seafood smelled amazing. Steak looked good too.  I wasnt feeling too adventurous so I got a cheeseburger.  It was decent; cooked well good gf bun.  The fried onions and cheese were excellent.  I feel like it would have been amazing cooked on some cast iron.  As it was it was good, well worth the price.   Dryft is a place I’d take anyone for a good casual dinner.   It’s not fine dining but the food quality was excellent.  For dessert the only GF was the pannecotte.  I took the pannecotte to go. ( to eat back at my hotel. )  put a pic of the truffle fries.

author: Jonathan Payson
review_text: This is my absolute go to spot!!! Danny the bar tender, Phil the server and Tracey the AG are the best!  Did is great drinks are better atmosphere is great.  I love this place but its the service that keeps me coming here and keeps me a regular 5 out 5 for me at dryft

author: Michelle Graham
review_text:
We came for brunch then a day at the beach. The location is impeccable!  We were greeted by the hostess and had a reservation.  Outside seating is first come first serve.  We asked for outside seating and the hostess was kind enough to inform us that the only available two tops were in the sun - we took one because we wanted to see the ocean. As we were eating our meal - we saw that she then seated another similar size party in the shade at a 4 top. There should be consistency and fairness!

As for the food - we ordered apps and main at the same time.  Literally 5 mins after our apps arrived, so did our main. We sent it back to the kitchen and it came out later.  We could tell that our mains were just kept on  warm for 15 mins.   So if you aren’t in a rush - stagger your order bc the kitchen isn’t managing the flow.  Our server was friendly and apologized for the timing issue.  She offered to remake the food - but we didn’t ask for that.

The food was delicious and drinks yummy!

author: Anastasia Borisevich
review_text:
At the end of our Boston trip, we decided to visit Revere Beach and combine it with a nice lunch — and I’m so glad we found Dryft Revere.

The atmosphere is relaxed and stylish, with ocean views from the windows. The food was flavorful and well-prepared - I had the Faroe Island salmon, and the kids enjoyed the homemade pasta. Dessert was also delicious.

A wonderful place to wrap up our vacation and share a meal together. Thank you!

author: Phil Goodwin
review_text:
🎉 Celebrating with the Best View at Dryft Revere! 🌊
What an amazing birthday dinner with my favorite people at Dryft Revere tonight! Seriously, the food was incredible—that fresh seafood and the handmade pasta are just chef's kiss 🤌.
Lets's be real, nothing beats that beachfront atmosphere and those panoramic ocean views of Revere Beach. It felt like a mini-vacation! Thanks to Mary for providing us with top-notch service.  She turned our dinner into the perfect experience.  If you haven't been to Dryft Revere you must go!

author: Angelo B
review_text: I’ve been to Dryft many times and have always thought the food was decent, but tonight was incredibly disappointing. I ordered two burgers to go, and both were completely flavorless no seasoning at all, and the meat was so dry it was almost inedible. For $42, I honestly expected so much better. It’s really upsetting to have to throw the food away from a place I’ve supported and enjoyed before.

author: ForealFeels
review_text: The food was a 9/10. We went got brunch on a Sunday.. I got the breakfast quesadilla, my favorite part about it was the buttery crisp of the tortilla. My sister got the French toast and did a side of fried chicken. We got calamari for an appetizer & it was the best calamari I’ve ever had! The sauce that came with it made it that much better!! For dessert we had the oreo tarte it was absolutely phenomenal. The chocolate was perfect, and it stayed hot so every bite was amazing with the cool vanilla ice cream. I highly recommend eating here!

author: Hritik
review_text:
Dryft Revere is one of the most promising places to be around the Revere beach. It was a gloomy weekend and we were super hungry and ordered without giving it much thought but surprisingly the food was way above our expectations.

I realized that the experience was on point when the flavors in the dishes were treating my taste buds one by one.

Highly recommended to sit outdoors and enjoy the mouthwatering food under the sun.

author: Pauline Savigni
review_text:
Best place to dine locally, on the water without the headache of traffic to Boston. The oysters are always fresh and delicious! The tuna nachos are out of this world. I have ordered them 3 times consecutively. Plenty of tuna, perfect amount of seasoning, crispy and
delicious.

author: Barbara Lee-Janavaris
review_text: Another wonderful dinner at the Dryft.  The Limoncello Pasta was fabulous.  The wait staff is so great, especially our server, Mary S, who was phenomenal.  She went above and beyond waiting on our booth with 6 people celebrating  2 Birthdays.  She was extremely accomodating, with humor & wit.  We will continue coming to the Dryft.  It is such a welcoming, comfortable dining experience.  Highly recommend.

author: Jonathan Isbell
review_text: The food was absolutely fantastic with a great atmosphere and great service. The clown chowder was absolutely amazing and so was the sorbet

author: Melissa Quinn
review_text: The whole experience was great! The food was to die for, but we already knew that since it was recommended to us from our good friends the Raymond’s. The staff were super attentive and made sure we were happy while also giving us the privacy we needed to continue our conversations. Drinks were also 10/10! The female manager came by to make sure our meal was going well and she was a hoot. We could have chatted with her all night. My one complaint is there isn’t any darts or pools tables lol! 😉

author: Jessica Backes
review_text: When we entered the restaurant, we were immediately greeted by a hostess. There was no wait, we choose to be seated on the patio. The ocean views were breathtaking. The service was excellent. The prices were reasonable for the quality of food. The food was beautifully prepared and served.

author: Tabata Torres
review_text:
I had an absolutely amazing dining experience at Dryft, and our waitress Lupe made it unforgettable. From the moment we sat down, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. She anticipated every detail before we even had to ask — perfectly balancing professionalism with friendliness.

The food was incredible — every dish beautifully presented and full of flavor — but Lupe’s service elevated the whole evening. She offered great recommendations, kept our drinks full, and made us feel truly cared for. You can tell she loves what she does.

If you go to Dryft, definitely ask for Lupe. She’s a gem and made our meal feel special from start to finish. I can’t wait to come back!

author: Kyle Sechler
review_text:
Visited July 12
Went here with my wife and her sister on a Saturday afternoon and it was a great time. Food was delicious. Got a classic lobster roll and my wife got a bunch of lobster with some onion rings as she can't eat gluten. Beautiful location on the water with lots of seating inside and outside. Came here after watching the Anthony Bourdain episode where he goes here. Highly recommend!

author: Mohammed Sindi
review_text: I know I gave 4 however it’s one of the best seafood places in all of MA. I’m not American and I found the cold lobster sandwich to not be the best, I mean get it but manage your expectations. The fried platter is amazing albeit a bit oily. Onion rings are amazing. Service can be improved as I has to stand up twice and go to the counter to ask for stuff, 2 of the stuff completely avoided looking at our table for 5 minutes straight knowing I wanted to ask for something lol. CASH ONLY!

author: Tyshawn Jenkins
review_text: The service was terrific, and the staff was kind and accommodating. They even brought me Old Bay so I could spice it up. The view was great, and it’s not far from the airport. However, the fries had no salt or seasoning; they were hot. The crab cakes either had a lot of breading or an odd taste of bread. Some may like it, but I may be spoiled having had crab cakes from Baltimore. It’s a lovely spot; maybe other items are worth trying.

author: Shelli Kurak
review_text:
Great food.. great service!
Ask for Dave ..gave great recommendation on menu.  He was  helpful with directions and world traveling advice. Very personable. Interacted well with the family. Ordered lobster pie and fried clams. Very very good...

author: Heather Gregory
review_text: Beautiful day to enjoy an outdoor lunch with my husband. Oh boy did we. Restaurant very clean & welcoming. Service friendly, efficient, professional. View was excellent, blue skies, boats on the water, got to watch planes take off & land. Now the food, amazing. We both order seafood combo plates. We each ordered our own, assuming a seafood combo plate priced in the mid $30’s wouldn’t have a lot of seafood, mostly fries wow 👀 were we wrong. 2 fairly large fresh Haddock filletscooked perfectly, at least 9 sea scallops, several Shrimp & whole belly clams.  Fries, onion rings, Cole claw, tarta sauce & cocktail sauce all cooked perfectly & delicious. We ate all we possibly could & will be enjoying the left overs for dinner. This is a must try 😊

author: Andrew Minster
review_text: Wow. Boston Logan Airport to Belle Isle Seafood is it! Perfect location and seashore vibe. Cash only. OK, the convenient ATM as you enter is available. Great outdoor seating as well as indoor dining. I ordered the Belle Isle draught. Smoooooth and uniquely perfect. Seafood is fresh, well cared for and expertly prepared. The Grilled Swordfish is highly recommended. Rice Pilaf is moist and flavorful. Cole Slaw is also very good.

author: KC KC
review_text: on a pricy side but the food they serve is totally worth it! beautiful place, fresh seafood and nice location on the water and get to see the belly of any airplanes! I love all kind of fried seafood dinner plates they have comes with yummy onion rings and fries and friendly service too

author: Brad SJCP
review_text:
Great lobster rolls.  The fried calamari was a bit crunchy due to a thick batter, otherwise it was okay. The fried shrimp appeared to be commercially made. One one in our party tried baked or fried fin fish.

The server was friendly and the food was delivered promptly.

The interior is on the rustic side.

Will to go back just for lobster rolls.

author: M Ferrick
review_text: Best coleslaw I've ever had. The baked stuffed haddock was delicious and fresh. My wife loved her shrimp dinner.

author: Gary Barmore
review_text: Belle Isle Seafood has been on my to do list for awhile.  I should have went sooner!!!  The food was fantastic and the portions were huge.

author: Don LeClair
review_text:
Came for our first visit for lunch midweek. It was not busy and we got a table looking out towards the airport.

They have a good amount of space and very high ceilings. We tried out the fried seafood: clams and scallops. Both were very good. The food came out really hot and tasted great. The portions size was very good. More Cole slaw would have been nice as it is very tasty.

The clam chowder was tasty, and not particularly thick.

author: Pilai W
review_text:
A Seafood Lover’s Paradise!
I had an amazing experience at [Restaurant Name]! From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm and welcoming. The atmosphere was cozy and had a great coastal vibe. The seafood was incredibly fresh — I ordered the bake combo both were absolutely delicious. My partner had the seafood platter, and every bite was perfectly cooked. The presentation was beautiful, and the flavors were out of this world. Service was attentive without being intrusive, and the staff was knowledgeable about the menu. If you’re looking for top-quality seafood and a memorable dining experience, this place is a must-visit!
Cash only

author: Joe & Laura Bodine
review_text: Great seafood and view of the harbor next to Logan Airport. Very fresh scallops, shrimp and halibut baked with a very light breading cooked to perfection!

author: Bob L
review_text:
**CASH ONLY!!** (there is an ATM at the front door however!)

It's been a while since I've been back and I must say that this place if anything, is super consistent! (Including it being cash only).

The decor and layout is exactly the same when I came here 8 years ago!

The food here is just as I remember it. Here are the items ordered as of 6/2025:

- Lobster Roll - $37.99 - When I came here 8 years ago it was $28.99 which if you ask me is an absolute steal value wise when compared to food prices at other restaurants! Still a half pound of delicious succulent lobster. Just as good as I remember!

- Fried combo - $32.99 - A generous heaping amount of fried seafood!  One thing I wish they would do is double the amount of coleslaw and tartar sauce they gave you as it's just as small as I remember (although you can request for more tartar sauce).  The seafood is battered and fried perfectly. The fries and onion rings, while crispy, are just as bland as before and needs a helping hand of ketchup and salt.

- Pina Colada - $10.99 - Very refreshing but wish the size was larger for the price.

- Clam Chowder (bowl) - $10.99 - Good flavor and not too creamy.  A staple at any seafood establishment.  Good but nothing mind blowing.

We were able to grab a table outside which has a fantastic view of the boats and the water. However, if you're hoping for a calm, serene experience be warned that the airport sounds like it's right next door to you so you WILL hear the jet's taking off and landing.  However if you're an aviation fan then this will be a huge bonus for you as you'll be able to see planes come and go!

Highly recommended for seafood lovers out there that can make the trek out here!

author: Bradley Nakaji
review_text:
Lobster rolls are fantastic. Fried calamari was a bit crunchy and cold. All the kids meals were good. Fried shrimp were good.

Service was above average.

Inside was rustic.

Overall a good seafood restaurant.

P

author: Marilyn Barba
review_text: Chowder was delicious. Fried seafood combination platter was outstanding. Service was superb!

author: Angela Lard
review_text:
Our last meal in Boston before flying home and we came here for great Lobster.  The Lobster Pie was fantastic!  We loved sitting outside in the beautiful weather watching the planes take off and the lovely skyline.
Service was quick, our server was a charming young lady who had just started but when I asked questions she was quick to find the answers.  I would highly recommend for a lovely delicious meal.

author: Noel Lopez
review_text: The lobster roll was A+. It had lots of lobster meat and the bread was nice and buttery. The clam chowder was creamy but lacked clams. The drinks were good and strong. This is an all cash establishment but there is an atm on site.  Try it at least once.

author: Bruce Ferjulian
review_text: Arrived on a weekday at noon and there was plenty of parking and our group was able to sit along the window. The view facing the marina is nice and they have outdoor seating which is probably great during warm weather. I had the fried clams (whole belly) at market price which was slightly over ( $30 ). The clams were good but the batter tasted void of any salt and the tartar sauce could have used some lemon. All in all I would return.

author: Suneesh Menon
review_text: The restaurant has a fantastic location with beautiful views of the marina and planes landing at Boston Logan airport, but unfortunately the food didn’t live up to the setting. The seafood was fresh but under-seasoned and totally lacked flavor. Service was also disappointing — our waitress seemed to forget about us and it took us a long time to settle the bill and leave. Great spot that has a great reputation, but it definitely needs improvement in both food and service.

author: Tee Elle See
review_text: This restaurant is the nicest I've been to, and also extremely clean. The food was delicious, our server, Emily, was wonderful. The posters on the wall, were fun to see. We can't wait to visit again, when we are in town!!

author: Andrew Hudson
review_text: First time eating at Wahlburgers. It was all around great!  The hamburgers had a great ratio of meat, veggies, and bun. The brioche bun was a nice touch. Bryce our server was very friendly to everyone who walked in the door and sat close to the bar. The fries and tots were cooked and seasoned well.

author: RVSSO
review_text:
Phenomenal juicy burguer, medium rare is the way to go. Amazing service by Katie a local who has an amazing energy and overall service qualities.
Great music, clean bathroom, amazing spot.

author: Maricela Herrera
review_text: I'm from Texas and have been a fan. Ever since watching the show I had always wanted to come to a Whalbugers. Finally had the chance and let me tell you, it did not disappoint especiallythe fried pickles, best by far. Great service, food and prices. 10/10 wishing I had been able to see one of the brothers bit the manager made up for it with his great attitude/service. Will make another trip just for another wonderful experience.

author: joseph allocca
review_text: Went to dinner on Friday 01/02/2026 at the Hingham Shipyard location. Three of us got burgers which were very good however my sister got a chicken sandwich and the center of it was still pink. Under cooked chicken can make you very sick. They did take it off the bill but that is not acceptable for any restaurant.

author: Davi Santos
review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Wahlburgers and indulging in a selection of their mouthwatering burgers. From the first glance, it was clear that these burgers were crafted with care and an eye for delicious detail.

Classic Cheeseburger
The classic cheeseburger was a sight to behold, with its perfectly melted cheese draped over a juicy beef patty. The fresh lettuce and thick slice of onion added a crisp texture that complemented the richness of the beef. Each bite was a delightful blend of savory meat, creamy cheese, and refreshing vegetables. It's the kind of burger that reminds you why you love burgers in the first place.

The Super Melt
Next up was the grilled cheese burger, which took a creative twist on the traditional burger. Sandwiched between two slices of golden, buttery toast, the patty was packed with flavor and paired perfectly with the melted cheese and caramelized onions. This burger managed to capture the essence of comfort food, delivering a nostalgic yet innovative experience.

Double Decker
For those who crave a bit more, the double cheeseburger did not disappoint. Stacked with two beef patties and layers of gooey cheese, this burger was a feast for both the eyes and the stomach. The combination of the well-seasoned beef and the creamy cheese was simply irresistible, making it a top choice for anyone with a hearty appetite.

Crispy Chicken Sandwich
Lastly, the crispy chicken sandwich offered a delightful alternative for non-beef lovers. The chicken was fried to perfection, boasting a crunchy exterior that gave way to tender, juicy meat inside. Paired with fresh lettuce and a slice of tomato, this sandwich was both satisfying and refreshing.

Overall, Wahlburgers delivered an exceptional burger experience. Each item was carefully crafted, balancing flavors and textures to create a truly memorable meal. Whether you're a fan of the classics or looking to try something new, Wahlburgers has something to offer for every burger enthusiast.

author: Janet Stiles
review_text: We always enjoy our trip to Wahlburgers. The food, service, and atmosphere were perfect.  The food was cooked perfectly, and I loved the truffle fries.  Our waitress was very good and attentive. The atmosphere is cozy and very clean.

author: David Hernandez
review_text: Checked off one of the bucket list places I’ve wanted to eat today. Food was fresh and delicious.

author: Jana Batista
review_text: The burgers are delicious. Well stuffed and varied. Very well served and really worth it. The milkshakes are very good too. Only the service is sometimes not so good. The staff seem forgetful and take a while, but they do serve you well! It's a nice place to go with the family.

author: Eric Zago
review_text: The Parmesan Truffle Tots were amazing.  Loved the burger, too!  We got there at 4:30 on a Wednesday, and were the only customers there.  But, our server was fantastically attentive, and it was great meal after a great day.  Wish there were locations in the Worcester or Milford areas!

author: Ami Lanning
review_text: One of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Great truffle fries and fried pickles, too. My parents had the chicken sandwich and the meatball sub, and they said everything was delicious. Great, fast and friendly service. Hey Wahlburgers, open some locations in PA, please!!

author: Kristie R
review_text:
Excellent service, food & atmosphere. Our waitress Kirsten (hope I spelled that right) was friendly, and our food came out pretty quickly. Everything tasted fresh and was cooked perfectly.
We've been to other Wahlburgers locations in other states, but the surrounding area of this one is the most beautiful we've seen so far. Took a quick walk across the street to look over the water for a little bit and relax.
Free street parking was easy, but there is a parking lot also.

author: Stacy
review_text: I was at the Hingham Wahlburgers last Thursday. Jill was our server and she was AMAZING!! Very friendly and patient. I was there with my 80 yr old mom - who can be pretty picky about what she eats. She loved the ‘Our Burger’ in a bowl - absolutely perfect choice for her and easy to eat. Everything was delicious!! 💚

author: Karla Cortez
review_text:
We visited on a trip from Texas, right before Thanksgiving. I was not disappointed. Walking in, the store was clean and welcoming. The staff was friendly and right away started conversations. They gave us the locals recommended places we should see and visit on our trip. It was really nice.
The food was fresh and delicious. There's nothing like a good, juicy burger with crispy bacon!  The chicken burger was good, too. We also had the fried pickles! Delish!! I personally loved the tots, but my family's favorite was definitely the onion rings!
We would definitely visit again!

author: Chris Parent
review_text: None of the Wahlberg brothers were there this time either... Lol! I have to ask each time I go. The food is amazing every time and staff is very patient with everyone that has the same kind of questions. Hahaha! They also sell many different kinds of franchise stuff, including shirts, hats and accessories. They have now opened different ones up all over in and out of the Country, so check em out and see what You 🤔.

author: Michael Keller
review_text: Best service in the history of food service! Food tasted like it was crafted in high heaven, and our waiter said his name was "Bryce" but we shall forever refer to him as, "JOHN WAITER" If you're ever in Boston, it  should be an obligation to place this on your to-do list

author: Kelly Aieta
review_text: We enjoy the take out options and app is very user friendly. Kids love smahlburger and adults are team bbq burger. Fries are fresh. Truffle fries are a nice addition.  Sweet potato tots are also tasty.  Mexican Cola also delicious.

author: william gross
review_text: In the beginning it started out shakey the hostess didnt seat us and the bar tender was yelling across the room to her she turns around and says why cant you seat them  the food and drinks were great and the waiter was attentive. Kinda pricey for the drinks but food was very reasonable. Overall would go again.

author: Carol Leonard
review_text: We dined in. Service was fantastic. Crispy fish sandwich was dark brown, hard and dry, disappointed. Burger was ok.  Fries and shake were great !

author: S B.S.S.
review_text:
**6years later I have to change my review ** staff have no clue on anything! Starting with the old way when you walk in and order your food sit and eat was the easiest and faster way, they changed that to a way when no one knows how things works! Order they were unable to give me my receipt with my order on it so I have no clue what they charge me for, wait and wait then went to ask the host if they will call my name or I have to wait or what? She was not able to comprehend what I was asking while I figure out my order was behind her waiting for her to let me know my order was ready…while I was there literally 3 people was complaining about the same issue smh…to make things better while I was waiting I saw a mice running around from the bar to the kitchen I understand in a way but they could do better! The burger honestly was still delicious as 6 years ago! However the fried pickles were pretty greasy! Very disappointed and this was my last trip to here unfortunately not coming back! Staff not friendly at all!!!

** 6 years ago review Delicious burgers indeed!!Super friendly workers, fast and delicious burgers!Will be back for sure!**

author: Paul Anderson
review_text:
The restaurant inside and outside is beautiful. The food is absolutely delicious.
I knocked one star off of atmosphere purely because I personally am not a fan of live music. There was live music playing outside, and in my humble opinion it was too loud. Thankfully, they eventually took a break and I was able to eat my dinner in peace. - I would definitely go back but I would sit indoors.
My wife had one alcoholic beverage. I didn’t. He had two seafood dinners. The check came to a little over $130.

author: Todd Curtiss
review_text: Waterfront dinning with a spectacular view and food that rivals anything upscale restaurant in the major New England area. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Live music and drinks were excellent. Live music was the cherry on top of the cake. I highly recommend this place if you’re in town or simply just driving through it is definitely a destination stop.

author: Jea Kim
review_text:
Amazing views, & vibes and solid seafood dishes.

Came here with my colleagues for an early dinner on a weekday. The restaurant was in a secluded pier with all the boats and storage yards, so compared to other bay area restaurants I’ve been to in the area, it felt more private. The patio got eventually packed by the time we were about to leave, but we were able to snag a table right away.

We started off with some oysters, shrimps, and sautéed mussels. To be honest, the oysters and the shrimps were disappointing. The oysters lacked brininess, and overall it was just too mild. The jumbo shrimp looked great, but they were slightly overcooked and came out  a tad rubbery. The mussels were satisfying and the white sauce was on point.

For the entrées, we opted for the scallops, swordfish, and the blackened chicken pasta. My colleague said the scallops were his favorite, and it was the most solid dish of the three. The rice grains were perfectly al dente, and I liked how they used the claw meats instead of the tail to amplify that natural lobster flavors. They also cut it in long chunks which helped accentuate its texture. Some of the scallop pieces weren’t exactly the freshest, but a solid dish overall.
For entrées we had the scallops, swordfish, and blackened chicken pasta. My colleague was all about the scallops, and I’d say they were the best of the three. The rice had a good al dente bite, and I liked that they used claw meat instead of tail as it gave the lobster flavor a little more depth. Cutting it into long chunks made the texture pop too. Not every scallop tasted super fresh, but overall it was a pretty satisfying plate.

The swordfish was probably the thickest I’ve ever seen served as a steak, and even with the crisped edges it stayed fairly moist. Swordfish is usually kind of boring to me, but the crunchy bits in each bite kept it more interesting. Small tip: swap the fingerling potatoes for risotto—the extra moisture makes a big difference. As for the blackened chicken pasta, it had a pleasant kick, but otherwise was pretty standard.

Would come back to soak in the vibes and enjoy the waterfront setting. Food’s on par with some of the good seafood places I’ve been around Boston, but not the best in the area.

author: Jaclyn D
review_text: Stopped in for drinks and apps and everything was great! The lobster avocado was so unique and a great combo! The sticky ribs were AMAZING and the clam chowder I look forward to having again. Overall a great place with a bright, fresh ambiance.

author: Chris Ianiri
review_text: This restaurant offers nice water views and outdoor seating. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. The food was phenomenal! I highly recommend the blue crab ravioli meal… One of the best seafood dishes I’ve had in a long time! Definitely check this place out!

author: Maria Felina
review_text:
First time at this restaurant with my family. Plenty of parking but they are busy!

Originally they told us one hour wait but ended up being 15 mins.

Food was delicious and it came out quick. The kids menu had plenty to pick from but is pricy at $15. Comes with drink and ice cream.

My salad was okay. Nothing fancy but the chowder was delicious.

NOTICE: There is a admin fee when dining here. Our waitress said it is due to inflation and it’s per item. Receipt included.

author: Sam kassis
review_text: The food was perfect we were party of four every we was happy with there food nothing to complain about, the day was raining and we sat inside but they do have nice deck i am sure the deck  is beautiful on a nice sunny day

author: Maureen Ryan-Hoffman
review_text: I'm so glad I picked this restaurant. The stuffed lobster is the BEST we've had in about 30 years. The quality, preparation (all cleaned out, meat removed from claws, mixed in the stuffing...). Our Server, Eddie, was smiley, friendly, wanted to take good care of his customers, which he did with great ease. Beautiful, relaxing atmosphere. Very comfortable.  It was a nice experience and meal to remember. Thank you .

author: Lorena Gomes Rocha
review_text:
Fantastic Waterfront Dining Experience
I had an amazing time at this waterfront restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch—friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, perfect for a summer outing by the water. I especially loved the fish tank—it adds such a fun and unique touch to the dining space. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great food with a view!

author: Amanda Landry
review_text: Absolutely gorgeous venue especially for a shower (we had 60 ppl) & great customer service. Flexible to fit your needs; pricey packages but understandable for a waterfront (harbor) view near Boston. Beautiful room, big windows & vaulted wooden ceilings. My o my complaint, however, was the function food (brunch) couldve been much much better for that price tag. Waitstaff and bartenders were exceptional! Very helpful, kind & great service. Plenty of parking. Thank you!

author: Kerrie Fraser
review_text: We made an impromptu stop at Bay Pointe on our way through Boston and we are so glad we did! We were able to be seated right away with a view of the water. Our waitress was so attentive and gracious.  The food was delicious but the star of the night was the sweet chili shrimp appetizer.   We just loved our stop in Quincy.  Thank you!!!

author: Marquise Bailey-Dillard
review_text:
I visited Bay Point Restaurant today with a family group of eight. The atmosphere was definitely the highlight — they have outdoor seating with a breezy, relaxed summer vibe, as well as drink-only high-top tables where you can enjoy a drink before sitting down. We waited outside with a drink before heading indoors for our meal, and the outdoor setting felt inviting.

Once inside, service for a large party was decent. The staff took appetizer and drink orders in a reasonable time, refilled drinks, and checked in as needed.

Food, however, was underwhelming. Two people ordered steak tips and found them enjoyable. Two others ordered chicken but found it dry. Two of us ordered the “catch of the day,” which was said to be haddock — but as someone who enjoys fish regularly, I didn’t taste anything resembling true haddock. Overall, the food was mediocre and lacked anything memorable.

In the end, while the atmosphere is a nice spot to grab a drink on a pleasant day, the food doesn’t justify a return visit for me. If you’re looking for a place with a good summer view and a drink in hand, it works. But for a satisfying meal, I’d look elsewhere.

author: Krissy M
review_text: Great spot, wish I knew about it sooner! The food was delicious and reasonably priced. Atmosphere can’t be beat on a nice day.

author: renee pham
review_text: Overall pretty good. Lots of free parking. Food did take a while to come out though, but they were busy.  My family was satisfied with their meals.

author: Paul Oliveira
review_text: Had a birthday celebration there with 11 people and everything was fabulous.  Olivia and the entire staff did a great job accommodating us with a private table on the patio.  Rob, our waiter, was very attentive, and did a fantastic job.  Food and drinks were great!  The view is wonderful and very serene.  We all took pictures on the lower dock area.  Thank you for everything 🥂

author: Martina Zoi
review_text: Amazing place. Great atmosphere there was live music. I loved the singer. The food was very good. Scallops were cooked excellent. Lobster roll was kind of blunt. Did not feel mayo or any marination. Definitely overpriced lobster roll. There is a wait of ~45 minutes on busy days for outdoor seating.

author: Павел Жардецкий
review_text: We been there for the first time  and it was awesome.  We didn't  expect  something  extraordinary but we were very surprised  when we finished our dinner. Everything  was perfect.  Food delicious.  We ordered  Serlion steak  tips and  it was cooked exactly  i wanted.  Oysters and shrimps were fabulous.  We came from VA  and definitely come back again.

author: Melise Nguyen
review_text: I’ve been here a few times, and I must say..never disappointed. Food was staff amazing. Amanda was our waitress and she was friendly and pleasant and always checking to see if we need anything but giving us enough time and space to have our meal. Host was very friendly and informative. Highly recommended.

author: Jeneen Hinkle
review_text: Oh my!! It was my first time on the North-east coast and I wanted lobster and fish and chips and Bay Pointe did not disappoint! The fish and chips were so light and flaky they were the best I have ever tasted. The lobster roll was flavorful,  stuffed with sweet succulent lobster with a hint of mayonnaise!  The clam chowder was rich and flavorful with large chunks of clam! The service was great also! What a wonderful dining experience 👌

author: Savannah Broderick
review_text: The best part of the experience was our server Patrick. He made it personal and inviting. We were impressed by his speedy service and his patience and kindness. Would return again only for the service. I loved the waterfront experience and the fish tanks. There are several puffer fish and clown fish! Great food, came out timely and was flavorful. I got the french dip sandwich. It came with fries and oju, which I never had before but was pleasantly surprised!
